jobs.title: Deployment Safety Engineering Manager II, Technology Deployment (TD)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? We apply advances in robotics and software to solve real\-world problems that delight our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. Amazon Robotics (AR) is located in the greater Boston area, the epicenter of robotics innovation. Our diverse team of engineers come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots and mechatronic systems. Having our offices, labs, test floors and factories all co\-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in autonomous movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more. The AR Technology Deployment (TD) Strategy and Operations (S\&O) team is looking for an experienced Safety Engineer to be responsible for the deployment of new technologies and products in a safe, ergonomic and efficient manner in new construction as well as live sites. This individual will partner with WHS, General Contractors, and Deployment Engineers to support day\-to\-day monitoring of Tech Deployment Safety Programs and initiatives. The candidate will assist in conducting incident investigation, reviewing safety compliance, and drive proactive identification of potential safety hazards for TD, our partners, and impacted teams across deployment sites. The individual will take the lead in promoting safety awareness and education across deployment sites and labs and be hands\-on with the product and deployment teams we support. We are looking for someone that is passionate about Safety, can identify risks and opportunities, deep dive incident metrics, and owns driving improvements while engaging Hardware, Deployment engineers, Operations teams and other stakeholders.. Key job responsibilities * Lead TD Safety Management System (SMS) program implementation and transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions across deployment sites. * Drive deployment safety continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in deployment sites. * Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our deployment engineers and contractors while enhancing operational excellence. * Develop leadership safety plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment across deployment sites. * Measure performance against TD safety policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site DSSI audits to address non\-compliance issues. * Build partnerships with Deployment engineers to integrate safety into every aspect of deployment processes. * Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision\-making. * Oversee incident record\-keeping, deployment area organization, and drive safety training program compliance. * Partner with Deployment engineers, contractors, WHS and other affected teams to report and investigate incidents and/or near misses and ensure timely/accurate documentation. * Support TD Contractor management, pre\-qualification and the execution of the Safe System of Work (SSOW) developed to perform Contractor work in deployment sites A day in the life As a Safety Engineer, you will take a lead role in implementing, monitoring, and evaluating TD Safety programs to ensure compliance with Amazon WHS and industry safety standards in order to provide a safe and secure workplace for employees and partners. You will be responsible for maintaining safety documentation, reporting and investigation of incidents, as well as leading and/or participating on safety committees, programs and initiatives. You will work across Amazon team to develop safety standard work in conjunction with our engineers, designers, and associates. In the event of issues or escalations you will investigate and report on situations and ensure proper actions are captured and closed out. You will pull teams together as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to conduct Root Cause Analyses in conjunction with Operations leadership and our deployment teams. In support of our field activities, you will perform site physical condition safety observations, safety behavior observations, as well as audits and inspections in relation to fire and safety related equipment. Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include: 1\. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage 2\. Maternity and Parental Leave Options 3\. Paid Time nt to make an impact on a global scale, please apply! About the team RDPI Technology Deployment (TD) offers services to our global customers to realize the full value of automation solutions. We deliver safe, efficient, and high\-quality integrations at scale to meet emerging network and business needs. We do this by partnering with upstream and downstream customers to innovate and perform rapid experimentation. This accelerates the maturity of complex solutions throughout the product lifecycle to enable simplified execution**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in safety, environmental, or equivalent * 3\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience * 3\+ years of safety compliance, audit or risk management experience in deployment sites or in manufacturing, construction, or service operations experience * Experience using data and metrics to measure impact, determine improvements, and provide feedback to development teams * Experience in analyzing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures associated with deployment operations * Experience in managing contractor work in fulfillment centers and ensuring safety compliance * Experience in incident reporting and investigations and ensuring risk control measures. * Excellent written and oral communication skills **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Master's degree in Safety, engineering, operations or MBA in business, or related field. Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or CSME or other functional safety certification or equivalent certification * Experience in the installation and commissioning of new technologies and equipment, including hoisting and rigging operations and safe lifting plans. * Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience with end\-to\-end project management * Experience working with fast\-moving, high\-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments * Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, effective communication abilities, including communicating complex business concepts in verbal and written form * Experience leveraging technology and AI tools to implement lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. existing technologies, including reviewing safe lifting plans for material movement in Amazon sites. * Contribute to building a safety culture that enables our technical engineering teams develop safe jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The BIL US Emerging Brand Partnerships team creates and delivers a dynamic, best\-in\-class, only\-at\-Amazon program experience for brands, customers, and internal stakeholders that yields measurable business impact. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Advertising & Marketing Performance Intelligence
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Advertising \& Marketing Performance Intelligence (AMPI) team is seeking passionate and talented MLE to join us. Team is on a mission to create cohesive, relevant, and truly helpful marketing experiences for every advertiser through automated processes and intelligence that enable scaled personalization. Our team is responsible for defining and publishing automated marketing communications leveraging Machine Learning, large language models (LLMs), large quantitative models (LQMs), and specialized agents using AI/ML workflows. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) to develop, deploy and scale robust ML and GenAI solutions in production environment. You will own building ML Infra for production models and feed AI/ML outputs to systems and services . In this role you will closely partner with Applied Scientists, Data Engineers,Product Managers, Software engineers to deliver and implement automated decision\-making algorithms. This team plays a significant role in various stages of the innovation pipeline from identifying business needs, developing new algorithms, prototyping/simulation, to implementation by working closely with colleagues in engineering, science, product management, marketing business operations and finance. Key job responsibilities * Collaborate with Data and Applied Scientists to process structured/unstructured data inputs, scale ML and LLM infra while optimizing Infra costs, GPU utilization, memory management, and the training workflows (like offloading optimizer states, massive parallelization, etc) for the production environments. * Create and deliver reusable technical assets that help to accelerate the adoption of ML, Optimization and GenAI across different science initiatives * Design and maintain production grade large\-scale distributed training systems to support ML, Causal, GenAI and multi\-modal foundation models. * Optimize AWS AI/ML infra costs, GPU utilization for efficient model training, latency, costs and fine\-tuning on massive datasets. * Develop robust monitoring and debugging tools to ensure the reliability and performance of training workflows, support piloting the LLMs and identify the related issues in the system. * Collaborate with Engineers, Data and Applied Scientists to investigate design approaches, prototype new GenAI and ML models, evaluate technical feasibility, identify and solve complex problems. A day in the life As a member of our team, you'll work on projects that directly impact millions of Amazon advertisers and Marketers across the globe . This role will provide exposure to state\-of\-the\-art innovations in Big Data, AI/ML systems and help Ads Marketing automate advertiser communications with personalized and relevant content and Measure/Calibrate Marketing effectiveness using RCTs. Technologies you will have exposure to, and/or will work with, include AWS Bedrock, Agentic AI (RAG, Agentic architectures, vector databases), Amazon Q, SageMaker, Containerized deployments, Hugging Face/LangChain, Guardrail implementations and Foundational Models such as Qwen, Anthropic’s Claude / Mistral, among others. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience programming with at least one software programming language * Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * 1\+ years of building large\-scale machine\-learning infrastructure for online recommendation, ads ranking, personalization or search experience Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. You will work in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next\-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network. The position's responsibilities include capacity scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Scaling Leadership and Technical Program Managers. You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Technician II you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of Amazon Web Services vast network infrastructure, Network Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. And then partner with network engineers to ensure all configurations are ready. You'll also be working on link and device troubleshooting within a certain Service\-Level Agreement 2\. There is also console builds (and room builds) that are really exciting. You'll be exposed to more teams whose goal is to provide more space and capacity for customer racks. 3\. Work with ID\-Scaling peers to build higher\-level networking devices. This team covers the whole Pennsylvania region with all the sites inside and outside the perimeter. There is travel involved as we move where the capacity is needed. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Amazon Customer Service Data Intelligence
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Customer Service Data Intelligence is hiring a Principal Product Manager \- Technical to own how we prove that the artificial intelligence serving our customers is safe, correct, and fair. Customer Service Data Intelligence builds the data and intelligence foundation for Amazon Customer Service. When a customer contacts Amazon, the systems that resolve their issue need context — what they said, what they ordered, what they already tried. Our organization is responsible for turning those interactions into a governed, trustworthy foundation that models and applications can safely consume, and for the privacy and security controls that make consuming it possible at all. This role exists because of a specific shift. When people handled every interaction, trust was a matter of training and policy. When artificial intelligence handles interactions autonomously, across every channel, trust becomes a matter of architecture. You cannot train an agent into good judgment after the fact, and you cannot audit your way to confidence in a system making decisions continuously. The property has to be engineered in — and increasingly, it has to hold for interactions no person will ever review. You will own the product charter for that engineering. That means building the capability to verify an automated decision against policy before it executes rather than sampling it afterward, the capability to test our own agents adversarially and continuously rather than waiting for someone to find the gap first, and the capability to show that automated decisions treat customers consistently regardless of the marketplace they contact from, the language they speak, or the channel they use. The most interesting part of this role is that the problem is genuinely unsolved. There is no vendor to buy this from and no established playbook to copy. You will define what "provably safe" means for customer\-facing artificial intelligence at Amazon's scale, then build the products that make it the default path rather than the careful path. You will do it alongside security engineers, applied scientists, and legal partners, and your work will set the standard other teams build against. Key job responsibilities * Own the product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for security and privacy intelligence across Amazon Customer Service artificial intelligence systems * Define requirements for translating customer service policies into machine\-verifiable logic, so automated decisions can be checked against policy before they execute rather than sampled afterward * Own the product roadmap for continuous adversarial testing of customer service agents, including pre\-launch security posture scoring as a launch requirement * Define and operate a fairness verification and monitoring framework that measures whether automated decisions produce consistent outcomes across customer segments, and escalates when they do not * Map product capabilities to regulatory obligations so compliance evidence is generated as a byproduct of operation rather than assembled on request * Chair the cross\-organization governance forum that resolves policy conflicts, approves time\-bounded exceptions, and closes the loop from a detected issue to an updated and re\-verified policy * Partner with security engineering, applied science, legal, and agent\-building teams to turn findings into launch standards other teams build against * Write the documents that drive decisions at director and vice president level, and define the metrics that show whether the safe path is also the fast path A day in the life Your week is split between three kinds of work. The first is depth: sitting with applied scientists and security engineers on how a policy becomes a formal constraint, or reading the output of an adversarial test run against one of our agents and deciding whether what it found is a bug in the agent or a gap in the policy. The second is decision\-forcing: chairing the governance forum where security, legal, and the agent\-building teams bring cases that need a call — restrict this agent, update that policy, accept this risk — and making sure each decision leaves with an owner and a date. The third is writing. This organization runs on documents, and the roadmap you own gets funded, sequenced, and defended in prose. You will also spend real time on other teams' problems, because the fastest way to make the safe path the default is to make it cheaper than the alternative for the team shipping next month. About the team Customer Service Data Intelligence builds the foundation that everything else in Customer Service depends on: how interaction data is captured, governed, enriched, traced, and safely consumed. Our teams span data and software engineering, applied science, analytics, and the privacy and security work that determines what any of it can be used for. We are at an unusual moment. Language became computable, which turned two decades of customer conversations from an operational cost into the most valuable behavioral signal Amazon has — provided we can use it safely. That condition is the work. We are a builder\-heavy, document\-driven organization that would rather solve a problem once, centrally, than watch every team solve it badly on their own.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree * Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition * Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product * Experience technical product management * Experience owning and leading significant projects from concept to deployment * Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements * Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement * Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution * Experience within a customer service/contact center environment \- \- Experience building security, privacy, or compliance products \- \- Experience working with legal and regulatory stakeholders on data protection or artificial intelligence regulation Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Product Manager - Tech, GO-AI Technology & Development Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Robotics is at the forefront of applying state\-of\-the\-art artificial intelligence to solve real\-world challenges on an unprecedented scale. Our fulfillment centers handle more individual items than any company in the world, combining computer vision, mobile robots, advanced end\-of\-arm tooling, and high\-degree of freedom movement with state\-of\-the\-art AI. We collaborate with customers across Amazon worldwide to conceive, develop, prototype, and deploy intelligent robotic systems that push the boundaries of industrial automation. Within Amazon Robotics, the Global Operations \- Artificial Intelligence (GO\-AI) team enables Amazon to accelerate and scale the next generation of AI\-powered robotic solutions. We're transforming how complex visual reasoning tasks are performed across Amazon's robotics operations, moving from traditional manual data annotation processes to state\-of\-the\-art foundation model solutions. As a Product Manager \- Tech, you will own and drive GO\-AI's product feature strategy and roadmap. You will develop deep expertise in GO\-AI's customers and operations to make informed, data\-driven product decisions. Leveraging your technical acumen and operational knowledge, you will influence architecture decisions, evaluate technical proposals, and ensure alignment between customer needs and engineering execution. GO\-AI's product portfolio spans software applications for annotations and near\-real\-time remote intervention, business intelligence reporting and insights, and data discoverability platforms. It also includes foundation models designed to automate the annotation process and other high\-value workflows. The portfolio is actively expanding to support remote real\-time tele\-operations—a critical growth area that will require defining new product capabilities from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to work with a team building AI systems that operate at Amazon scale while solving novel technical challenges in computer vision, natural language processing, and human\-AI collaboration. You'll collaborate with world\-class scientists, engineers, and operations teams to deploy state\-of\-the\-art research into production systems that deliver real\-world impact at global scale. Key job responsibilities * Define GO\-AI product long\-term vision, portfolio roadmap, and priorities through Working Backwards documents * Perform competitive analysis by establishing continuous customer and market feedback loops; translate insights into actionable product direction * Drive end\-to\-end product and feature launches across the GO\-AI portfolio, ensuring operational readiness, customer adoption, and alignment to business goals * Partner with GO\-AI engineering and science teams to navigate trade\-offs across customer requirements, technical feasibility, and quality standards * Partner with GO\-AI operations teams to balance delivery KPIs, including quality thresholds, with speed and scope * Define adoption metrics and own the business reporting cadence (weekly/monthly); present progress and recommendations to leadership * Represent customer needs in architecture and technical design discussions, ensuring product decisions are grounded in real\-world operational context **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent * 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience * Can show strong verbal and written communication skills * 3\+ years of experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition of software products along with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product * Experience building or managing data analytics products * Experience contributing to science, software, and data engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy * Experience working with engineering teams delivering software products and features using agile methodologies **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning * Master's in Computer Science or other relevant degree * Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle * Experience with data labeling platforms, human\-in\-the\-loop ML systems, or annotation tooling * Familiarity with remote tele\-operations concepts and solutions * Familiarity with robotics, fulfilment operations or large\-scale annotation/labelling workflows. * Experience working with applied science teams and foundation model technologies. jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop. As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more. \*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role. Key job responsibilities As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer. You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available. * You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently. * You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.) * You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization * You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources * You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes. * You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals. * You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains * You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment * You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results A day in the life In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your p tions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience * 5\+ years experience in troubleshooting robotics systems or other complex mechanical\-electrical or networked systems to resolve escalations including quality hand\-off, live order testing, site acceptance testing, operational readiness testing, and monitoring system performance * 5\+ years experience in project management related to the deployment, retrofits or technical maintenance of large\-scale industrial robotics * 5\+ years experience in use of project management and supply management tools/software including managing Bills of Material, deployment work instructions, and project task management * Experience working with technical drawings and/or reading CAD models (mechanical and electrical) for use in deployment, maintenance or support of large\-scale industrial robotics * Demonstrated ability to work with PLCs, SCADA systems, and network infrastructure. * Ability to travel domestically 75% or more of the year **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * MBA, or graduate degree in engineering or STEM field * 5\+ years experience with machine Overall Equipment Effectiveness and Key Performance Indicator metrics tools (such as Tableau) * Experience working with and managing third party vendors * Experience/certifications in Six Sigma, lean manufacturing and/or PMP * Excellent business communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders to leadership 2\+ levels above * Experience working in a 24/7 production environment * Experience in industrial systems engineering, such as building designs including conveyance and industrial robotics * Experience in building Capital Appropriation Requests for jobs.title: Senior Performance Engineer, Efficiency Red Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you the kind of engineer who obsesses over performance? Does the idea of hunting for hidden waste across the world's largest infrastructure and turning those findings into hundreds of millions of dollars in freed capacity sound like the most exciting job you can imagine? If so, keep reading. This role offers something rare. Deep technical research freedom, immediate access to the largest compute infrastructure in the world, and direct line of sight to impact that reshapes how Amazon builds and operates its infrastructure. The Efficiency Red Team has already driven billions in cumulative capacity savings, reclaimed petabytes of DRAM through automated profiling, and built GPU efficiency frameworks adopted across Amazon. And we are just getting started. The surface area of opportunity grows with every new workload, every new chip generation, and every new AI model Amazon deploys. You would be joining a team with a proven foundation and an expanding frontier. Compute demand is rising with no sign of slowing down. The explosive growth of Generative AI has created unprecedented demand for GPUs, and the shock\-waves are now constraining DRAM availability for traditional compute across the entire industry. Silicon, power, and physical space are not infinite. When capacity is constrained, efficiency becomes the new capacity. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Help shape how Whole Foods Market merchants plan, forecast, and make decisions, and put AI\-powered tools in their hands to do it better. As a Senior Product Manager, you'll own the product strategy for intelligent automation, next\-generation forecasting models, and the data foundations that connect them. You'll work at the intersection of AI/ML, merchant experience, and supply chain data to build capabilities that fundamentally change how category managers operate across one of the world's most trusted grocery brands. Whole Foods Market is known as the number one grocer suppliers want to be in, and our merchants are central to that reputation. Your job is to make them faster, sharper, and more confident in their decisions, whether that's through AI agents that surface insights at the point of decision, forecasting models that replace legacy planning systems, or data integrations that give merchants end\-to\-end visibility from supplier to shelf. You'll partner closely with engineering, UX research, analytics, and business teams spanning Amazon and WFM to translate complex technical capabilities into tools merchants trust and adopt. Key job responsibilities Own the product strategy and roadmap for AI\-powered merchant intelligence tools, including adoption strategy, capability governance, and merchant enablement Lead cross\-functional execution of forecasting model migration: defining success criteria, orchestrating data readiness, managing cross\-team dependencies, and driving go/no\-go decisions Drive data integration and catalog harmonization initiatives across multiple systems and organizations, resolving complex upstream and downstream dependencies Define product requirements for new analytical capabilities, including store clustering, category intelligence, and assortment optimization, from problem framing through OP1 commitment Earn merchant trust through direct engagement: translating technical capabilities into business value, validating solutions in the field, and building feedback loops that inform the roadmap Navigate a complex stakeholder landscape spanning product, engineering, supply chain, UX, and merchandising organizations across both Amazon and Whole Foods Market A day in the life You'll move between strategic planning and hands\-on execution in a single day. One hour you're reviewing AI capability adoption trends and refining the product roadmap, the next you're in a cross\-functional sync resolving data dependencies with engineering and analytics partners. After lunch, you might walk category managers through a new capability prototype, then pivot to a UX research debrief that reshapes how you think about the planning workflow. You'll regularly translate between technical ML conversations and practical merchant needs. Expect to partner with teams across Amazon and WFM, navigate ambiguity, and drive clarity where there isn't any yet. About the team Our team builds the tools and platforms that Whole Foods Market category managers rely on to plan, price, promote, and merchandise products. Our portfolio spans assortment planning, pricing optimization, promotions planning, and space and merchandising execution, all powered by a shared data foundation and increasingly driven by AI. We're at an inflection point: transitioning from legacy planning systems to intelligent, data\-driven capabilities that change how merchants work. We build in close partnership with Amazon's retail, technology, and operations teams. We move fast, operate with high ambiguity, and value PMs who earn trust with both engineers and merchants. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience * Bachelor's degree or equivalent * Experience as a product manager or owner * Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product * Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition * Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices. * Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Control Plane & Orchestration, Prime Video
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Prime Video is transforming how customers discover and experience entertainment. We are a premium streaming service offering an endless selection of movies, TV shows, sports, and more — all tailored to each customer's unique interests. Our vast library includes thousands of popular movies and TV series, critically acclaimed Amazon Originals, exciting live sports, and exclusive content you will not find anywhere else. With Prime Video, customers can easily find their next favorite show, rent or buy new releases, or subscribe to premium add\-on channels — all within a seamless, personalized experience. Prime Video is available globally in over 240 countries and territories, bringing the best of entertainment to customers worldwide. We are passionate storytellers committed to fostering connections between creators and audiences through unforgettable viewing experiences. We own the content management and aggregation platform that powers Prime Video (PV) content discovery experiences on all PV supported devices worldwide. We are responsible for constructing a page, orchestrating carousels and titles on that page and serving it to hundreds of millions of PV customers. Our platform is at the core of the PV content discovery experience and is critical to the PV mission of “Show Every Customer the Right Content, in the Right Place, at the Right Time”. We are the gateway for any PV content owner (e.g: Live Events) to push content to the different PV storefront pages. To be successful at our scale, we invest in long term platform capabilities and deal with exciting technical challenges on a daily basis. The complexity of the technical problems that we are solving creates great opportunities for engineers to meet their career goals and grow professionally. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to help us drive product innovation in our onboarding customer experience and raise the bar on operational excellence for our Tier\-1 filtering service. You will work on high\-scale, low\-latency distributed systems that directly shape what hundreds of millions of customers see when they open Prime Video, while also building customer\-facing features that make first impressions count for new viewers. You will have the opportunity to experiment with and champion AI\-powered development tools and workflows to accelerate how we build, test, and operate software. If you are excited about owning systems end\-to\-end at massive scale, thinking like a product owner, and pushing the boundaries of what AI tooling can do for engineering teams, this role is for you. Key job responsibilities Prime Video (PV) is a premium entertainment service that offers customers the greatest choices in what to watch, and how to watch it. PV delivers movies and TV shows instantly to TVs, tablets, game consoles and PCs worldwide. This is an evolving business within Amazon where creativity and drive can have a lasting impact on the way video is enjoyed worldwide. You will be encouraged to see the big picture, be creative, and positively impact millions of customers. We’re building the future of TV—yes, it’s challenging, but it’s also a lot of fun. Our team's mission is to empower Amazonians in delivering Earth's most customer\-centric video experience and increasing customer engagement by building products that automate all storefront merchandising and scale Prime Video’s service expansion. It’s a big goal and we’ll need to invent solutions along the way. We own high performance, low\-latency and highly available services and a rule engine built on a graph\-based data model that composes every storefront page on every supported PV device worldwide. Our teams embrace agile methodologies with a focus on automation and continuous deployment. We follow high development standards and build solutions that scale long\-term. On a daily basis we are solving challenging technical problems that create great opportunities for engineers to grow professionally and become tech experts. Our engineers are very excited to make code changes and test them at home on their PV\-supported devices. The team is seeking a talented and passionate Software Development Engineer to join our team. A successful candidate will have a strong technical ability, great communication skills, a motivation to achieve results in a fast\-paced environment, high creativity, great analytical reasoning skills, and, of course, a passion for TV and movies. A day in the life You will be building our best\-in\-class content aggregation platform while solving challenging technical problems. You will contribute to the PV storefront architecture. You will build platform capabilities and long term solutions that will need to perform at scale. We are at the epicenter of the storefront generation and hence you will have an opportunity to collaborate with many other PV teams and influence the PV technical ecosystem. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Multi-Channel Sourcing
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- How vendors and warehouses join Amazon's fulfillment network matters: it shapes delivery speed, product selection, and the economics of every order. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Multi\-Channel Sourcing (MCS) team within Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization, you will build software at the top of the sourcing funnel. These systems directly impact customer delivery promises and vendor operations across 80,000\+ vendors and 100,000\+ warehouses in 16 marketplaces, generating \~7% of worldwide Amazon Gross Merchandise Sales (GMS) in 2025\. You will design and ship features that onboard vendors and their warehouses as live nodes in Amazon's fulfillment network and scale Direct Fulfillment into new marketplaces while improving the channel's economics. You will also build the sourcing cost models that determine the true cost of sourcing at the vendor, channel, and ASIN grain, informing sourcing decisions across the network. The team's long\-term charter is still taking shape, so you can expect open architecture questions and the opportunity to provide input on where the team goes next. Key job responsibilities * Design, build, test, and deploy features that onboard vendors and warehouses as nodes in Amazon's fulfillment network with minimal friction. * Build capabilities that scale Direct Fulfillment into new marketplaces and deliver profitability levers that improve the channel's economics. * Develop the cost models that determine the true cost of sourcing from every vendor and feed Amazon's network\-wide sourcing optimization. * Develop and operate highly available, cloud\-native distributed systems on AWS that connect vendor systems with Amazon's internal fulfillment services. * Participate in code reviews, mentor fellow engineers, investigate operational issues to their root cause, and deliver permanent fixes that improve system reliability. A day in the life Most of your time is spent writing and reviewing code: building onboarding features, refining cost models, or improving system reliability. You collaborate with your team during design discussions and standups, and work with partner teams across the supply chain organization when your changes touch their systems. The rest of your time goes to operational support, documentation, and mentoring teammates on how your services are built and run. About the team The Multi\-Channel Sourcing (MCS) organization within Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) builds a comprehensive, intelligent suite of systems that answer how Amazon sources its selection. By integrating vendor capabilities, operational constraints, and economic modeling, we match our products to the simplest possible supply chain at the lowest cost for both Amazon and vendors through mutually beneficial supply chain relationships. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon is seeking a motivated, data\-driven Sr. Category Manager to support Americas data center expansion and infrastructure development within the Energy Infrastructure and Projects portfolio. In this role, you will own end\-to\-end sourcing strategies for natural gas procurement categories—collaborating with internal business partners, engineering teams, and suppliers to drive efficiencies, reduce risks, and optimize costs at scale. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to ensure supplier accountability for performance and delivery, leveraging competitive bidding, strategic negotiations, and comprehensive analysis of data and market trends to deliver measurable results for your category. jobs.title: Sr. Chief Engineer, DCEO, AWS DC Operations Engineering, DCEO
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon is looking for a detail\-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first\-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers. As the Data Center Senior Chief Engineer (CE), you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. You will serves as an expert technical resource reporting to the cluster leadership and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT), Chief Engineers (CE), Facility Managers (FM) and any third party vendors. Being the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center, you will support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission\-critical servers must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. As the Senior Chief Engineer you will manage small\-to\-medium impacting projects at local and/or regional level from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. Creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities. One of the best parts to this role is that you will direct, train and support Engineering Operation Technicians in their role of providing hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment\-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand\-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems. Key job responsibilities * Setting and maintaining the highest standards for safety and actively promoting a world\-class safety culture in all aspects of operational procedure * Driving continuous improvement efforts on infrastructure through standardisation of procedures and policies, while delivering performance against agreed metrics * Working closely with the Operations Principal Engineer, site Chief Engineers and broader operations teams to streamline maintenance procedures, and implement standardized risk assessment protocols. * Enabling the operations organisation to delivering 100% uptime on all customer supporting infrastructure * Training and mentoring technical operations staff members on the execution of all corrective and preventative maintenance activities on all mission\-critical infrastructure * Collaborating effectively with 3rd party providers to deliver operational excellence for all AWS customers * Innovation and delivery of a portfolio of strategic projects on critical infrastructure to ensure class\-leading performance * The successful delivery of build\-out and retrofit of facility infrastructure in existing and new regional locations through a deep technical review and execution of construction \& commissioning activities by contracted providers * Ensuring organisational capability to react \& respond appropriately to any potential customer impacting event on any component of electrical or mechanical infrastructure. * Elevating capabilities of site chief engineers and EOT’s, establish training requirements, coordinate operational readiness testing (LLT, MOT, CCT), LSE/CSE drill \& CST programs. Do you enjoy working on scalable services technology in a team environment? Do you like working on industry\-defining projects that move the needle? At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand. Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities * Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market. * Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry. * Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed. * Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use. * Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems. * Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software. Our systems process demand across 54 network departments, serving planning horizons from material procurement to power planning. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low\-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain \& Procurement (ISCaP) organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly\-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth! We are looking for a results\-oriented individual to support ISCaP planning and sourcing requirements for mission critical part supply chain for AWS data centers. You will work across the team and its customers to align on a short and long\-range supply plan. You will contribute to our Global Spare Planning function to understand the needs of our data centers across our network and manage the inventory across different nodes of our supply chain. If you love being at the forefront of industry growth and development, developing and executing processes in a highly ambiguous environment, identifying information gaps and collaboration needs, and driving business strategy, then this is the spot for you. This is a high impact role offering an opportunity to drive and influence business\-critical decisions impacting the long\-term future of the business. If you are an experienced professional with a passion for technology, driving change and impact at a Global scale, you might be a fit for the Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure supply chain and procurement team. jobs.title: Software Product Manager
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built, and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a real\-time, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **ABOUT THE TEAM** ------------------ Anduril's Electronic Warfare (EW) division builds next\-generation electronic warfare platforms — hardware\-enabled, software\-defined systems that are fielded, operational, and scaling fast. The EW team operates at a tempo the defense industry isn't used to: delivering novel system configurations into active operations in days, not months, securing major contract awards in under 24 hours, and earning unanimous fielding recommendations from government evaluators. Production is scaling from hundreds to thousands of units across multiple product variants, and the release and delivery challenges are scaling with it. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE** We are looking for a Software Product Manager to own what ships to the operator. EW Mission Applications builds the software between the device and the operator — operator applications, Lattice integrations, shared visualization components, and the internal tooling that the rest of the business line runs on. You will own the roadmap for that surface: which capabilities reach operators, through which channel, and in what order. EW Mission Applications delivers through multiple channels: each channel has different users, different timelines, and a different definition of done. Teams are organized by product surface rather than by program, so every engineering team supports several programs at once. Every program in the business line wants something from those teams. You decide what gets built, you write down why, and you hold that line when program pressure arrives — which it will, constantly, and for good reasons. This role is product\-focused and technically grounded. You won't write production code day to day, but you need to understand the device SDK boundary, the client architecture, and the integration surface well enough to tell a real blocker from a preference, to write requirements engineering can build against, and to negotiate scope with embedded engineering on the merits. ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Own the EW Mission Applications product roadmap: what is committed, what is queued, what we declined and why — published and current enough that program management and engineering leads both plan against it * Run a single intake path for product requirements from programs, customers, partners, and internal teams, and give every request a scoped, sized answer: accept, defer, or decline, with a reason * Define operator capabilities before design and engineering start — the problem, the workflow, and the acceptance criteria that QA builds integration coverage against * Deconflict competing program demands on shared engineering teams using a written, defensible prioritization framework * Represent EW Mission Applications in the recurring device API review: bring the integration needs, justify the priority, agree the build order with embedded engineering, and track requests through to delivery * Partner with UI design on operator workflows and with QA on test coverage, owning the requirement behind both * Turn recurring field issues from our mission software engineering team into roadmap items and test coverage on a standing cadence * Track delivery commitments against actuals and publish the results, so our estimates improve and our release commitments earn credibility * Brief delivery status, roadmap changes, and risk to stakeholders at every level — engineers, program leadership, and customers — without flattening technical nuance into a status color * Travel up to 25% to support integration events, deployments, osystem — CDRL cycles, ATO processes, and program\-of\-record cadence * Prior experience in defense technology, electronic warfare, command and control, ISR, or RF systems * Experience with geospatial or real\-time visualization software * Experience defining products against a hardware roadmap and an SDK or device API boundary * Experience with edge deployments where systems operate disconnected or in degraded network environments * Experience scaling product processes during a rapid production ramp The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Product Designer, Design Systems
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Design at Anthropic sits at the intersection of craft, research, and product intuition. Design systems is a growing team working on products that millions of people use daily, and on interactions that don't have established conventions yet. Our work shapes how people experience AI: whether Claude feels like a tool or a collaborator, whether it earns trust or erodes it. We partner closely with engineers and researchers, often designing around capabilities that are emerging in real time. That means staying close to the models, prototyping rapidly, and being comfortable with ambiguity. We care deeply about the details that make something feel polished, trustworthy and human. We ship fast and learn in the open. We'd rather get something in front of users and iterate than wait for perfection. The Design Systems team exists to define and elevate the language of our UI and core interactions. Every Claude product, from claude.ai to Claude Code, shares one system, including the guidance Claude itself follows when it generates UI. You would be joining an early\-stage team, working with design engineers and product designers across the company. You may be a good fit if you: * Are as comfortable designing on canvas tools as you are building and prototyping within the product, and prefer to ship in days, not months. * Have worked on design systems that balance simplicity with creative flair to produce beautiful products out of the box. * Care about the smallest details as much as the big picture, from a pixel to how the whole app fits together. * Make the people around you better through sharp, kind feedback and low ego. * Get up to speed quickly and can make an impact on projects already in motion. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and evolve the system, from foundations (colour, type, spacing, icons, tokens, theming) to components like menus, dialogs, sidebars and the chat composer. * Design the expressive layer as a system, not one\-offs: motion, illustration and icons that are brand and system at once. * Make the system legible to Claude as well as people: the guidance, metadata and evals that show whether Claude uses it correctly. * Partner with product teams: help designers and engineers apply the system well, and feed recurring gaps back into the system. * Prototype in code and ship: land changes in the design\-system package alongside engineers, using Claude Code in your own practice. **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Strong visual and interaction craft. * Experience building or working on a design system. * Experience with design tokens, theming and accessibility standards. * Fluency in whichever tool gets an idea across fastest, from Figma to code. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience building products at the highest level of craft. * Has shipped voice or other beyond\-the\-screen work, with native mobile instincts. * Has designed an icon set, illustration style or motion system used across products. * Experience defining evals, lint rules or automated checks for UI quality. * 8\+ years of product design experience. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $305,000 \- $385,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description: Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. AI \& Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS\&T's engine for AI\-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning \- including generative AI \- along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS\&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple. **Description** As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on building intelligent systems to democratize AI across a wide range of solutions within Apple. You will drive the development and deployment of innovative AI models and systems that directly impact the capabilities and performance of Apple’s products and services. You will implement robust, scalable ML infrastructure, including data storage, processing, and model serving components, to support seamless integration of AI/ML models into production environments. You will develop novel feature engineering, data augmentation, prompt engineering and fine\-tuning frameworks that achieve optimal performance on specific tasks and domains. You will design and implement automated ML pipelines for data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, hyper\-parameter tuning, and model evaluation, enabling rapid experimentation and iteration. You will also implement advanced model compression and optimization techniques to reduce the resource footprint of language models while preserving their performance. There are massive opportunities for you deliver impactful influences to Apple. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience in Anomaly detection and forecasting \& related methodologies Experience and proficiency in python \& writing efficient SQLs. Strong coding and software engineering skills, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing, code reviews and deployment. Proven experience with transformer models such as BERT, GPT etc., and a proven understanding of their underlying principles is a plus Data Visualization Tools: Proficient in data visualization, with experience in software such as Superset, Streamlit, Tableau, Business Objects, and Looker **Minimum Qualifications** BS in Computer Science or related field or equivalent. 3\+ years of machine learning engineering experience in feature engineering, model training, model serving, model monitoring and model refresh management. Experience developing AI/ML systems at scale in production or in high\-impact research environments. Passionate about computer vision, natural language processing, especially in LLMs and Generative AI systems. Knowledge with the common frameworks and tools such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data Solutions), AI & Data Platforms (AiDP)
jobs.description: Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world?
