This role requires in\-depth knowledge of innovative technologies and cloud data platform with the ability to independently learn new technologies and contribute to the success of various initiatives. **Preferred Qualifications** 3 or more years of experience building enterprise\-level data applications on distributed systems Hands\-on experience in designing and development of cloud\-based applications that include compute services, database services, APIs to design RESTful services, ETL, queues and notification services. Experience in cloud data warehousing platforms like Snowflake is highly valued Experience developing Big Data applications using Java, Spark, Kafka is a huge plus Understanding of fundamentals of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and problem solving Cloud technology experience on platforms like AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Data Visualization Tools: experience in software such as Streamlit, Superset, Tableau, Business Objects, and Looker Data Insights and KPIs: Working experience on generating and visualizing data insights, metrics, and KPIs. Usage of basic ML models in the space of anomaly detection, forecasting, GenAI. **Minimum Qualifications** Knowledge of BI concepts and implementation experience on Cloud with databases like Snowflake or Big Query Programming experience in building high\-quality software with at\-least one of the following programming languages \- Python, Scala or Java. Experience in developing highly optimized SQLs, procedures \& semantic process for distributed data applications. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Finance Engineering
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless. G\&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS\&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions \- including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G\&A operations across Apple. **Description** Most financial systems record what happened. We are building one that reasons \- where AI agents interpret business intent, validate and enrich transactions, route approvals, match documents, and resolve exceptions, with humans in the loop by policy rather than by default. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the services that make that possible: the transaction pipeline, the sub\-ledger, the orchestration layer, the tool APIs agents call, and the interfaces finance operators use to supervise and correct agent work. You will work across the stack with a backend center of gravity \- the majority of your time in distributed services and data, and real ownership of the APIs and operator\-facing surfaces that sit on top of them. You will work closely with the platform architect and with Finance, Controllership, and Accounts Payable partners. Correctness matters here in a way it doesn't in most systems: the code you write moves money, and it gets audited. ","responsibilities":"Design, build, and operate backend services across the transaction lifecycle \- ingestion, validation, enrichment, matching, approval routing, position tracking, settlement, and reconciliation. Build the tool and function APIs that AI agents act through: clean contracts, structured inputs and outputs, idempotent operations, and safe failure behavior when an agent gets something wrong. Implement agent workflows in production \- graph\-based orchestration, context assembly and retrieval, memory, structured output validation \- and the evaluation harnesses that keep them honest as models and prompts change. Build the operator\-facing surfaces that make agent work reviewable: exception queues, match and approval review, audit trails, and the APIs behind them. Model and evolve the platform's data layer \- canonical transaction documents, event streams, sub\-ledger balances \- with the schema discipline and migration care that financial data demands. Write the business, matching, and accounting logic as versioned configuration rather than hard\-coded branches, so finance teams can change behavior without a deploy. Own correctness in your services: immutable event history, exactly\-once settlement, duplicate detection, reconciliation, and the audit lineage SOX controls depend on. Own your services in production \- instrumentation, alerting, on\-call, and the performance and cost characteristics of what you build. Raise the bar around you: thorough code and design review, tests that catch real defects, clear technical writing, and mentorship of engineers earlier in their careers. **Preferred Qualifications** 6 years experience in API design and implementation, including mastery in RESTful API principles, gRPC, GraphQL, contract\-first design (e.g. OpenAPI/Swagger, Protobuf, etc.), API versioning strategies, gateway patterns, rate limiting, and designing APIs for backward compatibility and long\-term evolution. 6 years experience using relational (e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, etc.) and NoSQL (e.g. Cassandra, MongoDB, etc.) databases, including mastery in schema design, query optimization, performance tuning (e.g. execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, and query rewriting), and understanding of database transaction foundations across systems. 6 years experience with Natural Language Processing and Generative AI systems, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, embedding pipelines, vector databases (e.g. Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.), fine\-tuning, and prompt engineering for production applications. Track record of leading software projects that span multiple, distributed teams as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring senior\-level software engineers. Hands\-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes. Experience with message\-driven and event\-driven architectures, including mastery in messaging systems (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.), event sourcing, CQRS patterns, and designing reliable asynchronous communication between distributed services. Experience with caching strategies and in\-memory data technologies (e.g. Redis, Memcached, Hazelcast, Ehcache, etc.), including mastery in cache invalidation patterns, distributed caching architectures, and session management for high\-throughput applications. Experience with search and indexing technologies (e.g. Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, etc.), including designing search architectures, index optimization, query tuning, and implementing full\-text search for large\-scale datasets. Experience with distributed data orchestration \& computing systems (e.g. Airflow, Spark, Flink, etc.), including designing and managing complex data workflows, batch and real\-time stream processing pipelines, and ensuring data pipeline reliability and fault tolerance at scale. Experience with contract testing and API test automation for microservices architectures, including mastery in consumer\-driven contract testing (e.g. Pact, Spring Cloud Contract, etc.), API validation tools (e.g. REST Assured, Postman, etc.), and strategies for testing asynchronous and event\-driven systems. **Minimum Qualifications** B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience. 8 years experience developing software in a professional capacity. 6 years experience with Java, including mastery in concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization techniques. 8 years working with OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code. 6 years experience building production applications with the Spring ecosystem (e.g. Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, etc.), including mastery in dependency injection, auto\-configuration, reactive programming with WebFlux, and designing microservices using Spring\-based patterns. 6 years experience designing, implementing, and shipping high\-scale, high\-performance, highly available, fault\-tolerant, and secure cloud\-based distributed systems. **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. jobs.title: Founding Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **About Aurora Genesis** Aurora Genesis is an early\-stage startup building Aurora Origins, a personalized simulation platform. Aurora Origins starts with a private profile of how a person's brain and behavior patterns have developed over time, then lets people preview how different future choices might shape who they become. We're pre\-seed and founder\-led, and this hire would be one of our first. **About the Role** We're looking for a Founding Backend Engineer to build the systems and data foundation behind Aurora Origins, especially the Life Choice Simulator. This is a backend\-first role: the front\-end and visual experience are being built by a separate design contractor, so this hire is squarely about backend architecture, data modeling, and the systems that make a computationally complex simulation product reliable. You'll work directly with the founder to turn an ambitious product thesis into a working, dependable system. **What You'll Do** * Build the production foundation: accounts, authentication, data flows, permissions, entitlements, payments, instrumentation, deployment, and release quality. * Design and build the backend and data model for the Life Choice Simulator: state and pressure computation, branch and checkpoint logic, and the interfaces the front end will consume. * Make sound calls on system boundaries, data lineage, privacy, and reliability, and on what belongs in product code versus the scientific engine. * Use AI development tools to move quickly without losing engineering judgment, readable code, or testing discipline. * Work directly with the founder to turn product direction into a staged, shippable sequence. **What We're Looking For** * Real experience designing and shipping production backend systems end to end, including the middle layer between a durable backend and a working interface. * Comfort across APIs, databases, permissions, deployment, and observability. You can own the production foundation yourself. * Comfortable with ambiguity and high context. You bring a point of view rather than waiting for a complete specification. * You treat privacy, consent, and security as engineering requirements, not afterthoughts. This product works with people's personal data. **Nice to Have** * React/TypeScript front\-end familiarity (not required; the front end is being built separately). * Prior experience as an early or founding engineer at a startup. * Comfortable using AI development tools as a core part of how you build day to day. **How to Apply** Send your portfolio or GitHub, using the subject heading 'Founding Backend Engineer' along with a short note on what draws you to this, to hello@auroragenesis.com. Target start is 4 to 5 weeks from an accepted offer. Compensation is discussed in the first screening conversation. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **The** **Opportunity:** ------------------------ **Avantor** is looking for a **Controls Engineer** to work closely with R\&D, Manufacturing, Reliability \& Maintenance Engineering, and Process Engineering to design, build, install, and support control system equipment and upgrades to support NuSil's needs. The Controls Engineer will have a reasonably strong understanding of general aspects of the job functions noted below. They will typically work under the supervision of a Group Leader, or occasionally other senior personnel depending on the task at hand. This is a full\-time onsite position based out of our **Carpinteria, CA** location. Must have ability to travel as needed to other locations (primarily Bakersfield, CA and Irving, TX), possibly 5\-10%. **How you will thrive and create an impact**: * Design electrical schematics, physical electrical enclosure layouts, conduit runs, and PLC/HMI code for new or upgraded equipment, following applicable NFPA, NEC, and other standards. * Designs equipment for regular use in support of NuSil’s production needs. This can include electrical, instrumentation, and controls system design, as well as possibly elements of mechanical design. * Coordinates and works with third\-party vendors and contractors to facilitate and direct equipment builds and installations. * Plan projects that will operate in the short term, medium term and long term, balancing timelines and equipment downtime to minimize disruption to Manufacturing schedule. * Write technical documents to communicate preventative maintenance, operating instructions, control narratives, capital project proposals, etc. * Create or modify technical drawings/models with CAD software in order to properly document equipment and systems. * Assists other engineers to create, use, and determine feasibility of engineering designs to fabricate necessary parts for NuSil equipment. * Source and order necessary parts, raw materials, and tools required for projects. * Assist with troubleshooting equipment when necessary, working closely with Reliability \& Maintenance staff. * Assist other personnel with troubleshooting electrical and control system problems on installed equipment. **What we're looking for:** * **Education:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline required (Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Science preferred); advanced degrees desirable. * **Experience:** * 1 to 3 years of relevant experience. * PLC and HMI Programming experience. * Knowledge of relevant NFPA 70/70E standards, NEC, etc. * Understanding of electrical diagrams/schematics. * Electrical troubleshooting using multimeters, oscilloscopes, etc. * Knowledge of 1\- and 3\-phase AC circuit design \& principles, DC circuit design \& principles, instrument selection, etc. * **Certification/s:** * PE license, PMP certificate, or other relevant certifications desirable. * **Additional Qualifications:** * Proficiency of LabView and other data acquisition and process programs desirable. * Strong focus on safety, communication of technical details and project progress, attention to detail, 2D \& 3D CAD (DraftSight/Solidworks). * Technical document reading and writing ability, time and budget management skills (as part of a larger set of project management skills). * Data\-driven decision making skills, experience with metrology and measurement, engineering calculations, communication of technical details and project progress. * Experienced with Microsoft Office software. * Ability to manage multiple concurrent assignments. * Ability to work in a moderately noisy environment that may not always be climate\-controlled. * Ability to lift and carry 50 lbs. * Ability to work effectively in both a field/hands\-on setting and at a desk when needed. **Disclaimer:** --------------- The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. **Why Avantor?** **Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000\+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life\-changing science. **The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor. We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. jobs.title: Industrial Automation & Technology Innovation Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Position Summary The Industrial Automation \& Technology Innovation Engineer will lead technical exploration, evaluation, and prototype development across advanced control, automation, software, embedded systems, and emerging technology domains. Working with internal teams, universities, research organizations, startups, and technology partners, the engineer will assess feasibility, quantify value, and recommend technologies for future investment and development. Key Responsibilities Control \& Automation Engineering * Develop and evaluate advanced control and automation solutions for industrial and building applications. * Develop control algorithms, system models, and simulation environments. * Analyze system performance and optimize control strategies for reliability, efficiency, and scalability. Software \& Embedded Systems Development * Develop software, firmware, and embedded system prototypes. * Integrate sensors, controllers, communication systems, and data acquisition platforms. * Support implementation, validation, and troubleshooting from early prototypes through applied R\&D demonstrations. Emerging Technology Evaluation \& Innovation * Identify and evaluate emerging technologies in areas such as AI/ML, Industrial IoT, digital twins, advanced sensing, and intelligent automation. * Conduct technical due diligence on startup solutions, research innovations, and external technologies. * Assess feasibility, business relevance, and strategic fit for Azbil’s future technology roadmap. Proof\-of\-Concept \& Innovation Projects * Lead proof\-of\-concept projects that convert promising technologies into validated technical evidence. * Communicate findings, recommendations, and business implications to management and technical stakeholders. Collaboration \& Knowledge Sharing * Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, global R\&D colleagues, and external research or technology partners. * Prepare clear technical documentation, evaluation summaries, and project reports that support decision\-making. * Provide technical leadership and mentoring when appropriate. Requirements: Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred. * Experience in one or more of the following: o Process Control o Industrial Automation o Embedded Systems o Software Development o Modeling and Simulation o Data Analytics / AI o Proof\-of\-Concept Development Preferred Qualifications * Experience with AI/ML, Industrial IoT, digital twins, advanced sensing technologies, or smart building systems. * Experience evaluating emerging technologies, startup solutions, or research projects. * Strong communication and collaboration skills in multidisciplinary environments. Travel Requirements * Occasional domestic and international travel, estimated at 10\-20%, for conferences, technology evaluations, customer visits, partner meetings, and global collaboration. Career Development Opportunities This role provides opportunities to: * Lead high\-impact technology evaluation and innovation initiatives. * Build expertise in next\-generation industrial automation and AI technologies. * Grow toward senior technical leadership, innovation management, or advanced R\&D roles.

jobs.title: Chemical Process Engineer - Capital Projects
jobs.description: **Job Description** What’s it like working for a company that delivers life\-saving products and services to our nation’s military? Humbling. As part of our ordnance systems team, you will be on the forefront of energetics technology and working alongside some of the best industry's top talent. We are currently hiring for an experienced Process Chemical Engineer that can see the big picture to execute capital projects to modernize the plant. Here, we value our workforce, and their well\-being. We prioritize safety, work life balance, and offer competitive benefits. Whether it's a flexible work schedule or career development opportunities, you'll find it with us. Make a difference doing work you can be proud of, challenged, and part of a team that shares a passion of helping to protect our nation. As a Senior Process Chemical Engineer, you will: * Develop new and redline existing Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams and Interlock Narratives * Facilitate and lead improvement projects, maintenance projects, and troubleshooting and startup efforts * Lead and support Process Hazard Analyses for new and existing processes * Troubleshoot process, instrumentation and equipment problems to support manufacturing * Develop Process Flow Diagrams and Heat and Material Balances * Conduct various calculations for process design (i.e. relief, pump sizing, and heat transfer) * Develop cost estimates for new and existing products and / or develop scope of work for capital projects. * Provide field support for startup commissioning activities * Provide field support for I/O, interlock checkout, and preventive maintenance shutdowns * Provide on\-call technical support and interact with customers and suppliers on technical issues * Write, maintain, and update necessary procedures and assist with training operators when needed * Mentor junior Process Chemical Engineers * This role requires regular presence in a manufacturing or fabrication environment. The incumbent must be able to access and safely navigate production areas which may include climbing, kneeling, stooping, and working in confined spaces. The ideal candidate will apply mechanical engineering principles across thermal management, liquid cooling, environmental and structural dynamics, shipboard structural integration, high\-precision kinematics, drive mechanisms, and multi\-disciplinary digital engineering workflows. The engineer will work closely with systems, electrical, RF, software, manufacturing, test, and naval integration teams to deliver rugged, reliable, maintainable hardware for demanding maritime environments. This position includes a mix of office\-based engineering, laboratory integration, supplier coordination, production support, environmental testing, and occasional shipboard or customer\-site activities. The role requires work in controlled test environments and participation in technical reviews with government, prime contractor, supplier, and cross\-functional engineering teams. The successful candidate is a detail\-oriented mechanical engineer who can move efficiently between design, analysis, integration, and test. They are comfortable solving problems at the intersection of thermal performance, structural durability, shipboard constraints, precision motion, maintainability, and digital engineering rigor. They bring practical engineering judgment, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to delivering reliable capabilities for naval aviation operations. jobs.title: Staff Geologist
jobs.description: Description: **Barry Isett \& Associates (Isett)** is an employee\-owned multi\-discipline engineering/consulting firm headquartered in Allentown, PA, with additional offices throughout eastern and central PA. Isett associates get the opportunity to perform meaningful work that helps enrich our community each and every day. Our company is a values\-based organization that has been recognized for its award\-winning culture through several regional and statewide programs: * Best Places to Work in PA (annually since 2019\) * The Morning Call's Top Workplaces (annually since 2013\) * Empowering Women Award by Central Penn Business Journal and Lehigh Valley Business (annually, since 2022\) * Philadelphia Inquirer's Top Workplaces (annually, since 2022\) * Corporate Citizen of the Year (by Lehigh Valley Business) * The Societas Award for Responsible Corporate Conduct (for Ethics) **Benefits** * Career advancement and continuing education opportunities * Employee engagement events and parties * Work\-life balance and flexible working schedules * Paid vacation, holiday, and sick time * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) * Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurances * Discounted and/or free Isett wear * Parental leave * 401(k)/Roth match As a multi\-discipline firm, Isett provides a full range of engineering and consulting services, including civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, environmental, geotechnical, and municipal engineering, surveying, landscape architecture, code enforcement, plan review, construction management, construction materials testing, and grant writing services throughout the Mid\-Atlantic region. Our Environmental Department is seeking a motivated **Staff Geologist** to support a wide variety of public and private sector projects. This position offers the opportunity to work on environmental investigations, geotechnical explorations, construction observation, site redevelopment, due diligence, and permitting assignments across multiple markets. The ideal candidate enjoys a balance of field and office work, possesses strong technical and communication skills, and is eager to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver exceptional results to our clients. As an employee\-owner, you'll play a direct role in our continued success while working alongside industry experts in environmental consulting, geotechnical engineering, and other technical disciplines. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Geology, Environmental Geology, Geological Sciences, Environmental Science, or a related field. * 0 to 5\+ years of relevant environmental and/or geotechnical consulting experience. * Fundamentals of Geology (FG) certification or ability to obtain preferred. * Understanding of geologic principles, subsurface investigations, and environmental sampling methodologies. * Experience with soil classification, geologic mapping, and technical report preparation preferred. * Mapping experience using GIS is a plus. * Familiarity with Pennsylvania DEP regulations and environmental permitting processes is a plus. * Strong organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication abilities. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and technical data management software. * Ability to work outdoors in varying weather and site conditions. * Ability to travel to project sites throughout Pennsylvania and surrounding areas. * Valid driver's license. * Ability to obtain PA Act 34, 114, and 151 Clearances, as required for certain projects.

jobs.description: This role will be part of Bally Media, a Bally's Interactive company, that operates the Bally Sports Live and Stadium sports streaming services. Bally Sports Live reimagines how fans experience live sports through free streaming apps built around real\-time interactive communities, free\-to\-play games, and rewards. Stadium is a free ad\-supported streaming (FAST) sports network distributed through partners including Samsung TV Plus, Amazon Fire TV, Prime Video, LG Channels, Vizio WatchFree\+, Tubi, YouTube TV, DirecTV, and Fubo. Together, the two platforms bring fans live events and re\-airs from Minor League Baseball, the Savannah Bananas, Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship, Bare Knuckle Boxing, Pro Fighters League, AVP Pro Beach Volleyball, and more. We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to drive the modernization, scalability, and reliability of our infrastructure across AWS and on\-prem environments. Reporting to the Director, Platform Engineering, you'll work closely with software engineers, broadcast engineers, and product managers to evolve our cloud\-first, AI\-enabled DevOps practice. You'll contribute to critical projects improving CI/CD across our backend, web, mobile, and CTV apps, strengthening observability and incident response, and aligning processes across teams and platforms. This is a hands\-on role for someone who owns problems end to end, collaborates openly, brings a calm, reliability\-first mindset to incidents, and is always looking to automate toil and improve how we build and operate. You'll thrive here if you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping architecture, and building robust, maintainable systems at scale. Responsibilties: * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design and implement robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure in AWS * Develop and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform and Ansible * Contribute to improvements in system architecture, focusing on reliability, observability, and cost\-efficiency * Modernize our CI/CD practices, including the adoption of AI\-assisted tooling, to enable safe, rapid delivery of services across environments * Improve operational visibility through monitoring, logging, and tracing, applying AIOps approaches to anomaly detection and incident response. * Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and design reviews * Align DevOps tooling and processes across teams, promoting platform consistency and best practices * On\-call rotation and coverage during live events, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed to support broadcast reliability and incident response. Salary: $100,000\-$145,000 USD \#LI\-OP1 #### **Experience** Preferred* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 2–5 years of hands\-on DevOps or platform engineering experience, with a focus on cloud infrastructure * Experience with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, RDS, ALB, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, CloudWatch) * Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, Ansible), including reusable modules and remote state management * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines * Experience with observability and incident\-response tooling (Datadog, PagerDuty, or similar) * Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and distributed architectures * Experience operating systems at scale across multiple environments and AWS accounts * Experience with containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, ArgoCD, or similar) * Scripting or programming proficiency (Bash, Python, Go) * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation, including evenings, weekends, and holidays during live events Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. Storybook. * Integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL services to create seamless, data\-driven user experiences. * Deliver simple, scalable solutions that enable rapid iteration, experimentation, and jobs.title: Staff Android Software Engineer, Cash App Consumer Platform
jobs.description: It all started with an idea at Block in 2013\. Initially built to take the pain out of peer\-to\-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50\+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible. Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy. ### **The Team** The Cash App Consumer Platform is responsible for laying the foundation that every Cash App engineer builds on. We own the shared systems, abstractions, and tooling that power product development across the app. We sit at the product platform layer, building on top of core systems enabling feature development. Our customers are the engineers and teams building Cash App's product experiences, and we measure our success by their velocity and quality. As AI fundamentally reshapes software engineering, Cash’s Consumer Platform is uniquely positioned to define what AI\-native development looks like at Cash App and Block, both by building AI\-powered capabilities into our platform and by establishing the practices that help hundreds of engineers leverage AI effectively every day. ### **The Job** As a Staff Android Engineer on Cash App Consumer Platform, you are a multiplier for the entire client engineering discipline. You think in systems. You spot problems before they have names. You create platforms and patterns that make the right thing easy and the wrong thing hard. You operate at an organizational scope. Your work shapes how hundreds of Builders build and how millions of customers experience Cash App. You don't wait to be handed a problem \- you identify what needs to exist, build the case for it, and lead the work to completion. You bring deep Android expertise and a genuine conviction that AI is a transformative force in how we build software, and you act accordingly. This role reports to the Cash App Product Platform Lead. ### **You Will** Build and Own the Android Platform * Own and evolve foundational Android infrastructure: modularization, dependency injection, navigation, deep linking, and app lifecycle systems * Design and deliver shared libraries and frameworks that feature teams rely on daily with developer and AI ergonomics as a first\-class concern * Drive Cash App's Android architecture forward, making high\-leverage decisions that compound over time * Invent thoughtful Android platform tech and open source it where it creates value for the broader community * Develop and steward rapid experimentation in support of the fast iteration enabled by the AI world * Build upon observability and performance tooling that gives engineers and on\-callers clarity and confidence * Partner with iOS, Web, and backend engineers to deliver consistent, high\-quality cross\-platform experiences Lead as an AI\-Native Engineer * Evolve how Cash App's Android engineering org uses AI * Proactively identify where AI creates real leverage in platform and product engineering workflows, and act on it * Introduce and evaluate emerging AI development tools (Claude Code, GPT/Codex, Goose, and what comes next), forming a clear point of view on adoption * Build AI\-powered capabilities into the platform itself where they create durable value for product teams Drive Organizational Impact * Operate beyond your immediate team. Identify cross\-cutting technical problems across Cash App's Android org and mobilize the resources to address them * Surface unknown risks and systemic issues before they become customer problems or engineering crises * Lead architecture and design reviews across team boundaries \- help set standards that scale * Mentor and grow engineers at all levels, raising the technical ceiling of the Android community at Cash App Collaborate Broadly * Partner with engineers, product managers, and designers across Cash App to align platform investments with what teams actually need * Represent Android platform needs in cross\-functional, cross\-org, and Block\-wide technical discussions * Communicate complex technical tradeoffs with clarity to engineers, product partners, and leadership alike ### **You Have** * Platform or infrastructure builder's mindset. You've built systems for engineers as your customers, and you care deeply about developer experience * A high agency mindset \- if you see a problem you take the initiative to find a solution * 10\+ years of Android development experience with a demonstr perimentation infrastructure, feature flagging, or A/B testing at scale * A track record of identifying and naming problems that weren't yet on anyone's roadmap ### **Technologies we use and teach** * Kotlin, including Kotlin Multiplatform * Jetpack Compose, Molecule, WorkManager, Structured Concurrency * CI/CD: Buildkite, Kochiku, Artifactory * Tooling: Gradle, custom Gradle Plugins, SQLDelight, Wire, Paparazzi * AI\-powered developer tools: Codex, Claude Code, Goose ### **What Makes This Role Special** * Foundational scope: Your work is the ground other engineers build on. When you move the platform forward, every Cash App engineer benefits and so do millions of customers. * AI\-forward by design: We're building the practices and systems to stay ahead of how AI is reshaping software engineering. You'll shape what that looks like at Cash App. * Real organizational authority: At Block, you have the latitude to identify problems, set direction, and drive change across a large, ambitious engineering organization. * Mission that matters: Everything we build serves Cash App's mission of economic empowerment for people who've historically been left out of the financial system. We're working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. jobs.description: Available in 4 locationsAvailable in 4 locations See allSee all **Chief Product Engineer \- Audio Technology** ---------------------------------------------- Available in 4 locations Remote, Massachusetts, United States of America Framingham, Massachusetts, United States of America Bloomfield Hills, Michigan, United States of America Troy, Michigan, United States of America Category: Engineering Job ID: R29230 Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A Posted Date: September 21st 2026 widget: Full time **Description** --------------- At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. **Job Description** =================== The **Chief Product Engineer** serves as the top technical leader responsible for aligning product engineering with product, intellectual property (IP) and licensing strategies. This role bridges core research and development (R\&D) with external commercialization, ensuring that engineered systems are modular, documented, and legally robust for third\-party adoption or joint ventures. As the principal technical architect responsible for the creation, protection, and commercial transfer of our proprietary **consumer audio and hearables technology**. You will ensure that our patented algorithms, hardware / software architectures, and software stacks (e.g., ANC, spatial audio, voice pickup, wireless connectivity) are packaged into robust, modular, and easily integrable Reference Designs or Intellectual Property (IP) blocks for third\-party consumer electronics brands and ODMs. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Licensing Architecture Strategy:** Define and design the technical boundaries of our licensing portfolio (IP blocks, SDKs, reference hardware). Ensure audio technologies are modular and seamlessly integrate into diverse host chipsets (Qualcomm, Bestechnic, MediaTek, etc.). * **DSP Platform Integration:** Oversee the optimization and integration of audio code libraries across leading wireless audio SoC and DSP platforms (e.g. Cadence Tensilica HiFi DSPs etc.). * **Technical Package Delivery:** Oversee the development of comprehensive Technical Data Packages (TDPs). This includes golden reference designs, tuning tools and software, comprehensive SDKs, APIs and bit\-exact reference models, acoustic design guidelines, DSP code libraries, and documentation for licensee onboarding. * **Tuning \& Tooling Development:** Champion the creation of developer\-facing software tools and GUI\-based tuning utilities that empower licensees to calibrate ANC, EQ, and spatial audio parameters to their specific acoustic hardware. * **Partner Evaluation \& Integration Support:** Act as the primary technical authority during licensing evaluations. Provide deep\-dive technical support, reference tuning, and architectural reviews for tier\-1 consumer electronics licensees and manufacturing partners (ODMs). * **IP Protection \& Compliance:** Partner with the Legal and IP teams to identify patentable innovations in hardware, firmware, and acoustic architectures. Develop technical validation methodologies and tools to audit and verify licensee compliance. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Mentor a highly specialized team of audio, DSP, firmware, and hardware engineers, steering their R\&D output toward scalable, high\-margin licensing platforms rather than single bespoke products. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * **Experience:** 12\+ years in consumer audio, acoustics, or hearables product development (e.g., TWS earbuds, smart headphones, spatial audio systems), with a heavy emphasis on embedded software and DSP algorithm development. At least 4 years managing software IP delivery, technical transfers, or external licensing integrations. * **Algorithm \& DSP Mastery:** Deep expertise in developing and optimizing real\-time audio processing software. This includes fixed\-point math optimization, assembly\-level vectorization (e.g., NEON, Tensilica instruction extensions), and low\-latency scheduling. * **Domain Expertise:** Domain mastery over core hearable software pillars: Active Noise Cancellation (ANC/biquad design), Spatial Audio/HRTF, Echo Cancellation (AEC), Wind Noise Reduction, and Machine Learning\-based Voice Pickup (VPU). Deep understanding of Bluetooth LE Audio/Auracast, microphone arrays (beamforming), and audio codecs (LC3, LDAC, aptX). * **Systems \& Standards:** Strong fluency in C/C\+\+, Python (for modeling), real\-time operating systems (RTOS), Bluetooth LE Audio pipelines, Auracast, and standard audio codecs (LC3, AAC, LDAC). * **Hardware \& Acoustic Context:** Solid understanding of how software interacts with physical acoustic constraints, including microphone array geometries, transducer frequency responses, and ADC/DAC latency paths. * **Communication \& Negotiation Support:** Exceptional ability to present highly complex acoustic and software concepts to non\-technical business stakeholders, IP attorneys, and external executive teams. * **Education:** Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Acoustical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Bridgeway is seeking an AI Engineer to help build and operate large language model and intelligent automation capabilities across our products and internal tooling. The AI Engineer will implement production systems against the patterns and reference implementations set by our architecture team, contribute to design discussions, and partner with senior engineers to ship reliable AI\-enabled features. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused primarily on building. We are seeking a technically curious individual who brings solid Python experience and a pragmatic approach to AI\-enabled capabilities. A successful AI Engineer is a strong builder with a growing background in production software development and the kind of engineering judgment that turns architectural patterns into reliable working systems. This is a remote position with preference given to East Coast candidates. **Responsibilities:** * Contribute to the technical direction for AI\-enabled systems at Bridgeway, in partnership with senior engineers and the architecture team. * Participate in design reviews for AI\-adjacent features and incorporate feedback from senior engineers and architects. * Build production\-quality Python services, pipelines, and integrations that apply LLMs and retrieval to concrete internal and product problems. * Integrate LLM APIs into existing systems, following established guidance on model selection, cost profile, and failure\-handling for each use case. * Ensure AI capabilities correctly honor schema\-per\-tenant and PHI\-boundary patterns within our multi\-tenant model, partnering with the data team that owns those patterns. * Partner with the data and analytics team to integrate retrieval\- and LLM\-backed features into the lakehouse and analytics layer — embedding and chunking choices, retrieval evaluation, semantic search, summarization, anomaly narration, and contextual guidance for fund office users — with the data team owning pipeline build and operation. * Contribute to prompt libraries, evaluation frameworks, reference implementations, and reusable components that help engineers ship AI\-touching features consistently and safely; follow and help refine development standards for model selection, evaluation, testing, observability, and cost management. * Help evaluate emerging AI tools and provide input on build\-vs\-buy decisions anchored in Bridgeway's technical, cost, and compliance context. * Build AI implementations that comply with HIPAA, SOC 2, and NIST — with particular attention to PHI handling, data residency, audit logging, and BAA coverage — and work with information security to apply AI\-specific controls including prompt\-injection defenses, DLP for LLM interactions, model access governance, and secrets handling. * Maintain documentation of AI systems, data flows, and risk assessments sufficient for audit and compliance review. * Collaborate with engineering, product, customer success, security, data, and operations to identify automation opportunities, help translate them into technical plans, and contribute to the roadmap for future customer\-facing AI capabilities. * Participate in the operational quality and on\-call rotation for AI systems — including incident response, post\-incident learning, and instrumented observability — and help build feedback loops from users to continuously refine retrieval quality, prompt behavior, and agent reliability. * Track cost, quality, and adoption metrics for AI systems in production and report outcomes to your manager, the architecture team, and the team leads. * Apply best practices in enterprise AI\-integration and share knowledge with peers. **Qualifications:** * 3–5 years of software engineering experience, with at least one year working on AI\- or ML\-backed systems, including contributions to at least one LLM\-backed system in production. * Working knowledge of programmatic LLM orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and agent and tool\-using systems, including exposure to securely connecting enterprise APIs to agentic systems. * Strong Python skills for production services, data pipelines, and integration work. * Experience building retrieval\-augmented systems including familiarity with enterprise data architectures such as Databricks and Azure/AWS. * Strong written and verbal communication. * Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and MLOps practices for AI/ML systems. * Experience using generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve productivity and deliver high\-quality outcomes * Production experience in a regulated industry, with practical familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, or NIST, and with multi\-tenant SaaS data isolation and identity/access patterns for B2B platforms (preferred). * Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. Bridgeway is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Applied AI Inference Engineer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role** You will spend your time making large language models run faster, cheaper, and more reliably in production. That means owning the inference stack end to end: profiling where time and cost go, bringing modern optimization techniques into real deployments, and getting deep into the serving code when the defaults are not good enough. This is core systems and performance work on some of the most demanding models in use today. The work is applied, not academic. The optimizations you build land in real customer deployments, each with its own models, traffic patterns, latency targets, and cost constraints. So while performance is the heart of the role, you will also work directly with customer engineering teams to tailor deployments to their needs, take a workload from an early proof of concept to a fully monitored production service, and make sure the gains you engineer actually show up for the people running the workload. To set expectations clearly, this is a hands\-on engineering role built around coding, profiling, and low\-level optimization. It also carries a customer\-facing side, along with elements of product and technical solutions work, because that is where the performance work gets proven. **What You'll Be Working On:** * Bring current inference techniques into production and refine them. * Design and optimize serving architectures, including prefill and decode disaggregation, request routing, and related approaches. * Work down into the serving stack, from frameworks like vLLM and SGLang to the CUDA kernels underneath, profiling and running in\-depth analysis to find and fix performance problems. * Adapt and scale optimization methods across many kinds of ML models, with an emphasis on large language models. * Profile and tune deployments against clear targets for latency, throughput, and cost, and keep them dependable under real traffic. * Tailor deployments to each customer's models and constraints, partnering with their engineering teams to move a workload from an early proof of concept through to a live, well\-monitored production service. * Build and support the software and product features around the inference stack in a production setting, using one or more general\-purpose languages, with Python preferred given how central it is to ML work. * Experiment quickly: take fuzzy goals, shape them into clear specs and focused proofs of concept, run fast experiments to find what works, and ship well\-tested results without delay. * Own delivery end to end, from the first experiment through to the optimization running in production, keeping the underlying performance goals, clear specs, and follow\-through front of mind, and drafting features and product requirement documents together with other engineering and product teams. * Work through ambiguity and make sound calls on tradeoffs and tooling, steering away from complexity that is not needed. * Take real pride and ownership in your work, hold yourself accountable, and look for the same from the people around you. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * A Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. * Hands\-on experience shipping code in production with one or more general\-purpose languages, such as Python or C\+\+, with a strong preference for Python. * Familiarity with methods for optimizing LLMs for high throughput / low latency inference. * Comfort with modern LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang, and with profiling and analyzing performance down to the kernel level. * A firm grasp of how GPUs are built and how they behave. * Clear interest and hands\-on experience with large language models. * A working knowledge of AI/ML pipelines and the full path of developing and deploying ML models. * Strong communication skills, particularly when explaining hard technical topics to customers and teammates. **Bonus points:** * A track record of making software systems run faster, especially for large language models. * Experience with CUDA or comparable technologies. * A strong command of software engineering fundamentals, with a record of building and shipping AI/ML inference systems. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. * Prior work building or tuning AI/ML projects, particularly in a customer\-facing setting. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $250,000 \- $300,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Software Engineering Manager, GTI Team Lead** **Monday – Friday 8:00 – 5:00** **Remote** Corptax is the platform behind corporate tax for many of the largest enterprises in the world. Global Tax and Regulatory Intelligence (GTI) is the product that tracks tax and regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, models them as workflows, and tells our clients what is due, where, and when. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the GTI engineering team. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will run the team, own delivery, and stay close to the code. Your architecture calls and your code reviews carry real weight. You will report to the Head of AI and work alongside product, design, and tax content on everything GTI ships. **Some of the things you will be doing:** * **The team.** You will run one\-on\-ones, set growth plans, give direct feedback, handle performance, and hiring decisions. * **Delivery.** You will work with product to turn the roadmap into releases the team can land, and you will be accountable for the dates you agree upon. * **Technical direction.** You will make and document the architecture decisions across the frontend, the backend services, the database, and the Azure footprint. * **Code quality.** You will review pull requests, set the bar for testing, and contribute code on the novel problems we encounter daily. * **The release process.** GTI ships from a multi\-service repository with release tagging, release candidates, changelog gates, and merge\-back rules. You will own that process and keep it “boring” and stable. * **Production health.** You will own on\-call, alert routing, and the observability stack. You will be the person who asks why an incident happened and makes sure it never happens again. * **Hands\-on work.** You will definitely write code, enough of it to keep your judgment current, though it will not fill most of your week. **The Stack:** GTI has a small number of moving parts, and you should be comfortable in all of them. * **Frontend:** Next.js and TypeScript, with a shared React component library. * **Backend:** .NET and C\# services behind the product APIs. * **Data:** Microsoft SQL Server, including schema design, migrations, and query tuning. * **Hosting:** Azure Container Apps, with Key Vault, Container Registry, managed identities, and private endpoints around it. * **Delivery:** GitHub Actions for CI/CD, Bicep for infrastructure, and Linear for planning. * **Telemetry:** Application Insights for tracing and PostHog for product analytics. **What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?** **Required** * Experience building and shipping production software, including leading a team as a manager or a technical lead. * Hands\-on depth in C\# and .NET, including API design, async work, and testing. * Hands\-on depth in modern TypeScript and React, with Next.js experience preferred. * SQL Server skills: schema design, indexing, reading query plans, and running migrations against live data. * Production experience with containerized workloads on Azure. * A track record of shipping on a schedule in an Agile work environment. * Clear written communication. You can write a design document, an incident review, and a performance review, and all three land. **Nice to Have** * Infrastructure as code with Bicep, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions. * Experience with observability tooling such as Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, or PostHog. * Experience leading a team through an agent\-led development workflow with tools such as Claude Code. * Experience shipping LLM\-backed features into production. * Background in tax, accounting, law, or another rule\-governed domain. We can teach the domain, and it is a head start if you already have it. * Experience hiring and onboarding engineers. **What you get out of this:** * A funded product with real regulatory stakes. * A small team you can shape, with enough room to change how it works. * Direct access to the Head of AI and to the AI research feeding into GTI. * The budget and infrastructure to do the job properly, including model APIs and Azure capacity. * Competitive compensation and a flexible remote setup. Tax compliance is unforgiving. A wrong obligation date or a missed filing is a real problem for a real client, so the bar for correctness is high and the surface area keeps growing. We need someone who can hold that bar while still shipping on a schedule, and who can drive a team that holds it without being watched. If that sounds like the kind of team you want to run, apply! \#CSC \#CSCCareers \#CorporateTax \#LI\-HL1

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** ==================== CVS Health is seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering to join the Enterprise Observability Platform organization and help advance the next generation of observability, infrastructure, and security data capabilities. reliability, and maintainability of the platform and team. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** ============================ * Design, build, deploy, and support scalable Databricks\-based data pipelines and lakehouse solutions that ingest, transform, and curate observability, infrastructure, and security data from multiple enterprise sources. * Develop and optimize PySpark workloads, Structured Streaming jobs, and bronze/silver/gold data architectures while ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, data quality, and operational excellence. * Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Observability, and Platform Engineering teams to onboard new data sources, establish governance standards, improve metadata management, and deliver trusted enterprise data products. * Contribute to operational risks. * Support the ongoing evolution of the enterprise observability lakehouse by promoting best practices for Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data governance, security controls, access management, and cost\-efficient data platform operations. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** =========================== * 5\+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise data engineering solutions using Python, Spark, PySpark, SQL, and distributed data processing technologies. * 5\+ years of experience designing, developing, and operating large\-scale data pipelines, data ingestion frameworks, and bronze/silver/gold lakehouse architectures across multiple data sources. * 4\+ years of experience working with Databricks in production environments, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Asset Bundles, serverless SQL, performance optimization, and platform operations. * 3\+ years of experience developing high\-volume batch and streaming data solutions, implementing data quality controls, troubleshooting pipeline issues, and improving reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. * 2\+ years of experience collaborating with engineering teams, participating in code reviews, contributing to technical standards, applying cloud security and access management principles, and communicating technical solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Experience building Structured Streaming and near real\-time ingestion solutions within Databricks or similar cloud\-native analytics platforms in large\-scale enterprise environments. **EDUCATION** ============= Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or equivalent work experience (High School Diploma/GED plus 4 years of relevant experience). **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** ===================== Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health**.** This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric healthcare for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make healthcare more personal, convenient, and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging every day. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. **Location** ------------ This is a hybrid role based across multiple locations \- Atlanta, Nashville, Chicago, Dallas, New Jersey **About the job you're considering** ------------------------------------ The Capgemini team offers extensive career opportunities and provides mentoring and coaching for teammates. This role is an experienced professional with a strong background in software development. **Your role** ------------- * As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in Applied AI, you are the 'Agent Engineer' and the primary driver for our customers' most critical AI initiatives. * Take initial conversational prototypes and transform them into production\-ready solutions, owning the end\-to\-end engineering lifecycle, including the transition from 'Art of the Possible' to real\-world business value and scalable, secure AI systems. * This is a high\-travel, high\-impact role focused on leading technical delivery for Conversational AI pilots and establishing the first Customer User Journeys (CUJs) for our largest customers at their sites. * Deep understanding of software engineering, Machine Learning Operations, and cloud infrastructure. * Build high\-performance evaluation (Eval) pipelines and observability frameworks to optimize complex agentic workloads, focusing on reasoning loops, tool selection, and reducing latency while maintaining production\-grade security and networking. * Identify repeatable field patterns and technical 'friction points' in Google's AAI stack, converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for Engineering teams. * Co\-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google\-grade development best practices, ensuring long\-term project success and high end\-user adoption **Your skills and experience** ------------------------------ * 10 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages. * Serve as the lead developer for complex Conversational AI and CX applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production\-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi\-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable ROI. * Architect and code conversational flows that are not just functional, but optimized for the 'connective tissue' between Google's Conversational AI products and customers' live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters. * Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP). * Experience deploying resources via Terraform or similar tools to automate the setup of agents, functions, or networking. * Experience building full\-stack applications that interact with enterprise IT infrastructures and developing external customer projects. * Experience implementing multi\-agent systems using frameworks like ReAct and self\-reflection. * Experience debugging Agent logic and optimizing tool selection, including tracing conversation IDs across microservices to identify and resolve failures in real\-time. * Experience connecting agents to enterprise knowledge bases and optimizing RAG chunking to prevent hallucinations. \#LI\-RM1 \- Hybrid The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $88,544 \- $207,401 Capgemini provides compensation range information in accordance with applicable national, state, provincial, and local pay transparency laws. The base compensation range listed for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Capgemini, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. jobs.title: Threat Detection Engineer
jobs.description: New York, NY, United States (On\-site) Contract (2 months 27 days) Published 5 hours ago Observability \& Reliability Threat detection backend development Security Operations security monitoring AI Frameworks SIEM Technologies cloud security The Threat Detection Engineer will develop and enhance enterprise threat detection capabilities across security monitoring platforms. This role will focus on creating advanced detection logic, threat hunting, incident identification, security analytics, and monitoring of both traditional and AI\-enabled environments. The engineer will work closely with SOC, cyber defense, and threat intelligence teams to improve detection coverage and reduce organizational cyber risk. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop and tune SIEM detection use cases and correlation rules. * Perform proactive threat hunting and behavioral analytics. * Create and maintain security monitoring content. * Investigate emerging threats and map detections to MITRE ATT\&CK. * Improve detection coverage for cloud, endpoint, and network environments. * Build automated response workflows and security analytics dashboards. * Support detection strategies for AI, GenAI, and LLM\-based technologies. **Key Responsibilities:** AI / Agentic Systems Development * Design and implement agentic workflows (ReAct, multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-augmented agents) * Build autonomous or semi\-autonomous AI agents to handle development, testing, and operational workflows * Integrate agents with enterprise systems (Jira, Git, ServiceNow, APIs, etc.) RAG \& Knowledge: * Build and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines * Work with vector databases, embeddings, document chunking, indexing, retrieval tuning * Enable enterprise knowledge use cases (e.g., FAQ bots, nuggets/knowledge artifacts, AI copilots) Implement evaluation frameworks for LLMs: * Functional correctness * Response quality * Hallucination detection * Experience with AI testing frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, custom evaluation harnesses) * Build scalable APIs/services (FastAPI, Flask, etc.) * Ensure performance, observability, and reliability of AI systems **Primary Skills:** * Threat Detection Engineering (SIEM/EDR) * Splunk \& Security Analytics * Threat Hunting \& Incident Response **Secondary Skills:** * Security Automation (SOAR) * AI Security \& GenAI Monitoring **Experience**: * 7\+ years of cybersecurity and security operations experience. * Hands\-on experience with Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, or similar SIEM tools. * Experience building detection content and threat\-hunting methodologies. * Familiarity with cloud security, EDR technologies, and MITRE ATT\&CK framework. The pay range that the employer in good faith reasonably expects to pay for this position is $49\.93/hour \- $78\.01/hour. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis. *Tundra Technical Solutions is among North America’s leading providers of Staffing and Consulting Services. Our success and our clients’ success are built on a foundation of service excellence. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Unincorporated LA County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: client provided property, including hardware (both of which may include data) entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all portable client computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon completion of the assignment, and; maintain the confidentiality of client proprietary, confidential, or non\-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected client information technology systems and related data security obligations.*
