jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, EDGE Discovery
jobs.description: **About Crunchyroll** --------------------- Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super\-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200\+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in\-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love. Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime! **About the role** ------------------ The EDGE Discovery team at Crunchyroll is focused on powering content discoverability experiences across the platform. We build and evolve the backend systems that enable anime fans worldwide to seamlessly discover, browse, search, and engage with Crunchyroll’s catalog through personalized, highly scalable experiences. Our systems power critical user journeys, including home page personalization, search, recommendations, metadata delivery, content ranking, and discovery APIs across all Crunchyroll platforms and devices. We operate at the intersection of backend platform engineering, large\-scale distributed systems, and machine\-learning enablement, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, relevance, and reliability. As a Backend Senior Engineer, you will help drive the technical direction and architecture of the services that power Crunchyroll’s discovery ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, product, data, and machine learning teams to build highly scalable backend platforms that improve content discoverability and user engagement while enabling teams to iterate quickly and safely. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges in distributed systems, scaling high\-traffic backend services, and building systems that directly impact how millions of users discover and experience content. Experience building backend systems for large\-scale streaming, media, or other consumer content platforms is strongly preferred for this role. **What You Will Be Doing** -------------------------- * Design, develop, and evolve scalable backend systems that power search, recommendations, personalization, and content discovery experiences across Crunchyroll platforms * Lead architectural decisions for distributed systems with a focus on scalability, low latency, resiliency, observability, and operational excellence * Build and optimize APIs, metadata services, indexing pipelines, ranking systems, and recommendation infrastructure that support high\-throughput user experiences * Partner closely with product, machine learning, data, and platform teams to improve discovery relevance, personalization quality, and experimentation capabilities * Drive backend platform improvements that enhance developer productivity, deployment safety, and service reliability * Define and implement engineering best practices around API design, data consistency, caching strategies, asynchronous processing, resiliency, and monitoring * Identify and proactively address performance bottlenecks, scaling challenges, and operational risks across discovery systems * Support experimentation and A/B testing frameworks that enable rapid iteration on discovery and recommendation experiences * Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership through design reviews, architecture discussions, and cross\-team collaboration * Influence long\-term technical direction and build alignment across multiple engineering organizations * Champion engineering excellence through pragmatic improvements to tooling, automation, documentation, and operational workflows **About You** ------------- We are looking for a highly motivated engineer with deep backend engineering expertise and a strong track record of building scalable distributed systems. To be successful in this role, you should have: * 8\+ years of experience designing and building large\-scale backend systems and microservices architectures * Strong proficiency in backend development, distributed systems design, API architecture, and cloud\-native technologies * Experience operating high\-traffic services in production environments with strong understanding of scalability, fault tolerance, observability, and reliability engineering principles * Strong experience with large\-scale video streaming, media, or consumer content platforms, including an understanding of the performance, reliability, and scale requirements of streaming user experiences * Experience with search systems, recommendation platforms, personalization systems, metadata services, or large\-scale content delivery architectures, preferably in a streaming environment * Strong understanding of caching strategies, asynchronous processing, event\-driven architectures, and distributed data consistency patterns * Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms, including modern infrastructure and deployment patterns * Familiarity with experimentation platforms, analytics effectively across engineering, product, platform, and data organizations * Ability to influence technical direction and drive alignment in highly cross\-functional environments * Strong sense of ownership and empathy for both internal engineering teams and end\-user experience **About the Team** ------------------ The EDGE Discovery team is responsible for the backend systems and platform capabilities that power content discovery across Crunchyroll. We enable personalized and scalable user experiences through search, recommendations, metadata services, ranking systems, and discovery APIs, helping fans connect with the content they love. Our team focuses on building resilient, scalable, and high\-performance backend services that support millions of users globally in a rapidly evolving content ecosystem. We value ownership, collaboration, experimentation, and continuous improvement while working closely with cross\-functional partners to shape the future of content discovery at Crunchyroll. **Why you will love working at Crunchyroll** -------------------------------------------- In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks: * Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually. * Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self. * Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance * Health Saving Account HSA program * Health care and dependent care FSA * 401(k) plan, with employer match * Employer paid commuter benefit * Support program for new parents * Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly! \#LifeAtCrunchyroll \#LI\-Hybrid The Pay Range for this position is listed. Actual pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Crunchyroll’s Total Rewards offerings for employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time\-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks. Pay Transparency \- San Francisco, CA $203,400 \- $235,000 USD ### **About our Values** We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value * Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. * Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding. * Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress. * Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others. ### **Our commitment to diversity and inclusion** Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity \& inclusion. It's just the way we do business. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US\-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo\-based Sony Group Corporation. *Questions about Crunchyroll’s hiring process? Please check out our Hiring FAQs:* *https://help.crunchyroll.com/hc/en\-us/articles/360040471712\-Crunchyroll\-Hiring\-FAQs* *Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information about how we process your personal information, and your data protection rights:* *https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/22978/v1\_0/docs/spe\-jobs\-privacy\-policy\-update\-for\-crpa\-dec\-21\-22\.pdf* Please beware of recent scams to online job seekers. Those applying to our job openings will only be contacted directly from @crunchyroll.com email account.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Bethlehem, PA **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site Cybel is a leading photonic company based in Bethlehem, PA, specializing in the design and fabrication of fiber lasers and fiber amplifiers for different industries/fields, operating in various optical bandwidths. Cybel offers efficient and reliable OEM products for both CW and pulsed applications, with outstanding performance delivered through different platforms. Additionally, Cybel is the distributor of renowned photonic companies providing innovative products with stellar performance. **About the Role:** Cybel is looking for an **Entry\-Level Electrical Engineer** to join our engineering team. This is a hands\-on position ideal for a recent graduate or early\-career engineer who wants to develop practical experience, with opportunities to take on additional technical responsibilities as their skills and experience grow. At Cybel, engineers work closely across electronics, firmware, software, optics, and mechanical systems. We are looking for someone who is curious, adaptable, and eager to learn, contribute ideas, and gradually take ownership of engineering projects. **Responsibilities:** * Perform electrical testing, validation, and troubleshooting of electronic boards and electro\-optical systems. * Support production, assembly, testing, and qualification of Cybel products. * Analyze test results, identify issues, and assist with root\-cause investigation. * Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, signal generators, and spectrum analyzers. * Assist with PCB schematic design, layout, prototyping, and board revisions. * Assist with system integration involving electronics, firmware, optics, and mechanical components. * Document test procedures, results, engineering changes, and technical findings. * Collaborate with electrical, optical, mechanical, firmware, software, and production teams. * Participate in continuous improvement of testing and production processes. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in **Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a closely related field**. * Strong understanding of fundamental analog and digital electronics. * Familiarity with electronic laboratory equipment. * Basic understanding of schematic capture and PCB design. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Ability and willingness to perform hands\-on laboratory and production work. * Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team. * Willingness to learn new technologies and take on different engineering challenges. Experience in any of the following is a plus, but **not required**: * PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad, OrCAD, or similar. * Circuit simulation tools such as LTspice or similar. * Microcontrollers and embedded systems. * Manufacturing or production environments. * Photonics, lasers, or optical systems. This position offers the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across the complete engineering lifecycle from **design and prototyping to testing, troubleshooting, production, and system integration**. You will have the opportunity to contribute to real products while developing skills in electronics, PCB design, embedded systems, and photonic technologies. Pay: $30,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE - Digital Native Business
jobs.description: **CSQ427R137** **Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE \- Digital Native Business** ============================================================= **About the Team** ------------------ The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C\-suite\-sponsored, high\-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering *outcomes*, not just a platform. You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production\-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how." **Role Description** -------------------- As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi\-million\-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption. You will build C\-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production. This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands\-on delivery mindset. **The impact you will have** ---------------------------- * **C\-Suite Scoping \& Value Definition:** Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M\+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline. * **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands\-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against. * **Technical Solution Leadership** **\& Delivery:** Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C\-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure\-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early. * **Solution Launch \& Landing:** Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution. * **Strategic Handoff \& Growth:** Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high\-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering. **What we look for** -------------------- * **Executive Presence \& Communication:** You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions. * **Product Judgment \& Delivery:** You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome. * **Technical Fluency \& Architecture Judgment:** You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade\-offs, and pressure\-test technical decisions. * **Hands\-on Technical Ability:** You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting. * **Relevant Experience:** Typically 7\+ years of experience delivering complex, customer\-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high\-growth technology company, forward\-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25\-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery. **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. Zone 1 Pay Range $219,765—$302,220 USD **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. **Benefits** At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. **Compliance** **If access to export\-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**

As the first line of response, the Network Associate handles device setup, software installs, account changes, and common hardware or connectivity issues. Network Associate ensure staff remain productive by providing fast, reliable, and approachable support, while also maintaining accurate documentation and escalating more complex problems to senior engineers when necessary. This role is ideal for IT professionals early in their careers who are eager to build technical depth, gain exposure to enterprise IT environments, and grow into more advanced consulting roles. **Why Dataprise:** Dataprise is a private equity–backed company focused on both organic growth and strategic acquisitions of high\-performing businesses that align with our philosophies and values. Our mission is simple: **delight our clients and create an outstanding people experience—internally and externally.** We are an employee\-focused organization that prioritizes retention, satisfaction, and empowerment. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead (SF)
jobs.description: **Why Join Doppel** Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI\-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI\-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat\-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real\-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. **What We're Building** We're building the AI\-native social engineering defense platform. This means we're designing scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web forums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats. **What You'll Do** Doppel's Forward Deployed Engineering team owns the onboarding of our biggest enterprise customers as effective and low touch as possible You'll work directly with our largest enterprise customers alongside GTM and Product to understand their onboarding needs, scope and prioritize technical solutions, and build the end\-to\-end systems that get customers integrated with Doppel’s core offerings. You'll lead the technical direction of the whole FDE team while staying hands\-on with our hardest integrations and most strategic deployments. As Doppel's customer base and product portfolio expand, you'll help turn what we learn in the field into reusable capabilities that make every future deployment faster and easier. * **Lead FDE technically.** Set technical direction, mentor engineers, unblock complex projects, and raise the engineering bar while remaining hands\-on. * **Own our most strategic deployments.** Join customers from technical discovery through production rollout, identifying onboarding friction, scoping solutions, and driving the engineering work required to get them live. * **Build end\-to\-end solutions.** Architect, build, and debug across APIs, webhooks, SIEM/SOAR platforms, identity systems, email infrastructure, and the broader enterprise security stack. * **Turn field work into product.** Identify patterns across customer deployments and turn bespoke solutions into reusable product and platform capabilities. * **Make deployment increasingly scalable.** Build the systems, automation, and internal tooling that make every new customer faster and easier to launch than the last. * **Shape the product from the field.** Create a tight feedback loop between customers, GTM, Product, and Engineering so what we're learning from our largest customers influences what we build. * **Help shape FDE's technical boundaries.** Develop strong judgment around what FDE should build, what should graduate into core product or platform, and where FDE should partner with other engineering teams. **What we’re looking for** * **Strong software engineering foundation.** 6\+ years building and shipping production software, with the technical depth to make architecture decisions and contribute directly to the codebase. * **Technical leadership experience.** You've set technical direction, mentored engineers, and driven complex projects while remaining hands\-on. * **Customer\-facing technical depth.** You've worked directly with complex enterprise customers, can uncover technical needs, and can turn ambiguous problems into scoped production systems. * **Experience with enterprise systems.** You're comfortable working across APIs, webhooks, identity and authentication (OAuth, SAML, SCIM), and enterprise infrastructure. Experience with security platforms or SIEM/SOAR ecosystems is a plus. * **Product instincts.** You recognize patterns across customer needs and know when something should remain customer\-specific versus becoming a reusable product or platform capability. * **High agency in ambiguity.** You cut through organizational and technical blockers to get things done. You figure out who to pull in across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering, chase down missing context, and create the connections and processes needed to move customer problems from ambiguity to production. * **Strong technical judgment and communication.** You can move comfortably between a customer call, system design, debugging with an engineer, and working with Product on what should be built next. * **AI\-native mindset.** Experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI\-powered workflows is a plus, but we're most interested in engineers who are excited to use AI to change how technical customer work gets done. **Join Doppel** =============== Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective. We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real\-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you. Compensation Range: $120K \- $250K

jobs.title: Database Software Developer
jobs.description: **Request For Proposal:** **Environmental Data Management Platform** Ensolum LLC is seeking an experienced senior full\-stack developer or small development team to help design and build an Environmental Data Management Platform for environmental consulting operations. Project Overview: The platform will provide consultants with an organized view of projects to which they have been granted access, along with associated field activities, laboratory results, regulatory criteria, deadlines and deliverables required by regulatory agencies. It will initially focus on oil spill response workflows while establishing a flexible foundation that can support additional environmental services over time. Data will be organized hierarchically around clients, with each client containing one or more sub clients, each sub client containing a collection of projects and each project requiring one or many environmental services that occur at one or more sites. Each project will store associated field activities, laboratory results, and project deliverables, including reports, tables, photologs and GIS figures. This structure will provide a consistent way to organize environmental data and project work while maintaining clear relationships between the client, project, service(s), sites, and relevant project documents. The platform must ingest Electronic Data Deliverable (EDD) data received from a variety of laboratory sources, transform the data into a standardized format and load it into a custom, project specific template. Templates will provide functionality to compare analytical results against applicable regulatory criteria and flag potential exceedances for review. Pending approval and lab QC validation, the table, or updates to the table will be added as a project deliverable. The platform must provide standard data tables and customizable data tables and completed deliverables must be exportable as CSV and XLSX. The platform must be able to integrate directly with ArcGIS to obtain coordinates and associated metadata for point, line, and polygon features collected through Field Maps. This integration will enable laboratory sample data to be spatially associated with corresponding field locations, providing a unified view of sample results, field activities, and spatial information within the project. The successful candidate or team will be responsible for both the underlying platform and the user experience. The application must be intuitive for environmental consultants who work with complex data but may not be technical users. **Key Responsibilities** **Product and UI/UX** * Design clear, efficient workflows for project setup, field data, EDD review, approvals, reporting, and GIS access * Develop responsive, accessible, and consistent user interfaces * Create dashboards, data tables, filters, search, maps, review queues, forms, and approval screens * Make data\-quality errors and regulatory exceedances easy to understand and resolve * Incorporate user feedback from the internal team and pilot clients **Full\-Stack Development** * Design and implement the frontend application and backend services * Build the EDD upload, parsing, transformation, validation, and approval workflow * Implement configurable QA/QC and regulatory rules * Design database relationships among clients, projects, sites, samples, documents, and deliverables * Integrate with ArcGIS for spatial data, coordinates, features, and sample relationships * Support CSV, XLSX, PDF, image, and other project\-related files * Implement role\-based access, tenant isolation, audit trails, versioning, and approvals * Develop report and deliverable\-generation features * Develop a custom data analytics system for sorting and viewing data to look for trends in projects, locations and over time * Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and future enhancements **Preferred Experience** * Strong full\-stack web application development experience * Excellent frontend skills and demonstrated UI/UX judgment * Experience building data\-heavy business applications * PostgreSQL database design and optimization * PostGIS or other spatial\-data experience * API design and third\-party integrations * Workflow, approval, and data\-validation systems * GIS or ArcGIS integration * Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture and access control * Cloud deployment, testing, version control, and security practices · Experience with environmental, laboratory, regulatory, engineering, or GIS applications is highly desirable. **Engagement Details** * **Role:** Senior Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer * **Engagement:** Contract * **Start date:** November 2026 Applicants should provide: * A brief description of relevant experience * Frontend and UI/UX work samples * Relevant backend, database, or integration experience * Experience with GIS, laboratory, regulatory, or workflow systems * Recommended technology stack * Availability and expected engagement terms * Cost and time estimates Job jobs.title: Business Optimization Manager
jobs.description: **Company Description** “We’re not in the shipping business; we’re in the information business” \-Peter Rose, Expeditors Founder Global supply chain management is what we do, but at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service\-based approach to logistics. * 15,000 trained professionals * 250\+ locations worldwide * Fortune 500 * Globally unified systems **Job Description** Cargo Signal is hiring a Business Optimization Manager to find the work our teams still do by hand and make our systems do it instead. The role is deliberately blended: part business analyst, part product manager, part hands\-on builder. You will sit with our billing, operations, and commercial teams, learn where their time actually goes, decide what can realistically be automated with the tools we already own, and then go build it. This position exists because of a specific gap. We have no shortage of people who can execute a well\-specified request, and very few who can walk into a messy, undefined problem, work out what is actually wrong, and propose a fix the business will adopt. We need both halves in one person. You will not be writing production software or shipping code to our platform. You will be working across APIs, SQL, low\-code tooling, and AI automation to get real results out of the systems already in place. You will start with a backlog we have already identified. Over time, we expect you to set that agenda yourself. Key Responsibilities * Partner with business teams to map how work is done today and identify the manual steps that cost the most time or introduce the most error. * Turn those findings into a prioritized automation plan with a clear view of effort, impact, and sequence, then defend the priorities to the teams they affect. * Build and maintain integrations between Cargo Signal's platforms using APIs, webhooks, and scheduled jobs. * Write SQL against our BigQuery environment to answer operational questions, build reporting, and confirm that automations are behaving the way they were designed to. * Configure and extend our low\-code and SaaS platforms, including Retool and HubSpot, writing or adapting small pieces of custom JavaScript where the configuration screens run out of room. * Apply AI and agentic automation capabilities inside the tools we already run, and keep current as those capabilities change. * Own what you build after it launches: monitor it, measure whether it delivered the time or accuracy it promised, and iterate. * Work inside corporate IT and security controls, delivering through approved applications rather than unmanaged desktop scripts, and finding a compliant path when the obvious one is closed. **Qualifications*** Three to five years in a business systems, business analyst, solutions, or technical product role where you owned outcomes rather than tickets. * Hands\-on experience building, consuming, and troubleshooting integrations between business systems. * Strong SQL, including joins, aggregation, and window functions, with the ability to work in a cloud data warehouse without hand\-holding. * A track record of identifying a business problem yourself, designing a viable solution, and seeing it through to adoption. * Enough technical range to be self\-sufficient in a systems UI and to write or adapt a small piece of custom JavaScript when configuration alone will not finish the job. We are not hiring a software engineer, and we are not hiring someone who stops at the edge of the admin panel. * The communication skill to run a discovery conversation with a non\-technical team and then explain the proposed solution, its trade\-offs, and its limits in business terms. * Sound judgment about operating inside corporate security controls, including knowing when to escalate for an approved tool instead of routing around the guardrail. **Additional Information** A successful candidate must pass Expeditors’ pre\-employment background check. Expeditors offers excellent benefits: * Paid Vacation (first year prorated based off month of hire then eligible for 15 days) * Holidays (10\) * Flexible Days (2\) * Paid Sick Time (accrual rate of 1 hour of sick time per 30 hours paid) * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with employer match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental \& Vision Coverage * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Life and Disability Insurance * Paid Parental Leave (additional eligibility criteria) * Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (DC FSA) * Commuter Benefit * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Training and Personnel Development Program * Educational Assistance and Reimbursement * All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO Guidelines. Salary range: $120,000\-$140,000 *Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not transfer or sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (such as an H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.*

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Full stack), Shared Services Platform - Miami
jobs.description: **Location:** Miami (in\-office 4 days per week) **Team:** Engineering **Reports to:** Head of Engineering **About Extenteam** Extenteam is the AI\-driven operations platform for short\-term rental property management, headquartered in Miami and founded in 2021\. Our platform, Shared Services, handles guest communication and daily operational workflows for 80,000\+ properties by pairing an AI orchestration layer with a shared\-services team of hospitality\-trained specialists, so no guest inquiry goes unanswered, day or night, and no property manager has to staff for the 2am cancellation themselves. We're industry\-only: every workflow, integration, and agent we hire is built around property management specifically, not bolted on from a generalist platform. As we push more of that platform toward AI\-led automation and self\-serve tools, the software our own Shared Services team works in every day has to keep pace, that's this role. **Why This Role Exists** Shared Services' guest communication runs on two things: an AI layer that handles as much of a conversation as it safely can, and a shared\-services team of hospitality\-trained agents who catch what the AI shouldn't touch alone. Every day, that team hits walls in the platform they use to do the work; bugs, missing tooling, workflows that don't match how a busy overnight shift actually runs. Some of that is a quick fix. Some of it is a signal that the platform is failing at scale, and by the time it reaches Engineering it's already cost real client trust. We don't have a layer of PMs pre\-chewing every one of those signals into a spec. We're hiring an engineer who can sit close to Operations, tell the difference between a one\-off bug and a systemic gap, and ship the fix with no handoff required. **The Role** You'll report to the Head of Engineering. Priorities are set jointly with the Head of Operations, who owns the operational signal driving what gets built. You'll do two things: * **Close incoming platform tickets from Shared Services.** Agents, Team Leads, and Operations report issues daily; quick fixes, workflow bugs, configuration problems. You triage, diagnose, and ship. * **Find the pattern and fix it at the source.** When multiple agents report the same friction, that's not a ticket, it's a product problem. When a client complaint traces back to repeated agent failures, you ask why the platform is allowing it, and you close that gap for good. Every ship goes through the same process as any other engineer's here: product filters for coherence, design filters for UX consistency, standard code review. This role works inside those guardrails, not around them. **What You Will Do** * Own features end to end; problem framing, design, backend, frontend, instrumentation, rollout, and the follow\-up fixes nobody filed a ticket for. * Work with founders, product, and design at the whiteboard stage, before anything is written down, and help decide what's worth building. * Build the AI surfaces of the product; prompt and agent architecture, tool calling, retrieval, guardrails, and the human\-in\-the\-loop escape hatches that make automation safe to ship. * Build and maintain evals. Treat "does this actually work" as an engineering artifact with a regression suite, not a vibe check before launch. * Watch real usage. Session replays, logs, transcripts, support tickets, and customer calls. Bring back what you learn as shipped changes, not as a document. * Own the details that make software feel good; latency budgets, token cost, empty states, error copy, loading behavior, keyboard paths. These are part of the feature, not a separate polish phase. * Cut scope and kill things. Argue a feature is wrong before you build it well. * Compound the team's velocity; CI, preview environments, internal tools, seed data, debugging surfaces. Leverage counts as product work. **What This Role Is Not** * **Not a ticket queue firefighter.** That's other roles on the Operations side. * **Not a shadow engineering team.** You report to and work within Engineering. * **Not an independent operator building outside the platform.** Everything you ship goes through product. **Anti\-Signals** * You want a ticket fully spec'd before you'll touch it * You treat "why does this keep happening" as someone else's question to answer * You measure your work by whether you closed the ticket, not whether the pattern stopped * Your AI/LLM experience is prompting a demo — never held to a reliability bar with a real agent depending on it at 2am **Required Experience** * 4\+ years of **full stack** (stronger on the BE) software engineering experience shipping production enterprise software * Direct experience building internal tools, agent\-facing platforms, or operational systems * Product mindset: comfortable scoping problems, asking the right questions, and communicating/prioritizing tradeoffs * Track record of shipping fast while working inside a product and design process * Experience working asynchronously with distributed teams **Required Technical Skills** * Strong fluency in TypeScript. We currently use: + Next JS + NestJS + TypeORM with Postgres + BullMQ * Comfortable with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Replit Agent) * API integration experience (REST, webhooks, third\-party SaaS APIs) * Prompt engineering experience with production AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) **Strongly Preferred** * Experience building tools for contact center, customer support, or operations teams * Short\-term rental, hospitality, or property management domain knowledge * Track record of deploying AI agents in production **How You'll Work** * Reports to the Head of Engineering * Priorities set jointly with the Head of Operations, based on operational signal * Product decisions filter through the Head of Product * Design decisions go through our design team * Weekly syncs with Engineering, Operations, and Product * Miami\-based, in\-office 4 days per week

jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**About the Team** ------------------ Every time a fan places a bet, earns a reward, or checks out on Fanatics — Fanatics Core made that possible. We build the shared foundations — identity, payments, loyalty, wallet, data, and platform — that power sports betting, ecommerce, collectibles, and beyond. We supercharge the business by providing products and capabilities so that teams can focus on what matters most: building delightful experiences for the fans. Fanatics is uniquely positioned at the intersection of sports commerce, betting, and collectibles, and Fanatics ONE is the loyalty and identity program that ties it all together. **Overview** As a Senior Software Engineer at Fanatics, you will design, build, and operate the platforms and services that power the Fan Ecosystem — the systems that connect fans to every Fanatics product and experience. You will own significant technical surface area end to end, set the technical direction for projects that span multiple services and teams, and raise the engineering bar for those around you through mentorship, design leadership, and hands\-on delivery. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack role with a backend center of gravity. The majority of your work will be building high\-throughput, high\-availability services in Go, with meaningful contributions to the TypeScript/React front ends those services support. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, document, and operate high\-quality, production\-grade software with a focus on Go services and APIs * Own the technical design of medium\-to\-large features and systems: define the approach, weigh trade\-offs, document decisions, and drive them to completion * Break down ambiguous problems into well\-scoped, deliverable work for yourself and other engineers on the team * Lead and participate in design and architecture reviews; provide clear, constructive feedback that improves both the design and the designer * Set the standard in code reviews — for correctness, readability, testability, and operational safety * Mentor and grow engineers on the team; onboard new hires and act as a technical point of contact for your systems * Participate in and improve the on\-call rotation: instrument your services, drive incident response, and lead blameless postmortems that result in real fixes * Improve reliability, performance, and cost of the systems you own; define and act on SLOs and operational excellence metrics * Identify and pay down technical debt, and make the case for the investments worth making * Partner closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape the roadmap and make technology decisions that grow the business * Influence and help define the principles, guidelines, and best practices of our engineering strategy — then hold the team to them * Develop deep understanding of our industry, product, feature set, and roadmap, and use it to make better technical decisions **Required Qualifications** * **5\+ years** of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems * **Strong, demonstrated proficiency in Go (Golang) — required.** You have built and shipped production services in Go and can speak to concurrency patterns, error handling, testing, profiling, and performance tuning in the language * Proven experience designing, building, and scaling backend services and APIs (REST and/or gRPC) in a distributed, microservices environment * Demonstrated proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, and experience with React or another modern front\-end framework * Solid grounding in data stores and messaging: relational and/or NoSQL databases, caching, and event streaming (e.g. Kafka, SQS/SNS) * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code * Strong operational instincts: observability, monitoring, alerting, debugging production issues under pressure * Track record of leading projects with multiple contributors and delivering them on time without sacrificing quality * Familiar with Agile software product delivery and SCRUM methodology * Able to effectively work cross\-functionally within an enterprise environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building or integrating with identity and access management systems — authentication, authorization, SSO, and account lifecycle * Hands\-on familiarity with identity standards and protocols: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, MFA, session and token lifecycle management * Experience with identity providers and CIAM platforms (e.g. Okta, Auth0, ForgeRock, AWS Cognito, Ping) or with building an in\-house identity platform * Experience with account security, fraud prevention, PII handling, or regulatory/compliance\-driven engineering (KYC, GDPR, CCPA) * Experience designing systems that serve high\-traffic, consumer\-facing products with spiky, event\-driven load * Experience with platform or shared\-services work where your consumers are other engineering teams * Experience working in a start\-up environment * Experience in sports, commerce, media, or another consumer\-scale domain *If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ \#LI\-KR1 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.description: Fickett Structural Solutions, Inc. is a structural engineering, inspection and testing firm with offices in Madison and Milwaukee Wisconsin, as well as Tennessee, Oregon, and Washington. We are seeking a Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) who is actively performing welding inspections. This person will be assigned to either our Madison or Milwaukee, Wisconsin office. We provide inspection and testing services during the construction of commercial structures such as buildings, stadiums and parking ramps, as well as shop fabrication inspections on bridges, buildings, and dams. Most inspection work is fabricated to AWS D1\.1 or D1\.5 specifications. This is a direct hire position, not a contractor role. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * Perform visual inspections (VT) on structural steel for use in the construction of buildings, bridges, dams, and ancillary structures as specified by design, shop, and as\-built drawings, specifications, and applicable industry codes * Coordinates inspections with site project manager or responsible person in charge * Coordinate and communicate with Engineer of Record as required * Communicate with project personnel regarding work requirements, inspection findings, and identified defects or nonconformances * Ensure proper care, maintenance, and use of specialized inspection and testing equipment * Prepares timely, detailed reports of the inspection results, including descriptions, drawings, photos, etc., of nonconforming details with deficiencies noted * Ensure compliance with company safety policies, federal and state regulations, and client requirements * Maintain compliance with AWS, ASTM, RCSC, IBC, ICC, OSHA and other applicable codes * Promote safety awareness and model best practices during field and office activities * Other responsibilities, as required/assigned **Required Qualifications:** * Holds a current certificate as a Certified Weld Inspector (CWI) with D1\.1 or D1\.5 work experience * 1\-year of experience or more as a CWI performing in\-service weld inspections or shop welding inspections * Is thoroughly familiar with the scope and limitations of the methods for which he/she is certified and is able to exercise assigned responsibility without direct supervision * Relevant experience with structural steel welding inspections, structural steel bolting inspections, and writing comprehensive reports * Have, or ability to obtain within three months of hire, the ICC Special Inspections certification for 2\.1 Structural Steel: Steel High Strength Bolting and 2\.2 Structural Steel: Steel – Welding * Ability to define and document problems, collect data, evaluate facts, and draw valid conclusions * Ability to read and understand engineering and construction plans, specifications, industry codes and shop drawings * Ability to work outside in various types of weather conditions * Ability to work in aerial lifts utilizing appropriate PPE and safeguards * Ability to drive company vehicle or own vehicle to various job sites **Recommended Qualifications:** * Documented proof of experience/on\-the\-job\-training to meet the Level II requirements to SNT\-TC\-1A and Fickett Structural Solutions’ personnel specification for MT and UT Shear Wave * Ability to successfully pass NDT Level II Certification to SNT\-TC\-1A and Fickett Structural Solutions’ personnel specification for MT and UT Shear Wave * Have, or ability to obtain, the ICC Special Inspections certification for 2\.1 Structural Steel: Steel – Nondestructive Testing **Skills:** * Experience with PDF software, Word and Excel required * Experience using various computer devices including laptops, iPads, tablets, etc. required * Experience (previous employment or coursework) with Computer Aided Drafting (CAD) is useful but not required * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Strong sense of integrity and professional ethics **Physical Demands:** * Ability to work in both office and non\-office environments, such as construction job sites and fabrication shops * Ability to speak, hear, sit, reach, bend, stoop, climb, balance, walk, and stand for long periods, traverse uneven job site surfaces, lift or move up to 50 pounds, handle power tools, utilize various testing instruments, reach with hands/arms, crawl/walk into small spaces, maneuver over fences and up steep embankments, climb ladders/ascend heights, climb into bucket trucks and aerial lifts * Ability to tolerate working at heights in mechanical lifts or from ladders * Ability to wear appropriate fall protection equipment * Vision abilities must include close and distance vision with or without correction, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus * Ability to adjust and work in varied weather and temperature conditions, as well as dusty and noisy environments **Other Working Conditions:** * This is a full\-time position, typically working 40 hours per week depending on project schedules and workload, and ability to work overtime as needed. * Available for periodic overnight(s) travel during the week (Company reimburses mileage, meals and hotel costs) to work at customer job sites or other locations * Travel requirements to project locations will include various modes of transportation, including vehicles and airplanes * A valid, current driver’s license with a good driving record is required. Ability to drive on behalf of the company is subject to the Company’s insurance carrier’s review of driving records * All employees who drive their personal vehicles on company business are required to carry at least $300,000 of liability protection on their personal auto policy * Background screening required **Compensation:** This is a nonexempt, hourly position. Our chapter comprises teams that work on a wide range of applications and platforms like Fidelity.com, Fidelity Mobile and Investor Centers. As an associate software engineer, you will help us build the omni\-channel user experiences and the underlying platforms needed to support our digital presence. You’ll work on building entire features, taking these from concept to deployment, as part of our autonomous, cross functional teams. You'll have the opportunity to contribute ideas to improve our products as well as develop your skills, learn new technologies and languages, and continue to learn. Node.js based web applications in a fast\-paced environment. * Design and Development of front\-end solutions using Angular, Typescript, JavaScript, CSS, HTML \& Browser Developer tools. * Designing and implementing continuous JS environments using Webpack, Grunt, Gulp, etc. * Knowledge of DevOps, Automated Testing and Continuous Delivery using technologies such as Groovy, Jenkins, Concourse preferred. * Experience consuming RESTful APIs. * Exposure to native mobile development on iOS and/or Android a bonus. * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Mathematics, Physics (or equivalent). **The Skills You Bring** * Strong understanding of Computer Science fundamentals (Data Structures, Algorithms). * Your knowledge of HTTP based APIs, Networking and how the internet works. * Strong Version Control, Branching strategies and Git skills. * Your hands\-on experience working with package management using Node.js, NPM, Express. * Proven expertise and mindset of employing Automation for Development, Testing \& Deployment. * Appetite for learning new skills and constantly learning. **The Value You Deliver** * Using business knowledge to translate the vision for initiatives into business solutions by developing complex interconnected software applications and conducting studies of alternatives. * Creating and maintaining comprehensive documentation for multiple applications or subsystems. * Participate in iteration planning to maintain velocity and deliver quality each sprint. * Analyzing business requirements and system development specifications. * Participating in problem solving, troubleshooting, performance tuning, production support, and maintenance of existing applications. * Playing a key role in resolving technical roadblocks involving multiple technologies. * Ensuring code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing are completed efficiently and effectively. * Helping to coordinate the delivery of technical components across internal/external technical teams. * Contributing to process\-improvement initiatives to maximize velocity for the product team. **How Your Work Impacts the Organization** We believe that diversity in background and experience will foster an inclusive and engaging work environment for our employees. This ultimately enables us to deliver a better product for our customers. Being technically competent is only telling half the story. We believe that delivering the best possible customer experience requires an artful blend of human ingenuity and technology. While we value smart technologists, we are fanatics about our culture that promotes autonomy and leadership at all levels. People who are great cultural fits demonstrate curiosity to learn, are unafraid to break things, step up and take the lead, take ownership of their projects, and thrive by sharing knowledge and demonstrating our core pillars: * Imagine. Keep it cool: Nurture an inclusive organizational culture, foster positive energy \& family spirit, recognize greatness, support each other \& enjoy the journey. * Elevate the floor; Influence the horizontal: Commit to developing leadership at all levels. jobs.title: Manager, Sales Enablement
jobs.description: **About First Due** First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end\-to\-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations. ### **Job Title: Manager, Sales Enablement** **Location**: Remote \- US Only **Country**: United States **Department**: Sales **Position Type**: Full\-Time **Salary**: $140,000 ### **Job Summary:** We are hiring a **Manager, Sales Enablement** to deeply partner with GTM and drive actionable accelerated outcomes. We want someone who sees the function of Sales Enablement as a revenue problem rather than a training problem. The job will be measured on ramp time, certification, and win rates, not on how much training gets delivered. This is a highly hands\-on role. You should expect to write the playbook and then run reps through it yourself: leading live sessions, reviewing call recordings, sitting in on demos, and building and managing the certification program. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * **Rep ramp and productivity** + You will own time\-to\-first\-deal for new AEs. Onboarding should be built around real pipeline, live customer conversations, and recorded calls, so that new hires are selling early rather than watching slide decks. You'll also build and manage a tiered certification program covering trade\-show fluency, demo certification, and full\-suite certification, with live evaluated practice at each level. Completing a video course doesn't count as a credential here. * **AI\-driven coaching at scale** + We have more than 30 reps, so ride\-alongs alone won't work. We expect you to use AI heavily: call analysis, coaching, content personalization, and rep self\-service, built on our current GTM stack. In practice that means managing a coaching loop that surfaces deal risk, demo quality, talk\-track adherence, and discovery gaps to each rep and their Regional Sales Director every week. It also means building reusable AI assistants for things like objection handling, battlecards, discovery prep, and account research. Every tool should be tied to an outcome. If something isn't moving win rate, ramp time, or activity quality, we stop paying for it. * **Product and competitive fluency** + An early and non\-negotiable goal: every AE can hold a 15\-minute overview conversation across the full product suite at a trade show without a solution consultant in the room. From there, the longer\-term work is building the habits that let reps land and expand across RMS, ePCR, scheduling, training, command, and reporting from the first call, supported by competitive playbooks and displacement plays. * **Content and sales tools** + Audit the existing collateral in your first 60 days. Keep what reps actually use and what converts, and rebuild or retire the rest. Reps should never have to wonder which deck, pricing sheet, or battlecard is current, so part of this job is maintaining a single source of truth. The same standard applies to the tool stack: every tool should have an owner, an adoption target, and a connection to a sales metric. * **Partnership with sales leadership** + You'll partner closely with sales leadership to identify coaching priorities region by region. A significant part of the job is helping our four Regional Sales Directors become better coaches and ensuring reps receive consistent, actionable coaching. You'll also keep a tight loop with Solution Consulting and Product on demo discipline, sandbox usage, and new\-feature enablement so that product launches turn into pipeline quickly. ### **Qualifications:** * Five or more years in B2B SaaS sales, sales enablement, sales engineering, or sales management, including experience directly supporting or owning enablement programs * A track record you can point to: ramp time you reduced, win rates you moved, or a certification program that changed how reps actually sell * Hands\-on experience with Gong or a similar platform, modern outbound tooling, LMS platforms, and CRM workflows * Real working fluency with AI. You are already building custom GPTs or similar assistants, automating call review, and using AI for coaching and content, not just reading about it * Field credibility. Reps will trust you faster if you can take the call and run the demo yourself, so a background as a high\-performing AE, sales manager, or sales engineer is a strong plus * Experience selling into public safety, healthcare, govtech, or other vertical or regulated markets helps * Comfort with ambiguity. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
jobs.description: **About Forma** --------------- The employee benefits landscape needs a reset. Companies invest millions annually in benefits that employees neither value nor use regularly. Forma, founded in 2017, set out to challenge this one\-size\-fits\-all approach. Forma's global lifestyle benefits platform enables companies to offer competitive packages while reducing costs and inefficiencies. While giving employees more choice and flexibility in spending their benefit allowances, the Forma platform saves HR, total rewards, and benefits professionals countless hours they would have spent managing and supporting multiple point solutions. With Forma, companies can choose from a suite of products, including Lifestyle Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Health Reimbursement Arrangements, Flexible Spending Accounts, and more. These products allow companies to design and deliver customized benefits programs through a single platform. Employees can then spend account funds in three ways: The Forma Store, The Forma Visa Card, or claim reimbursement. Forma has helped hundreds of renowned companies, including Stripe, UKG, lululemon, and Tripadvisor, to design equitable, scalable, and flexible benefits programs for nearly 1 million employees worldwide. Forma is backed by Emergence Capital and Ribbit Capital. We have received numerous awards for our exponential growth, innovation, and as a "Great Place to Work." **About the Role** ------------------ As Senior Manager on the Platform side at Forma, you'll lead the backend team responsible for the core systems that power our entire benefits platform. Your team owns the reliability, scalability, and performance of the backend systems that every product and customer\-facing team builds on. Under your leadership, the team will drive end\-to\-end ownership of these services from architecture through deployment and operational excellence. You'll work closely with Engineering leadership, Product Management, Security, Customer Operations and other engineering teams to ensure our platform can scale reliably as we grow. You'll also shape how the team builds, not just what it builds — AI\-assisted development is changing the volume and shape of code flowing into our systems, and Platform owns the guardrails that keep that change safe. **You Will** ------------ * Product Strategy \& Executive Communication + Own the product strategy and roadmap for backend platform services, balancing scalability, reliability, security, with business outcomes across the org. + Translate platform strategy into a practical execution plan with quarterly OKRs, and hold the team accountable to delivery. * Technical Strategy \& Judgment + Champion engineering excellence — driving best practices in system design, code quality, testing, and operational readiness across services, including an explicit bar for how AI\-assisted code is specified, reviewed, and verified before it reaches production. + Partner cross\-functionally with other engineering teams to define platform APIs, shared services, and infrastructure that support company\-wide product velocity. * Manager Effectiveness + Manage and grow a team of backend engineers, providing performance feedback, hiring, and fostering a diverse, collaborative, and inclusive team culture. + Build trust and a strong engineering culture, coaching engineers toward technical and career growth, including deliberate investment in the skills AI doesn't replace: problem framing, debugging from first principles, and architectural judgment. * Delivery \& Organizational Effectiveness + Own the operational model for platform reliability: uptime, incident response, on\-call processes, and postmortems, ensuring the platform meets the performance and availability bar the business needs. + Develop and track engineering and platform health metrics to drive continuous improvement toward world\-class enterprise infrastructure. + Set up processes to handle ad hoc infrastructure and support needs without disrupting the team's execution cadence. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * 5\+ years of experience directly managing software engineers, including experience managing a platform, infrastructure, or backend systems team. * 10\+ years of experience developing backend software applications, with deep expertise in distributed systems, APIs, and service\-oriented architecture. * Proven track record of building and scaling large\-scale, complex distributed systems in a production environment. * Experience owning platform reliability — SLAs/SLOs, incident management, observability, and on\-call practices. * Experience developing engineering talent and helping them achieve their personal and professional goals through hiring, coaching, and performance management. * Ability to foster a collaborative environment through strong partnerships with Product, Security, and other Engineering teams. * Proven success driving technical strategy and innovation in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment. * Hands\-on experience building with AI\-assisted development tools, and a clear point of view on where they help, where they don't, and how to hold quality and security standards as output scales. * Fintech experience would be a plus. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Remote\-first working environment * Medical, dental and vision insurance plans * Employee wellness program * One\-time home office stipend * 401(k) savings plan * Flexible PTO policy * 12 weeks Parental Leave \+ 4 additional weeks for the Birthing Parent *At Forma, we value diversity, and always treat all employees and job applicants based on merit, qualifications, competence, and talent. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *Duties and responsibilities may not all be covered in the description, or may change over time at the discretion of Forma. At Forma, we welcome diverse perspectives, and people who think rigorously / aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us!*

jobs.description: **What You Will Do:** --------------------- **GFT** is seeking an Environmental Scientist to join our Environmental Sciences team in **Owings Mills, MD.** This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring regular attendance at our **Owings Mills** office. **GFT’s Environmental Team** GFT’s Environmental team delivers integrated planning, permitting, design and compliance solutions that support infrastructure development across North America. project delivery skills. **In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:*** Opportunity to work across multiple environmental disciplines and project types. * environmental disciplines. * Assist with Phase I and Phase II ESA’s (soil and groundwater studies). * Assist with NEPA documentation and environmental review processes. * Conduct site inspections, environmental monitoring, and field reconnaissance. * Perform wetland delineations, stream assessments, environmental resource surveys, and stream and wetland monitoring. * Interpret and apply federal, state, and local environmental regulations. * Prepare technical reports, permit applications, environmental documentation, regulatory submissions, and analyze environmental and laboratory data to develop clear, defensible conclusions and recommendations. * Assist project managers with project planning, budgeting, scheduling, and execution. * Plan, prioritize, and organize multiple assignments while meeting project deadlines. * Perform GIS data collection, mapping, and analysis using ArcGIS. * Mentoring, training, and professional development opportunities. * Opportunities for technical growth and progression into increased project responsibility. **Education \| Experience:** ---------------------------- **What you will bring to our firm:*** Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Environmental Engineering, Natural Resources, Biology, Ecology, or a related scientific or engineering field. * 3\-5 years of relevant environmental consulting, engineering, compliance, assessment, permitting, remediation, or field investigation experience. * General knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to gather, organize, analyze, and interpret environmental data. * Self\-motivated, organized, and able to complete assignments with appropriate direction. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams. * Professional judgment, consistency, attention to detail, and commitment to high\-quality work products. * Willingness and ability to perform fieldwork in varying weather, terrain, and site conditions. * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites. **What we prefer you bring:*** Experience with environmental site assessments, subsurface investigations, remediation, compliance, permitting, or natural resource projects. * Experience with wetland delineations, stream surveys, stream assessments, restoration, or ecological field studies. * OSHA 40\-Hour HAZWOPER certification. * Experience with ArcGIS, GPS, or other environmental data collection tools. * Familiarity with environmental databases and electronic data deliverables, including EQuIS. * Experience with AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Microsoft Project, or related software. * Knowledge of environmental permitting and regulatory processes in the Mid\-Atlantic region, including Maryland, the District of Columbia, Virginia, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. **Compensation:** The salary range for this role is $62,000 \- $93,000\. Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location. **Featured Benefits:*** Hybrid (in\-person and remote) work environment. * Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance. * Tax\-deferred 401(k) savings plan. * Competitive paid\-time\-off (PTO) accrual. * Tuition reimbursement for continued education. * Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations * Incentive compensation for eligible positions. **Company Overview:** --------------------- At GFT, a privately held AEC firm, we innovate where transportation, water, power, and buildings converge. We call this the Infrastructure of Life. We measure our success by the strength of our relationships – that’s why we’re the employer of choice for 5,000\+ of the industry’s brightest engineers, planners, architects, inspectors, designers, and more. Our clients choose us for our expertise and prefer us for our nimble approach, creativity, and personal touch. Backed by over a century’s experience, together we’re building a lasting legacy for future generations: stronger communities, a healthier planet, and better lives. **GFT: Ingenuity That Shapes Lives™** is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veterans’ status or other characteristics protected by law. Unsolicited resumes from third party agencies will be considered the property GFT. GFT does require the successful completion of a criminal background check for all advertised positions. **Location:** Owings Mills, MD **Core Business Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM **Employment Status:** Full\-Time \#LI\-KV1 \#LI\-hybrid
