jobs.title: Chemical Process Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: As the **Chemical Process/Manufacturing Engineer**, you will play a key role in improving the reliability, efficiency, safety, and sustainability of our manufacturing processes. This position offers the opportunity to apply and expand your technical expertise while leading process improvements that support plant performance, profitability, and future growth. What makes the Lawrence plant unique is our highly collaborative culture. Engineers work closely with operations, maintenance, and technical teams to identify opportunities, implement innovative solutions, and continuously improve the way we operate. If you enjoy working in an environment where curiosity, initiative, and teamwork are valued, you'll find plenty of opportunities to make an impact. **I’m interested! What will I get to do in this position?** * Working closely with operations and maintenance, you will use engineering expertise to optimize plant performance through process improvement, troubleshooting, project support, and technical leadership. * You'll analyze production data, implement solutions to manufacturing challenges, support audits and capital projects, and share knowledge through training and collaboration across the organization. * You will leverage data and KPIs to identify and execute improvement opportunities, lead cross\-functional initiatives, and drive operational excellence. * Success in this role includes fostering a culture of continuous improvement, developing team capabilities through coaching and knowledge sharing, and delivering sustainable, measurable results. **What skills and experience do I need to be successful in this role?** * B.S. in Chemical Engineering; upcoming December 2026 graduates are welcome to apply. Must be available to start full\-time employment no later than January 2027\. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. * Knowledge of manufacturing processes and plant operations. * Excellent communication, organizational, and documentation skills. **What will set me apart?** * 2\+ years of chemical manufacturing or process engineering experience; recent graduates with relevant internship or co\-op experience are encouraged to apply. * Experience leading process improvements, managing projects, and influencing change across teams. * Experience in chemical, food, or other process manufacturing environments. * Knowledge of multiple engineering disciplines, including electrical, instrumentation, and process controls. * Experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar design software. jobs.title: Principal, AI Operations & Infrastructure Automation
jobs.description: Overview: **About the Role \& Team** IDC is the premier global provider of market intelligence, advisory services, and events for the technology markets. For more than 60 years, we've helped technology suppliers, buyers, and investors make the right decisions with evidence, not guesswork. Our analysts turn data into the clarity our clients need to navigate their next move with confidence. That standard applies internally too. The infrastructure our analysts, sales teams, and clients depend on has to be fast, reliable, and quietly excellent — at a scale manual operations can no longer reach. **What You’ll Do** IDC is modernizing how infrastructure is run — shifting from manual, ticket\-driven operations to an automated, AI\-informed model that keeps pace with the speed of the business. We're looking for a Principal of AI Operations \& Infrastructure Automation to lead this transformation: designing and standing up the automation, tooling, and operating model that will define how IDC's infrastructure team works going forward. This is a hands\-on, high\-velocity leadership role for someone who has actually built AIOps and infrastructure\-as\-code capability before — not just overseen it. You'll personally write and review automation, get into the tooling directly, and lead by example for the team you manage. You'll partner closely with the CIO, Cyber \& Infrastructure leadership, and AWS as a strategic cloud and co\-development partner to re\-architect how infrastructure operations get done. This role builds and leads the team responsible for automation — setting technical direction, reviewing their work, and growing their skills as the operating model evolves. Additional responsibilities include:* Own the end\-to\-end redesign of the infrastructure operating model, moving core workflows (provisioning, monitoring, incident response, patching, capacity management) from manual execution to automated, self\-healing pipelines. * Define a phased transformation roadmap with clear milestones, automation\-coverage targets, and go\-live gates — and drive execution against it at pace. * Lead change management for the infrastructure team through the transition — defining new roles, skills, and ways of working as automation is adopted. * Build the AIOps layer; evaluate, select, and deploy AIOps platforms and agentic tooling — anomaly detection, predictive alerting, automated remediation — suited to IDC's AWS\-centric environment. Implement event correlation and noise reduction so a hundred alerts resolve into one actionable incident with a probable root cause attached. * Stand up LLM (large language model)\-assisted triage that classifies, enriches, and routes incidents, pulling relevant runbooks, past resolutions, and change history into the ticket automatically. * Develop predictive capacity and failure models for critical services, and act on them before thresholds are breached. * Automate end to end, build and champion an infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) standard across the organization, converting legacy manual processes into version\-controlled, repeatable automation. * Deliver self\-healing automation and closed\-loop remediation for the highest\-volume recurring incidents — restart, rollback, scale, reroute, and verify without a human in the loop. Automate service request fulfillment: access provisioning, environment setup, onboarding and offboarding, and routine change execution. * Own CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery\-deployment) pipelines for operational tooling, including testing and safe rollback for automations that touch production. * Lead the team and prove the results Directly manage and develop a team of infrastructure and automation engineers — hiring, coaching, and setting technical direction — while staying hands\-on in the tooling and code yourself. * Partner with AWS and other strategic vendors to pilot and scale automation and AI\-driven operations capabilities, including Bedrock/AgentCore\-based tooling where relevant. * Establish new operational KPIs — automation coverage, mean time to detect and resolve, deployment frequency, toil eliminated — and report progress in concise, executive\-ready formats. * Set guardrails for AI in operations: human\-in\-the\-loop thresholds, blast\-radius limits, audit logging, evaluation of model output quality, and clear rollback paths. * Ensure automated operations meet IDC's security, compliance, and resiliency standards, working closely with Cyber \& Compliance. **What You Bring** Required * 8\+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, or IT operations, including 3\+ years leading automation or AIOps initiatives. * Demonstrated track record of redesigning an operations function around automation — not just introducing point tools but changing how a team works. * Deep hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure automation (AWS strongly preferred), infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar), and CI/CD pipelines. * Wor ty with FinOps practices and cloud cost automation. * Relevant certifications (cloud architect or engineer, Kubernetes, ITIL v4, Terraform). **What success looks like** *First 90 days* You know our estate — tooling, telemetry, ticket volume, and the top recurring incident categories. The transformation roadmap is published with milestones and automation\-coverage targets, and at least one automation is live and measurably reducing manual work. *First two quarters* A documented automation\-first operating model is adopted across the infrastructure team. Intelligent alert correlation is live on our highest\-noise services, and baseline AIOps KPIs are instrumented and reported to the CIO. *One year* Measurable improvement in mean time to detect and resolve incidents. A growing share of routine operational workflows runs without manual intervention, and infrastructure changes are consistently deployed through version\-controlled, automated pipelines. **Why This Role Stands Out** At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high\-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions. Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long\-term career development with a globally respected brand. **What We Offer** 15 vacation days (prorated based on start date) 12 company\-paid holidays 6 paid sick days (prorated based on start date; may vary by state) Medical, dental, and vision coverage 2 floating holidays (prorated based on start date) 1 volunteer day 401(k) company match (IDC matches 3% on the first 6% of employee contributions) Company\-paid short\-term disability Company\-paid life insurance Company\-paid parental leave Compensation Transparency At IDC, we are committed to fair and equitable pay practices. Employees are compensated equitably for their work, aligned with their skills and experience. Salary and incentive structures are determined through a rigorous process that considers experience, education, certifications, role\-specific requirements, internal equity, and verified U.S. market data from an independent third\-party partner. The expected total annual compensation, depending on location and experience, is between $139,000\-$240,000, inclusive of base salary and variable compensation. If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range. **Equal Opportunity Employer** IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E\-Verify. IDC is currently able to employ remote workers in the following states: Arizona (AZ), California (CA), Colorado (CO), Connecticut (CT), Washington D.C. (DC), Florida (FL), Georgia (GA), Illinois (IL), Indiana (IN), Kansas (KS), Massachusetts (MA), Maryland (MD), Maine (ME), Michigan (MI), Minnesota (MN), Missouri (MO), Mississippi (MS), North Carolina (NC), New Hampshire (NH), New Jersey (NJ), New York (NY), Ohio (OH), Oregon (OR), Pennsylvania (PA), Rhode Island (RI), South Carolina (SC), Tennessee (TN), Texas (TX), Utah (UT), Virginia (VA), Vermont (VT), Washington (WA), and Wisconsin (WI). jobs.title: Assoc Director - Responsible AI
jobs.description: Posted Date 9/21/2026 Description #### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you'll be doing…** As the Associate Director of Responsible AI, you will lead Verizon’s enterprise\-wide efforts to ensure our artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies are developed, deployed, and scaled safely, ethically, and equitably. Sitting at the intersection of technology, law, and business, you will serve as the central authority on AI risk and governance as Verizon continues to integrate advanced AI across our global 5G network and customer experiences. * Defining, scaling, and managing Verizon’s enterprise\-wide Responsible AI (RAI) framework to align with global standards like the NIST AI RMF. * Co\-chairing the AI Governance Council, facilitating strategic reviews of high\-impact AI use cases, and establishing clear "go/no\-go" criteria for model deployment. * Designing and implementing AI auditing processes focused on bias mitigation, algorithmic fairness, transparency, and explainability. * Partnering with Legal, Privacy, and Public Policy teams to navigate the rapidly evolving AI regulatory landscape (e.g., EU AI Act, FTC guidelines) and ensure strict compliance. * Leading cross\-functional AI "red\-teaming" and stress\-testing initiatives to identify vulnerabilities and edge\-case failures in production models. * Collaborating with ML engineers and product managers to embed RAI checkpoints directly into the CI/CD pipeline and ML lifecycle (MLOps). * Developing comprehensive training programs to upskill Verizon’s workforce on AI ethics, data privacy, and responsible development practices. **What we're looking for…** You are a strategic leader who seamlessly bridges the gap between complex technical algorithms and enterprise risk. You have a deep passion for technology ethics and possess the unique ability to translate abstract principles—like fairness and privacy—into measurable engineering metrics and operational workflows. With exceptional stakeholder management skills, you are just as comfortable discussing prompt injection risks with data scientists as you are presenting governance strategies to C\-suite executives. **You'll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant work experience in technology policy, data governance, legal, risk management, or data science. * Three or more years of direct leadership experience in AI Governance, Responsible AI, Tech Ethics, or AI/ML Risk Management at an enterprise scale. * Deep understanding of machine learning lifecycles, generative AI technologies, and the specific ethical risks associated with Large Language Models (LLMs). * Demonstrated experience translating global AI and data regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, GDPR, CCPA) into enterprise compliance strategies. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A Master’s degree, JD, or PhD in Law, Public Policy, Computer Science, Data Ethics, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * Experience operating within highly regulated industries such as Telecommunications, Financial Services, or Healthcare. * Active certifications in privacy or risk (e.g., CIPP/US, CIPT) or relevant AI ethics credentials. * A proven track record of representing your organization in industry consortiums, academic partnerships, or standard\-setting bodies focused on AI ethics and safety. #### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. #### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 #### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. #### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $126,000\.00 \- $242,000\.00\. jobs.description: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. The Lead PLM \& Configuration Engineer is a n individual contributor responsible for disciplined configuration control and lifecycle governance of all CAD models, BOMs, and technical documentation within the PLM system. This role acts as the system authority ensuring data integrity, traceability and alignment across mechanical, electrical, and documentation domains throughout concept, NPI, production and sustaining phases. The position owns revision management, baselining, effectiveness, and ECR/EC N workflows, preventing data divergence while enabling scalable, repeatable engineering operations. The role is critical to supporting customer audits, compliance requirements, and product lifecycle traceability in complex, configuration\-driven product environments. **Key Responsibilities** **Configuration Control** **\& PLM Governance** * Own end\-to\-end configuration control for CAD models, BOMs, and technical documentation within the PLM system. * Ensure accurate revision management, baselining, effectivity, lifecycle states, and release readiness across all engineering artifacts. * Maintain alignment between CAD structures, EBOMs, MBOMs, and released documentation. * Serve as the authoritative source for released product data, ensuring integrity, traceability, and audit readiness. **Engineering Change \&** **Release** **Execution** * Own and enforce ECR/ECN workflows, ensuring changes are properly reviewed , approved, and traceable. * Manage as\-designed versus as\-built alignment across product variants and lifecycle phases. * Coordinate engineering release activities across mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, quality, and documentation teams. * Drive resolution of configuration, release, and data quality issues to support program schedules and business objectives . **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Agile Execution** * Lead release readiness reviews, change control boards, and cross\-functional working sessions. * Facilitate prioritization, action\-item tracking, and issue resolution across engineering teams. * Identify and remove blockers, manage dependencies, and drive accountability without direct supervisory authority. * Apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or similar execution methodologies to improve engineering workflow efficiency and predictability. **Data Governance \& Continuous Improvement** * Define and enforce naming conventions, metadata standards, classification structures, and release criteria. * Resolve configuration discrepancies, duplicate records, and data integrity issues. * Continuously improve PLM, configuration management, and release processes to increase engineering velocity and data quality. * Develop and maintain configuration management standards, best practices, and governance procedures. **Audit Readiness \& Traceability** * Ensure PLM data structures support customer audits, compliance requirements, and quality management systems. * Maintain traceable records linking requirements, designs, changes, configurations, and released products. * Support customer, regulatory, and internal audits through configuration history, impact analysis, and documentation retrieval. **Required jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, E-Commerce Platform
jobs.description: ### About Us: JetPens is a growing online retailer with over 20 years of history. We specialize in premium writing instruments and office supplies, and have been featured in Wired, New York Times, and CNBC. At JetPens, software is central to nearly every part of the company, from how customers discover and purchase products to how orders move through inventory and fulfillment. Our custom platform supports millions of customers and a complex physical operation. ### Role: * We are looking for a backend\-leaning Senior Full\-Stack Engineer to help build and evolve the software behind our e\-commerce business. * You’ll work directly with our principal engineer, help shape technical decisions, and modernize a successful platform through thoughtful, incremental improvements. * This is an opportunity for unusually broad ownership inside a stable, profitable business, not a narrowly defined role maintaining one small service. ### Responsibilities: * Design, build, test, and maintain features across JetPens’ customer\-facing e\-commerce site and internal business systems. * Own important work in areas such as checkout, payments, inventory, order processing, fulfillment, and customer communications. * Understand business problems, evaluate tradeoffs, propose solutions, and carry work through implementation and deployment. * Investigate difficult problems across application logic, relational data, third\-party integrations, and the production environment. * Improve application performance, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability. * Modernize the application through carefully scoped changes that preserve stability and business continuity. * Document systems, operational procedures, and architectural decisions so knowledge remains accessible and useful. ### Requirements: * A track record of independently designing, shipping, and maintaining significant production web features. * Strong backend engineering fundamentals in PHP or another server\-side language. * Strong SQL and relational\-database skills, including experience investigating performance and data\-integrity problems. * The ability to trace difficult problems across application logic, data, integrations, and the production environment. * Comfort working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript while remaining primarily backend\-focused. * Sound technical judgment, including the ability to explain tradeoffs, identify risks, and choose solutions appropriate to the problem. * Willingness to understand existing code and business behavior before changing them. * Clear written communication and disciplined documentation habits. ### Bonus Points: * Professional experience developing PHP applications. * Experience with e\-commerce, payment processing, inventory, ERP, or warehouse systems. * Experience improving database or application performance. * Familiarity with application infrastructure, caching, search, observability, or security. * Experience incrementally modernizing a large, mature application. * Experience working effectively on a small engineering team. ### Technology Environment: * Our platform is a large, mature web application built primarily with PHP and MySQL. + Most interfaces are server\-rendered, with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript used for customer\-facing and internal applications. * The broader environment includes Linux\-based production systems, containerized services, caching and search systems, and integrations with payment providers and other external services. * You do not need previous experience with every part of this environment. Strong backend engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn an unfamiliar codebase matter more than matching a checklist of tools. + Prior PHP experience is helpful but not required, but you must be interested in using PHP as your primary development language. ### Hours \& Pay: * Business hours are 9:00 AM PST \- 5:30 PM Pacific Time. * Anticipated starting salary range: + San Francisco Bay Area, New York City, and Seattle: - $185K \- $220K / year. + Other U.S. locations: - $155K \- $220K / year. * This role may be local or remote. + Remote employees must maintain at least four hours of overlap with Pacific Time business hours. + We prefer candidates who can be employed in the United States, but we may consider exceptional international candidates. * This is an exempt position. ### Benefits: * Benefits for eligible U.S. employees include: + Up to 99% company\-paid premiums for health, dental \& vision insurance. + Partial dependent health insurance. + Health flexible spending account. + Company\-paid long\-term disability \& life insurance. + Commuter benefits. * Benefits for all employees regardless of location include: + Paid time off. + Paid company holidays. + 401(k) retirement plan with 4% company match. ### Additional Perks: * Employee purchase discounts, employee product giveaways, company parties, \& free snacks. ### How to Apply: * Please apply via JobScore link: * Please include a resume with a cover letter. Applications without a cover letter will not be reviewed. * For candidates who are within 10 years of graduation, please also include a college transcript. JetPens is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under California law. Employment with the company is at\-will, meaning either the employee or the company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice.

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are building Kernel to power instant, simple payments across healthcare. Healthcare providers spend enormous amounts of time navigating insurance portals, practice\-management systems, phone calls, claims, denials, payments, and reconciliation just to get paid for care they have already delivered. **We think much of this work can and should be done by machines.** Kernel is an always\-on system that operates across the software healthcare practices already use. Our agents navigate practice\-management systems and payer portals, call insurance companies, verify coverage, submit and recover claims, reconcile payments, and increasingly handle the entire path from care delivered to money collected. We are starting with dental practices and building toward a much larger goal: making healthcare payments simple. **The role** We are looking for an exceptional engineer to join the founding team in New York. You will work directly with the founders and own major pieces of Kernel from idea to production. This is not a narrowly scoped engineering role. You might spend one week building an agent that operates legacy healthcare software, the next improving our verification infrastructure across thousands of sessions, and the next shipping a new payments product directly to clinics. **We are looking for an exceptional engineer to join the founding team and help us push these systems toward true autonomy.** **What you'll build** You will work directly with the founders on some of the hardest technical problems at Kernel. This may include: * Building computer\-use and browser agents that reliably operate legacy healthcare software * Training and improving models for healthcare\-specific actions and reasoning * Building post\-training pipelines using SFT, reinforcement learning, synthetic data, and production traces * Designing rigorous evals for long\-horizon agent behavior * Improving reliability across workflows that may require hundreds of actions and multiple external systems * Building model\-routing, inference, context, memory, and tool\-use infrastructure * Turning millions of real\-world agent interactions into training data * Building voice agents that communicate with insurance companies * Working with multimodal models across screens, documents, faxes, forms, and structured data * Reducing inference cost and latency while increasing task success * Building the product and infrastructure necessary to deploy these systems across thousands of healthcare practices **Who we're looking for** We care much more about what you can build than where you went to school or how many years you have worked. You may be a strong fit if you: * You are an exceptional programmer * You have unusually high technical ambition * You learn new systems very quickly * You have built serious projects outside of assigned work * You enjoy debugging problems where there is no Stack Overflow answer * You are comfortable moving between ML, infrastructure, product, and systems work * You want ownership rather than narrowly scoped tickets * You care about both speed and engineering quality * You want to work intensely with a small team in person in New York * You enjoy making things We are open to exceptional new graduates and early\-career engineers. We are also open to candidates from traditional ML, systems, infrastructure, robotics, compilers, distributed systems, or other technically demanding backgrounds if they can demonstrate exceptional ability. **How we work** Milo is a small engineering team in Manhattan. Engineers here do not sit several layers away from the problem. You might talk to a customer in the morning, inspect an agent failure, modify the runtime, run an experiment, and deploy the fix that afternoon. We expect engineers to own problems end to end. There are very few meetings, very little bureaucracy, and a very high bar for what we build. **Why Milo** AI is becoming capable of doing work, not just generating text. Healthcare is one of the largest industries in the world, but much of its financial infrastructure still depends on people manually moving information between fragmented systems. We think that changes over the next decade. Our goal is to build the autonomous infrastructure that gets healthcare providers paid. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years solving, we'd like to meet you. **Application** Please include: **1\. The most technically ambitious thing you have built.** Tell us what you personally built and include a link if possible. **2\. Your experience with modern ML systems.** This could include agents, model training, post\-training, reinforcement learning, evals, inference, multimodal models, or ML infrastructure. **3\. A difficult technical problem you encountered.** What was breaking, how did you diagnose it, and what did you change? **4\. Why Milo?** Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Happy hour * Health insurance * Paid time off * Snacks provided * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

This role begins on a standard 9am\-5pm schedule and transitions to first shift coverage, 6am\-2pm, as fleet operating hours expand. **What You'll Be Building** * Monitor robot behavior during live production operations. * Intervene quickly and safely to pause, stop, or reset robots when needed. * Document logs, sensor output, video, and reproduction steps for incident escalation. * Perform minor robot maintenance, including cabling, sensor swaps, fasteners, and basic component replacement. * Execute robot swap procedures, validate spare units, and return robots to production readiness. * Maintain accurate records of robot health, incidents, maintenance actions, and fleet status. * Translate field observations into clear priorities for robotics software and hardware fixes. * Identify recurring failure patterns and recommend improvements that reduce downtime. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Hands\-on experience working with robotic systems through work experience, technical programs, internships, academic robotics teams, or equivalent practical exposure. * Solid grasp of core robotics concepts, including kinematics, sensors, actuators, and control systems. * Working experience with ROS2, including nodes, topics, launch files, and debugging or introspection tools. * Comfortable with basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, including cabling, connectors, sensors, and fasteners. * Strong observational skills and sound judgment for quick, safe decisions during live operation. * Clear written communication skills for documenting issues and reporting to engineering teams. * Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. * Flexibility to begin on a standard 9am\-5pm schedule and transition to first shift coverage, 6am\-2pm, as fleet operating hours expand. **Bonus Points For** * Experience supporting robots or automated systems through a production rollout or pilot phase. * Familiarity with Nav2, Behavior Trees, or related robotics tooling. * Scripting experience with Python or similar tools for log review, data collection, or simple automation. * Experience with fleet management, monitoring dashboards, telemetry tools, or issue\-tracking systems. * Background in mechanical, electrical, robotics, or mechatronics engineering through a degree, technical program, or equivalent hands\-on experience. **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard\-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title**: Embedded Systems Engineer **Job Summary** System Level owner to lead the integration, configuration, and validation of embedded software within MCU\-based automotive controllers. This role operates at the intersection of firmware, controls (model\-based development), and vehicle integration, ensuring software is correctly built, configured, and validated for production release. The System Engineer is responsible for facilitating the integration of the mechanical, electrical and control systems of a propulsion or driveline system. Responsibilities include but are not limited to identifying, defining, and characterizing the connections between these systems and executing the functional, performance, and safety goals. **Responsibility*** Integrate firmware, middleware, application software, and configuration data into complete ECU builds. * Own build generation, versioning, and release packaging across multiple vehicle programs. * Maintain and improve build systems, integration scripts, and continuous integration / continuous development pipelines. * Validate memory layouts, software configurations, and calibration data prior to release. * Ensure alignment between software branches, feature content, and vehicle program milestones. * Integrate model\-based functional software components into production ECU software. * Ensure proper definition and implementation of software interfaces across application, middleware, and hardware layers. * Collaborate with controls engineers to integrate and validate auto\-coded algorithms (Simulink/Coder). * Support software architecture integration, whether AUTOSAR\-based or custom platforms. * Verify correct interaction between control algorithms, drivers, and system services. * Support software in lab, HIL, and vehicle environments. * Validate end\-to\-end system behavior including bootloaders, diagnostics, and communication stacks (CAN\-FD/LIN/SPI). * Troubleshoot integration issues across firmware, controls algorithms, and hardware interfaces. * Support ECU flashing, software updates, and vehicle\-level deployment activities. * Partner with calibration and vehicle teams to resolve issues identified during testing. * Work closely with firmware, controls, hardware, validation, and systems engineering teams. * Ensure all software inputs (code, models, configs, calibrations) are aligned and integration ready. * Support interface alignment, feature integration, and system\-level behavior consistency. * Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams on software deliverables and integration dependencies. * Investigate integration failures, ECU instability, communication issues, and unexpected system behavior. * Perform log analysis, trace debugging, and diagnostic evaluation (CAN traces, DTCs, etc.). * Drive root cause analysis across software layers and system interfaces. * Track defects and ensure resolution through cross\-team coordination. * Manage software baselines, version control, and traceability from development through production. * Maintain configuration management practices aligned with ALM tools (e.g., Polarion or similar). * Ensure proper documentation of releases, feature content, and known issues. * Support change management and impact analysis across integrated systems. This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of this position and it is not intended to be an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Academic/Educational Requirements** Four\-year degree in engineering or technology related field from an accredited Institution and 5 \- 10\+ years of experience in embedded software integration, development, or validation. **Required Skills/Experience** * Strong understanding of embedded systems and software architecture, including real\-time systems, application software integration, bootloaders and flashing, diagnostics (UDS, DTCs), and automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet). * Experience integrating software into MCU\-based automotive controllers (ECUs). * Familiarity with model\-based development (MATLAB/Simulink, Coder) and auto\-code integration. * Ability to understand control algorithms and their interaction with hardware and vehicle systems. * Hands\-on experience with build systems, scripting, or automation (Python, shell, CI/CD tools). * Strong debugging and system\-level root cause analysis skills. * Experience supporting software bring\-up in lab, HIL, and vehicle environments. * Familiarity with configuration management and ALM tools. * Strong collaboration and communication skills across cross\-functional teams. **What Linamar Has to Offer** * Competitive Compensation * Employee Benefits package includes but not limited to, Drug, Dental \& Vision etc. * 401k Program * Opportunities for career advancement. * Sustainability Counsel * Community based outreach supporting both local and global initiatives and charities. * Discounts for local vendors and events, including auto supplier discounts. **About Us** Linamar Corporation is a Canadian\-founded global manufacturer, renowned for its advanced engineering and innovative product development across diverse industries and markets. Our journey started in 1966 under the visionary leadership of our founder, and today, we remain committed to cultivating a culture of innovation and collaboration. With access to state\-of\-the\-art tools and resources, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact alongside a team of driven and passionate professionals. Join us and be part of a company where innovation, collaboration, and growth are at the heart of everything we do. Linamar Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and encourages diversity in the workplace without regard to any basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Linamar Corporation encourages applications from all qualified individuals and will reasonably accommodate applicants throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process upon request

jobs.description: At Lloyd Construction, we are not looking for just another employee — we are looking for the right person to become part of the Lloyd family. We believe construction is more than building projects. It is about building trust, relationships, careers, and communities. The Lloyd Way is rooted in teamwork, accountability, integrity, hard work, respect, and pride in doing things the right way. The Project Engineer will help coordinate communication between the Project Manager, Superintendent, Design Team, Owner, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders. This role is responsible for maintaining project documentation, tracking key project information, assisting with schedules and budgets, supporting field coordination, and helping ensure issues are communicated and resolved in a timely and professional manner. They will take ownership of their responsibilities, communicate clearly, and work well in a fast\-paced team environment. project plans and specifications, addressing any questions from field personnel. * Familiarity with design specifications and if applicable, owner specific specifications. * Understand structural Architect – Contractor (OAC) meetings, and assist in recording and distributing meeting minutes. * Oversee material procurement, tracking, and timely delivery of long\-lead items. **Project budget and schedule:** * Assist the Project Manager/Superintendent in creating and distributing the project schedule. * Understand the design cost estimate, change management and scopes of work. * Support the Project Manager in preparing and overseeing the project budget, including general conditions, subcontractor costs and other project related activities that could impact the overall project budget. * Monitor project progress and report any deviations from the plan. **Documentation** * Manage all project documentation, including plans, specifications, Request for Information (RFIs), submittals, Architect Supplemental Instructions (ASIs), logs, meeting minutes, proposal requests, inspections and project closeout documents. * As\-Builts: Keep the construction drawings up to date by red lining drawings when RFIs, ASIs, and PRs are issued and approved. * Assist Project Manager in change order management, creation, negotiation between Project Manager and Owner. * Create and distribute meeting minutes, documenting decisions, pertinent discussions and all issues impacting the project. * Support the project team with site safety documentation and coordination. * Assist in obtaining all project closeout material. * Help the project team with closeout activities including creation, distribution and tracking of punch list items. * Maintain understanding of all project related documents. * Ensure accurate records and logs. **Communication:** * Support the project team in maintaining alignment and positive working relationships among Subcontractors, the Owner, and the Architect/Engineer. * Communicate proactively with all parties, addressing their needs while balancing service excellence with business interests. * Support and collaborate with internal and external project team members. * Ensure Management is informed as to the progress of the project, its financial status and current relations with the Owner\-Architect. * Assist the Project Manager in ensuring the project team understands th f reports from the owner or design team such as field observation reports to notify subcontractors of deficiencies. * Report any on\-site emergencies, safety concerns, or critical issues promptly to the Superintendent and Project Manager. **Qualification Requirements** * **Construction and Engineering Expertise**: In\-depth knowledge of construction and engineering processes, industry practices, and advanced construction techniques. Certification as an Associate Estimating Professional is a minimum requirement. * **Technical Proficiency**: Effective computer skills, including proficient use of Word, Excel, Outlook, Procore, Bluebeam, Excel estimating software, and cloud\-based take\-off software. * **Communication Abilities**: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective interpersonal relationships. Excellent presentation skills. * **Work Ethic and Passion**: Strong work ethic and dedication to timely tasks. Passionate about construction, process improvement, and professional development. * **Management and Organizational Skills**: Thorough in all aspects of the position. Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously. Effective organizational and time management skills. * **Team and Client Focus**: Works well in a team environment. Commitment to excellent client service. * Minimal travel is needed. * Valid driver’s license, reliable vehicle, and proof of insurance. * Pass a drug screen **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field such as Architecture or Architectural Engineering **OR** 5\-7 years of commercial construction or industrial construction project management experience. * ProCore Certification and experience * Proficient in both verbal and written communications. * Computer literate and proficient in Excel, Word, Procore, Microsoft Project. **Physical Demands** * May involve periods of standing. * Regularly required to work with a computer * Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stand, stoop, kneel, crouch, and/or crawl. * Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds * Specific vision abilities include close vision, the ability to adjust focus, and color vision. **Benefits** * Competitive Salary \+ Bonus (**Salary will be based on experience**) * Numerous team\-building events * Very generous holiday schedule * Medical, Dental and Vision Plans * Short\- and Long\-Term Disability * 401K (\+ Match) * Paid Time Off **About Us** At Lloyd Construction, we take pride in our reputation for delivering quality projects, building lasting client relationships, and creating a workplace where people feel valued, supported, and part of something bigger. The Lloyd Way is about more than construction. It is about family, teamwork, trust, accountability, and pride in our work. We believe in investing in our people, helping them grow, and providing opportunities to build a meaningful career — not just hold a job. As a member of the Lloyd team, you will be surrounded by people who care about the work, care about each other, and care about the communities we serve. We are looking for individuals who want to learn, contribute, lead, and grow with us. At Lloyd, you are not just joining a company. You are joining a family and building a career. Lloyd is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to status as a protected veteran or a qualified individual with a disability, or other protected status, such as race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or age. jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Test Management Platform
jobs.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software\-defined vehicle architecture, our award\-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in\-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility. Engineering Workflow Platforms builds and operates the software Lucid uses to run its vehicle programs. Five products are live in production today, covering the planning bill of materials, engineering change management, software feature ownership, release readiness, and test fleet and vehicle build management. They are not five separate tools. Each one is a window onto a single data model that reconciles six systems of record, including Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, SAP, MES, Auros, Jira, and Salesforce into one trustworthy answer to whether a program is ready for its next gate. We are forward deployed. We sit directly with Program Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Supplier Quality. We set our own OKRs and report against them in Monthly Business Reviews. AI\-assisted work is core to how we operate, and it is what allows a team this size to carry this much surface area. The team is small, and it is growing. **Role:** We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own verification and test management across the platform. That is the chain that runs from a requirement, to the test cases derived from it, to the runs that execute those cases, to the result a gate review accepts as evidence. The scope covers hardware and software. On the hardware side the platform has to carry the DVP, test requests, sample and build allocation, lab and track capacity, and the DV and PV campaigns behind each program gate. On the software side it has to carry suites running in CI, on bench, on HIL, and in vehicle, tied to a release candidate and to the feature they verify. The role is not the DVP owner and does not run tests. Test and Validation engineering does both, and will continue to. This will own the tooling they work in, the data model underneath it, and whether the coverage and evidence that come out of it survive a gate review. This is an internal product role, not a validation engineering role. This role is based in Phoenix, AZ and requires employees to be onsite five days a week. **Key Responsibilities:** * Capability Ownership: Verification and Test Management + Own the strategy and roadmap for test case management and test run management as one connected capability, and carry that area into the platform roadmap. + Own the traceability model that links requirement to test case to test run to result to defect, and hold it steady as new programs, new variants, and new test types arrive + Sequence delivery against real vehicle program gates, and be able to state which gate a given scope or staffing decision causes us to make or miss + Define the coverage and readiness measures a gate review actually uses + Own source\-of\-truth decisions inside your area across systems and define the reconciliation rules + Protect the integrity of the model against expedient one\-off requests, and be able to explain the refusal in terms the requester accepts + Work through with the manager what belongs in the data model, in a pipeline, in the application, and in a process outside the system entirely * Requirements and Traceability + Make coverage answerable on demand: which requirements have test cases, which cases have run, which runs passed, and what is left before the gate + Drive migration off legacy requirements and test tooling, including the data cleanup and the working habits that migrate with the data + Keep the verification evidence an audit or a safety case requires attached to the object that produced it * Test Case and Test Run Management + Own the architecture of the test case library: authoring, review, reuse across variants and programs, versioning, and the link back to the requirement each case verifies + Own the paradigm for traceability of execution: campaigns and plans, scheduling against labs, benches, rigs, tracks, and test fleet vehicles, results capture, retest, deviations and waivers, and defect linkage + Make hardware and software execution reconcile into a single program\-level verification picture rather than two parallel ones + Partner with test enginee a number before repeating it * Effective use of GitHub Copilot or comparable AI assistants across research, analysis, prototyping, and drafting, with the judgment to verify output rather **Preferred:** * Automotive, aerospace, medical device, or hardware NPI domain depth: DVP, DV and PV campaigns, phase gates, launch quality, or program milestone governance * Requirements management at automotive scale, including traceability across product, system, component, and functional safety levels, and understanding of legacy tool such as Jama, DOORS, Polarion, or Codebeamer * Test management tooling experience: Xray, Zephyr, TestRail, Polarion, Auros, or an equivalent, including the coverage and reporting layer above it * Familiarity with automotive test infrastructure * Functional safety exposure, including ISO 26262 and ASIL decomposition * Automotive SPICE familiarity, particularly the system and software verification processes and what an assessment expects to see * Phase gate or stage gate product development process governance, and the executive reporting layer above it * PLM experience, particularly Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE and ENOVIA, or Siemens Teamcenter or an equivalent * Depth in the Atlassian ecosystem: Jira architecture at scale, Jira Assets as a master data model, and applications built on Atlassian Forge * Experience building AI\-assisted workflows into a product practice, including standards for how AI\-generated analysis and specifications are reviewed At Lucid, we don't just welcome diversity \- we celebrate it! Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and expression, marital status, and any other characteristic protected under applicable State or Federal laws and regulations. **Compensation** **\& Benefits:**Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non\-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. jobs.title: Sr. Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Backend Engineer **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a senior, hands\-on engineer to own the technical integrity and delivery of a core backend platform. Working within established architectural direction, you will make build\-versus\-configuration decisions, uphold engineering quality, and serve as a technical anchor for a small specialist team. This is an expert\-level engineering engagement focused on building and delivering production software—not an advisory or oversight role. The work centers on core software development and transaction processing that supports the operational backbone of a live system. It is not an analytics, data\-warehousing, or business\-intelligence position. Required Qualifications Candidates must demonstrate experience across all of the following areas: · **Hands\-on engineering experience:** 8–12 years of hands\-on development experience, including recent work personally built and delivered, which you can discuss in depth. · **Event\-driven architecture:** Designed and built event\-driven systems using event sourcing, CQRS, or comparable architectural patterns—not simply consumed or published messages through a message bus. · **Domain modeling:** Strong judgment in distinguishing genuinely new domain patterns from variations of established ones. · **Security and tenant isolation:** Implemented server\-side multi\-tenant or multi\-party isolation, with authorization revalidated on every request. Understand event integrity, and encryption in transit and at rest. · **Delivery ownership:** Accountable for execution, quality, timelines, and clear communication. Surfaces risks early and exercises sound escalation judgment. · **AI\-assisted development:** Fluent with modern AI coding tools and able to direct, review, and verify generated code and tests—catching plausible but incorrect output rather than relying on passing checks alone. · **Test strategy:** Able to define what a test suite must prove, identify coverage gaps, and assess whether generated tests meaningfully validate behavior. · **Programming and data:** Strong Python skills, with working proficiency in relational databases and read\-model/projection design. · **Cloud\-native development:** Serverless\-first experience, using object storage and serverless compute as primary building blocks. Comfortable with containers and local cloud emulation. · **Team and decision\-making:** Works effectively in a direct, fast\-moving small team; executes within established architectural decisions without repeatedly reopening settled choices. Key Responsibilities \& Technical ExpectationsArchitecture and domain design · Design and build event\-driven systems, including event sourcing and CQRS where appropriate. · Make sound domain\-modeling decisions and distinguish new patterns from extensions of existing ones. · Translate intent into precise, actionable specifications that enable implementation right the first time. · Make build\-versus\-configuration decisions within the established architectural direction. Security by design · Enforce tenant and party isolation on the server side, with authorization checked for every request; never rely on URL paths or UI behavior as security boundaries. · Protect event and transport integrity through authenticity and tamper\-evidence measures, such as message signing. · Ensure encryption in transit across external boundaries and internal service calls. · Apply encryption at rest to relational data, event logs, and object/lakehouse storage, including customer\-managed key requirements where applicable. · Review AI\-generated code for injection risks, exposed secrets, and authorization bypasses before integration. Testing, verification, and CI · Set the testing standard and define the CI checks required before code can be merged. · Use unit and integration testing, service mocking/stubbing, test\-data generation, and local cloud emulation. · Review generated tests for meaningful coverage of edge cases, error paths, and security or data boundaries—not just successful execution. · Ensure humans appropriately review and gate AI\-generated changes. Delivery and collaboration · Own assigned scope through completion, maintaining quality and delivery discipline under time pressure. · Drive outcomes proactively rather than waiting for detailed direction or pre\-written tickets. · Communicate status and trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. · Identify risks early and distinguish decisions to make independently from issues requiring escalation. · Work productively from principles and open problems within a small, fast\-moving team. Implementation environment · Build cloud\-native, serverless\-first solutions with object storage and serverless compute. · Package compute using containers and support containerized local development. · Use local cloud emulation to develop and test cloud\-dependent functionality. · Maintain working capability with relational databases and read\-model/projection design. Preferred / Advantageous Experience · Configuration\-driven platforms where change is primarily absorbed through configuration rather than code rebuilds. · Cloud\-native architecture, streaming, event\-processing platforms, and serverless systems. · Federated or keyless CI credentials, secrets management, and least\-privilege access design. · Container orchestration experience (helpful, but not required). · Experience in a data\-intensive, operationally complex industry. Technical Assessment The assessment will include a deep dive into a system you personally built, secured, and delivered. You should be prepared to explain how you enforced tenant isolation and protected data in transit and at rest, how you would specify a non\-trivial feature, how you verify implementation results, and how you determine whether a test suite genuinely demonstrates correctness. Pay: From $60\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Estimator / Project Manager (Heavy Civil)
jobs.description: **Job Description** Marwood General Construction is a Service Disabled Veteran Owned heavy civil contractor working federal, municipal, and private civil projects across Kitsap and the surrounding counties. We self perform our work. Earthwork, utilities, structures, paving, site clearing, concrete flatwork, demolition, and hauling. We own our iron and we run our own dirt. Our market runs in three lanes. Federal work through NAVFAC and Naval Base Kitsap is a growing part of our pipeline. Municipal and public agency work is steady. Private commercial site development rounds it out. We are also OMWBE certified and a participant in the WSDOT Capacity Building Mentorship Program. This position is a dual hat seat with real ownership. You take a job from bid invitation through award, then carry that same job through buyout, execution, and closeout. You are accountable for the margin you wrote into it. That structure is deliberate. Estimators who never build their own work develop expensive blind spots. We want someone who has to live with their numbers, because that is what makes a number honest. A lot of our people are veterans, and it shows in how we run. We hire self starters who can move without direct supervision, make a sound call, own the outcome, and tell us straight what happened. We are small enough that this hire will visibly move the company, and established enough that the work is already there. You will not be a cog in an estimating department. You will build it. Duties **Estimating** * Own bids end to end. ITB review, site visit, quantity takeoff, unit pricing, subcontractor and vendor solicitation, bid day close, and closeout feedback back into the cost library. * Price earthwork, utilities, structures, and paving for federal, municipal, and private civil work in the $500K to $10M range. * Build production rate based pricing from crew composition, equipment fleet cost, and realistic daily output. Not gut feel and not a marked up unit price book. * Model earthwork: cut and fill balance, shrink and swell, mass haul, import and export pricing, and unsuitable material strategy. * Build prevailing wage by trade and classification, including fringe, travel, and shift differentials. * Make the self perform versus subcontract call with the operations team and defend the number to the owner. * Identify and price risk explicitly. Differing site conditions, dewatering, utility conflicts, permit driven schedule constraints, restricted access, environmental windows. * Track your own hit rate and margin, run post bid debriefs, and know why you won and why you lost. * Work with Marwood's AI assisted takeoff and OS\-Est estimating brain as a force multiplier. **Project Management** * Own the job from award through warranty expiration. You are the single person accountable for whether a job makes money and whether the owner would hire Marwood again. * Contract review, buyout, subcontracts, purchase orders, and submittals. * Baseline schedule development and ongoing schedule management. * Job cost setup, weekly cost to complete forecasting, and projected margin. * Change orders identified and priced the day the extra work occurs, not at closeout. * Progress billing, retainage, and collections. * Washington public works compliance. Intents and affidavits, certified payroll coordination, and prevailing wage documentation. * Owner, agency, engineer, and inspector relationships. RFIs and submittal logs. * Production reviewed weekly against field data, with the estimate corrected by what the field actually did. * Punch list, closeout, as builts, retainage release, and final acceptance. * You direct the job through the Superintendent and supervise the Project Coordinator on assigned jobs. You report to the Operations Manager. **Requirements** * Three or more years of hands on heavy civil estimating where you personally performed the takeoff and the pricing. Admin or takeoff support does not count. Estimating gained solely at a design firm, an owner's rep, or a vertical GC that subs out all sitework does not qualify. * You have built a complete bid solo, start to finish, and can name the project, the bid value, and how the job performed against your number. * Public works contract administration. Submittals, RFIs, change orders, schedule, and owner facing communication. * Working experience in HeavyBid/HCSS or an equivalent such as B2W or Bid2Win. * Ability to read civil plans and specifications unaided, including grading and drainage plans, utility profiles, geotechnical reports, TESC plans, and permit conditions. * Advanced Excel. Nested logic, lookups, and pivot tables should be routine. * Clean, professional written communication. You will write RFIs, change order narratives, and correspondence that agencies and owners read. * Authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. * Valid driver's license and an insurable driving record. Driving between job sites, pre bid walks, and agency offices across Kitsap, Pierce, King, and surrounding counties is an essential function of this position. * Able to perform site walks on active construction sites and in undeveloped terrain, in Pacific Northwest weather, wearing required PPE. **Strengthens an application** Civil engineering or construction management degree. Primavera P6 or MS Project. Existing Kitsap County owner, subcontractor, supplier, or trucking relationships. Federal construction experience including NAVFAC or USACE, base access, and Buy American compliance. WSDOT or APWA standard specifications. Experience with Bid Express, WEBS, Builders Exchange of Washington, LCPtracker, or SAM.gov. Field background as an operator, foreman, or superintendent before moving into the office. Certifications such as CPE, CCP, CPC, OSHA 30, HAZWOPER, or CESCL. We are a family. We look out for each other and we hold a high bar for each other. If you need a rule written for every action before you take it, this is not the company for you. If you want to be handed a plan set and trusted to take it to a sealed bid, then hand the keys to your own job and make the number come true, this is the seat. You will help build our estimating system rather than inherit someone else's, and the person who builds it gets to decide how it works. The work is already on the table. What we need is someone who wants to own it. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Opportunities for advancement * Paid time off Application Question(s): * 1\. Name one civil project you personally estimated from start to finish. Give the scope, the approximate bid value, whether you won it, and how the job performed against your number — including the amount you missed by. 2\. Which takeoff and estimating platforms have you personally built an estimate in? For each, state what you did in it — built crews and resources, set up activities, closed on bid day, or viewed someone else's file. 3\. Describe the last time you priced earthwork. How did you handle shrink/swell and haul, and did the site balance the way the plan said it would? 4\. Describe a Washington public works job you estimated or managed. What did you do for prevailing wage build\-up, and how did you handle intents, affidavits, or certified payroll? Work Location: In person

extensive health coverage, deferred compensation plan, and employee pension plan. jobs.description: Site: Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** The Postdoctoral Fellow will support and help lead a multidisciplinary research initiative focused on advancing laryngology through real\-time machine learning, computer vision, and quantitative analysis of laryngoscopy videos. This role will involve developing, testing, validating, and translating algorithms that track laryngeal anatomy, classify examination states, extract clinically meaningful video\-derived metrics, and support future clinical decision\-support tools. The fellow will work with laryngologists, clinical research staff, engineers, and collaborators at Mass Eye and Ear and Mass General Brigham to move the project from proof\-of\-concept research toward reproducible, clinically useful deployment.
