jobs.title: Senior Director, Growth Technology & Platforms (WIP)
jobs.description: Know where you belong! Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products \- it’s the foundation of every team we hire. When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week. Marketing is becoming more data\-driven, automated, and AI\-enabled—and the technology behind it needs to evolve just as quickly. Across Match Group, we have an opportunity to build shared capabilities that help our brands make better decisions, move faster, and scale what works across the portfolio. The **Senior Director, Growth Technology \& Platforms** will lead the team responsible for **MarTech Engineering, Marketing Data Foundations, Technical Program Management, and Organic Growth.** You’ll set the strategy and roadmap for these capabilities, make clear prioritization and investment decisions, and connect business needs to scalable technology and growth solutions. You’ll lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of approximately 10 people spanning engineering, data, program management, and organic growth. You’ll bring these disciplines together as one cohesive organization, developing technical leaders and functional experts while building shared capabilities used across a global portfolio of consumer products. As the function’s impact grows, the team and remit have the potential to expand into additional areas of Growth Technology. Near\-term priorities include strengthening our **marketing data and technology foundations to enable better measurement and audience activation; scaling AI\-enabled automation and performance intelligence; advancing creative technology; and expanding experimentation capabilities** across the portfolio. You’ll determine how to sequence these investments based on business value, technical readiness, and where shared capabilities can create the greatest leverage. This role is part of Match Group’s Global Media \& Growth organization, supporting Tinder, Match, Hinge, and our broader portfolio of brands. ### **How You’ll Make an Impact:** * **Growth Technology Strategy \& Roadmap:** Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for the function, translating brand and portfolio growth needs into scalable capabilities and measurable impact. Make thoughtful build, buy, and partner decisions that maximize the value of our technology investments. * **Team \& Capability Leadership:** Lead and grow a multidisciplinary organization spanning engineering, data foundations, technical program management, and Organic Growth. Establish clear ownership, strong operating rhythms, and a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and business impact. * **MarTech \& Data Foundations:** Lead an integrated platform function to build the shared technology, data, and delivery foundations that power measurement, audiences, activation, experimentation, and creative technology across the portfolio. Establish a scalable operating model that aligns technical capacity to the highest\-value brand and portfolio needs. * **Organic Growth \& AI Discovery:** Position Match Group for the next era of organic discovery by building a centralized capability across SEO, ASO, GEO, and AI Search. Develop the team, tooling, and playbooks that help brands act on emerging opportunities and scale learning across the portfolio. * **AI\-Powered Growth Operations:** Build on our early momentum to scale AI\-enabled capabilities across campaign automation and performance intelligence.Identify and advance human\-in\-the\-loop and agentic solutions that improve how Growth teams plan, execute, and make decisions. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Partner with brand and functional leaders across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Analytics, and AI/ML to identify high\-value opportunities and mobilize teams to bring them to life. Build alignment around shared priorities and connect expertise across the organization to accelerate impact. ### **We Could Be a Match If:** * You have 12\+ years in marketing technology, growth engineering, or platform leadership, including experience building and leading multidisciplinary teams across engineering, data, program management, product, or growth * You have led a platform or technology capability with a clear roadmap, prioritization model, and accountability for business impact * You have experience making build, buy, and partner decisions, including managing technology vendors, to maximize the value of technology investments * You bring the technical depth to engage credibly with senior engineers, evaluate architecture and platform tradeoffs, and understand how data, identity, audiences, activation, and automation come together in a modern growth ecosystem * You have experience partnering closely with Analytics, Advanced Data Science, Applied Science, or ML teams, translating their measurement and experimentation needs into technical requirements, and operationalizing model outputs into scalable growth systems and workflows * You have experience supporting consumer growth or performance marketing ecosystems, including mobile marketing, paid media activation, first\-party signals, and audience infrastructure * You have experience applying automation, predictive intelligence, or AI\-enabled workflows to marketing or growth use cases * You can move effectively between executive\-level strategy and operating detail, driving complex initiatives in matrixed organizations and communicating decisions, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations clearly to senior leaders ### **Bonus Points:** * Experience in consumer subscription or multi\-brand portfolio businesses * Exposure to SEO, ASO, GEO/AI Search, or other Organic Growth capabilities * Experience with creative technology, personalization, or conversion optimization $260,000 \- $300,000 a year*Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job\-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered.* *This salary range is reflective of San Francisco, CA or Palo Alto, CA.* *The salary range for Los Angeles, CA is $240,000 \- $280,000\.* *For all other locations, this salary may be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.* **\#LI\-LH1** ------------- **Why Match Group?** Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer: ***Mind \& Body***– Medical, mental health, and wellness benefits to support your overall health and well\-being ***Financial Wellness***– Competitive compensation, 100% employer match on 401k contributions up to 10% (cap at $10,000\), as well as an employee stock purchase program to help you feel supported in your financial security ***Unplug*** – Generous PTO and 14 paid holidays so you can unplug ***Career***– Annual training allowance for professional development and ERG membership opportunities and events so you feel connected and empowered in your work ***Family*** – Families come in all shapes and sizes so we offer 20 weeks of 100% paid parental leave, fertility, adoption, and child care resources, as well as pet insurance and discounts ***Company Gatherings*** – We host company events where our employees get to know each other and build a sense of connection and belonging! *We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we value the rich dynamics that diversity brings to our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation, sex (including pregnancy and sexual harassment), gender identity or expression, uniformed service or veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. Period.* *If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the hiring process — such as during pre\-employment testing or interviews — please indicate this by selecting “Yes” in the accommodation request field. We’ll reach out to discuss your needs if you're selected for the interview stage.* *\#MG* .

jobs.title: PLC Programmer/Robot Integrator
jobs.description: **Company Summary** Our client is a growing industrial automation and systems integration company that designs, builds, and commissions automation solutions for manufacturers across a variety of industries. The organization works with PLCs, robotics, collaborative robots, conveyors, machine interfaces, sensors, controls, and other industrial automation technologies. The company is expanding its automation capabilities and is looking to add an experienced controls professional who can contribute to projects from programming and integration through installation and commissioning. This is an opportunity to join a growing team where the individual will have meaningful technical responsibility and the potential to grow into a broader leadership role as the business expands. **Job Summary** The **PLC Programmer / Automation Integration Engineer** will be responsible for programming, integrating, troubleshooting, and commissioning industrial automation systems. This position will have a strong emphasis on PLC programming and controls while also involving robot and collaborative robot integration, machine communication, HMI development, networking, sensors, motion control, and system troubleshooting. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on automation professional who enjoys solving complex technical problems and working directly with equipment and customers. The ability to work across multiple automation platforms is more important than having deep expertise in one specific manufacturer or technology. The position is based in **Syracuse, New York**, with some flexibility for remote work when project requirements allow. The individual will spend time at the company's facility as well as customer sites during installations, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project implementation. **Responsibilities** * Program and modify PLC control systems using Ladder Logic, Structured Text, SFC, and other IEC 61131\-3 programming environments. * Develop and modify HMI/SCADA applications for machine operation, diagnostics, alarms, recipes, and system monitoring. * Integrate industrial robots and collaborative robots into automated production systems. * Configure and troubleshoot communication between PLCs, robots, cobots, CNC machines, conveyors, HMIs, sensors, drives, and other equipment. * Integrate industrial networks and communication protocols including EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, and similar technologies. * Configure and troubleshoot servo drives, VFDs, motion systems, and high\-speed I/O. * Configure robot signals, sensors, pneumatic systems, safety devices, machine interfaces, fixtures, and other field I/O. * Assist with control system design, I/O development, electrical schematic review, device selection, and panel checkout. * Commission automation systems both internally and at customer facilities. * Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, controls, networking, and software issues and determine root causes. * Perform PLC upgrades, machine communication improvements, controls modifications, and automation retrofits. * Provide technical support during customer installations and production startups. * Configure remote\-access systems and provide remote troubleshooting support when appropriate. * Document PLC programs, network configurations, startup procedures, and system modifications. * Train customer maintenance and technical personnel on equipment operation and troubleshooting. * Work directly with customers to understand technical requirements and develop practical automation solutions. * Support technical sales activities, project planning, site assessments, and customer meetings when needed. * Develop reusable programming standards, function blocks, templates, and other tools to improve future projects. * Travel to customer locations for project assessments, installations, commissioning, and troubleshooting. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of hands\-on PLC programming experience in an industrial automation, controls, manufacturing, or systems integration environment. * Strong practical understanding of industrial automation and controls. * Experience programming PLCs and troubleshooting control systems in a production environment. * Working knowledge of IEC 61131\-3 programming environments, including Ladder Logic and/or Structured Text. * Experience integrating PLCs with robots, machines, conveyors, HMIs, sensors, drives, and other industrial equipment. * Working knowledge of industrial communication and networking, particularly EtherNet/IP and/or EtherCAT. * Ability to read electrical schematics and troubleshoot control panels using appropriate diagnostic equipment. * Experience with servo drives, VFDs, motion control, or related automation technologies. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently research issues and identify root causes. * Ability to work comfortably on the plant floor and directly with machinery and automation equipment. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact professionally with customers, operators, maintenance personnel, and engineering teams. * Ability to manage projects and technical assignments with a high degree of independence. * Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25–40% for customer projects. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel throughout the United States. * Ability to work in a hands\-on environment involving equipment installation, startup, testing, and commissioning. **Preferred Requirements** * Experience programming or integrating collaborative robots or industrial robots. * Experience with FANUC, Universal Robots, Doosan, or similar robotic platforms. * Experience with palletizing, packaging, material handling, machine tending, or conveyor automation. * Experience with CODESYS\-based platforms, Rockwell Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, Beckhoff TwinCAT, Panasonic, or similar PLC platforms. * Experience with vision systems such as Cognex, Keyence, or robot\-integrated vision. * Experience with end\-of\-arm tooling, pneumatic systems, vacuum systems, and robotic grippers. * Experience with safety PLCs, safety\-rated devices, machine guarding, and industrial robot safety standards. * Experience with remote\-access systems, VPNs, industrial networking, or OT network architecture. * Experience with edge devices, industrial PCs, or gateway technologies. * Robot manufacturer certifications or formal robotics training. * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Technology, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. * Experience developing reusable PLC code, function blocks, programming standards, or automation libraries. * FANUC training or certification is a plus; additional training may be provided. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Salary: **$90,000–$110,000**, depending on experience and capabilities. * Performance or project\-based bonus opportunity. * Possible monthly vehicle/car allowance. * Company\-paid business travel and travel\-related expenses. * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) with company match. * Paid time off and company holidays. * Company laptop, tools, and equipment necessary to perform the role. * Training and certification opportunities on new automation, robotics, and controls platforms. * Opportunity for increased responsibility and advancement as the automation business continues to grow. **Location** **Syracuse, New York** This is a primarily on\-site position. The successful candidate will need to be available to work with automation equipment at the company's Syracuse\-area facility and travel to customer locations for project implementation, installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting. Travel is expected throughout New York and the Northeast, with additional projects potentially requiring travel to the Southeast and other locations within the continental United States. Some remote work may be possible when project requirements permit. Typical customer assignments may include an initial site visit to assess the application and develop an implementation plan, followed by an installation and commissioning period. Travel frequency will vary based on the project schedule, with some assignments requiring overnight stays.

jobs.title: Principal Test Development Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities: MaxLinear is seeking a Principal Test Development Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will focus on the following: * Develop ATE test solutions for highly integrated RF SoC ICs for Wireless, Cable, and High\-Speed Interconnect transceiver applications * Lead cross\-functional discussions on testability architecture, design for test, efficient test solution development, and ATE test HW design * Define, document, and drive best practices within test engineering team * Drive R\&D experiments for new hardware and software design concepts * Evaluate new software/automation tools to improve test development efficiency * Provide training and technical guidance to junior test engineers in the team * Interact with test ecosystem to enable test solutions that meet our business needs * Communicate clearly with all levels within the company * Assist with attracting and hiring top talent * Accountable for the KPIs (test coverage, test cost, product spec compliance) for test engineering Qualifications: * Strong background in RF, Mixed Signal, and Digital principles * Expertise in developing multi\-site production test solutions for complex RF SoCs using Advantest 93K wave scale and port scale test system. Experience with other test systems is a plus * Experience in C, C\+\+, Java, VB, LabView, or automation scripting (PERL, PYTHON, or MATLAB) * Experience in developing high\-performance RF ATE hardware * Experience with electronic bench\-test equipment \- oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, pulse and signal generators, power supplies, DC source/measure * Proven track record of leading test development and taking multiple RF SOCs to high\-volume production * BS in Electrical Engineering or related \+ 9 years of experience, or MS \+ 7 years of experience Compensation and Benefits: MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock\-based compensation. MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $142,000to $191,000 Annually We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off. The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role\-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all\-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Company Overview: MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ\-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system\-on\-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio\-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed\-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi\-market applications. We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner. MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high\-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high\-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long\-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end\-to\-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs. Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore. We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside\-the\-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high\-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

supporting warehouse, distribution, purchasing, inventory, sales order, and EDI business processes. * Create documentation including business requirements, technical designs, test plans, and implementation procedures. * Partner with business stakeholders to identify process improvements and recommend technology solutions. * Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve application issues and user and maintain system performance, reliability, and data integrity. * Participate in a rotating 24/7 on\-call support schedule and provide after\-hours support when required. * Perform other duties as experience. * 5\+ years of software development experience in an IBM i (AS400/iSeries) environment. * Strong functional and technical experience with RPG development. * Demonstrated experience creating business requirements, technical specifications, test scripts, and supporting user testing. * Experience supporting and resolving production application issues. * Strong analytical, jobs.title: Area Chief Engineer
jobs.description: **Area Chief Engineer – Regional Hotel Engineering \& Facilities Operations** **Start Your Journey with Midas Hospitality** Midas Hospitality is seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands\-on Area Chief Engineer to provide engineering leadership across a portfolio of hotels within an assigned region. This position serves as the technical leader for multiple properties while maintaining direct responsibility for a designated home hotel. Working closely with the Corporate Director of Engineering, Regional Operations Leaders, General Managers, and property engineering teams, the Area Chief Engineer drives operational excellence through preventative maintenance programs, capital improvement projects, engineering team development, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate is an accomplished hotel engineering professional with extensive technical expertise, exceptional leadership skills, and a passion for developing engineering teams while protecting hotel assets and maximizing operational efficiency. **What You Will Be Doing** As the Area Chief Engineer, you will provide leadership and technical expertise for engineering operations across multiple hotel properties. **Responsibilities include:** **Regional Engineering Leadership** * Oversee engineering operations for multiple hotels while maintaining direct responsibility for your assigned home property. * Ensure all hotels maintain safe, reliable, and efficient building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, elevators, fire/life safety systems, and building infrastructure. * Partner with General Managers and Regional Operations Leaders to establish engineering priorities and operational goals. * Provide engineering support during hotel acquisitions, renovations, transitions, and new property openings. **Preventative Maintenance \& Asset Management** * Develop, implement, and continuously improve preventative maintenance programs across the region. * Monitor work order completion, preventative maintenance compliance, and engineering performance metrics. * Conduct quarterly engineering inspections, work order audits, and property assessments while documenting findings and action plans. * Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability and extend asset life. **Capital Projects \& Engineering Initiatives** * Collaborate with Corporate Engineering on capital improvements, renovations, ADA compliance projects, and building upgrades. * Manage project timelines, contractor coordination, and engineering budgets. * Support implementation of new engineering technologies and building automation systems. * Identify and implement energy conservation initiatives involving HVAC systems, lighting, water usage, and utility management. **Leadership \& Team Development** * Coach, mentor, and develop Chief Engineers and engineering associates across the region. * Support recruiting, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and ongoing training initiatives. * Establish standardized engineering procedures and best practices. * Promote a culture focused on safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional service. **Compliance \& Safety** * Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, brand standards, life safety requirements, and local building regulations. * Oversee fire and life safety inspections, emergency preparedness, and regulatory compliance initiatives. * Maintain engineering documentation, certifications, and maintenance records. **Operational Support** * Assist hotels with complex repairs involving HVAC, refrigeration, electrical, plumbing, mechanical systems, and building infrastructure. * Provide temporary engineering leadership for hotels experiencing staffing shortages or leadership transitions. * Support additional engineering projects and regional initiatives assigned by Corporate Engineering leadership. **What You Bring** * Previous hotel Chief Engineer or multi\-property engineering leadership experience required. * Experience managing engineering operations for multiple hotels preferred. * Strong knowledge of: + HVAC systems + Electrical systems + Plumbing + Refrigeration + Boilers + Fire \& Life Safety Systems + Building Automation Systems + Preventative Maintenance Programs * Experience leading engineering teams and developing technical talent. * Knowledge of OSHA, EPA, ADA, and local building code requirements. * Experience managing capital projects and engineering budgets. * Experience with CMMS/work order management software and preventative maintenance systems. * Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and project management skills. * Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required. * Willingness to travel regularly between assigned hotel properties. **Physical Requirements** This position requires frequent standing, walking, climbing ladders, bending, reaching, lifting, and travel between hotel properties. Candidates should be able to lift, push, or move up to 40 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation. Work is performed in hotel engineering spaces, mechanical rooms, rooftops, guest areas, and outdoor environments, with occasional exposure to varying temperatures, mechanical equipment, electrical systems, noise, and cleaning chemicals. Travel throughout the assigned region is required. **What We Offer** At Midas Hospitality, we believe in investing in our associates and providing opportunities for growth and success. Eligible associates may receive: * Growth and development opportunities and access to learning resources * Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) * Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Hotel travel discounts * Career advancement opportunities * Associate recognition programs **About Midas Hospitality** Founded in 2006, Midas Hospitality is a premier hotel development, management, and investment company with more than 1,000 associates and a portfolio of over 60\+ hotels across 14 states. Through partnerships with Marriott, Hilton, and IHG, we are committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences while fostering a people\-first culture built on growth, teamwork, and opportunity. Our associates are the foundation of our success. We invest in professional development, encourage innovation, and provide meaningful opportunities for career advancement within a collaborative and inclusive workplace. Midas Hospitality is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintains a drug\-free workplace.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack TypeScript Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** Seeking a senior full\-stack TypeScript engineer to construct the web platform through which enterprise users manage our multi\-tenant control plane powering AI infrastructure. This interface allows organizations to establish tenancy, orchestrate GPU resources, configure access policies, and observe cluster metrics in real time. Responsibilities encompass the full web stack: React components integrated with our design system, Next.js server logic for authentication and API proxying to backend Go services, and automated client SDK generation. Collaborating with distributed teams across North America, Europe, and Asia, you will drive frontend features from design phase to production deployment, delivering resilient, information\-dense web tools for system administrators. **Main Responsibilities:** * Build product features end to end in a modern Next.js and React application — server components, route handlers, client interactivity, and the data layer that connects them. * Develop and extend the shared component library and design tokens, implementing Figma specs faithfully across light and dark themes. * Own the server tier that sits between the browser and the platform: request proxying, session handling, and keeping backend service URLs and credentials securely off the client. * Implement authentication and authorization in the web tier — OIDC login against the platform auth service, JWT claim verification, session expiry, and role\-based UI gating that mirrors platform permissions. * Maintain the generated TypeScript SDK produced from the platform's OpenAPI specification, including the codegen pipeline, compatibility gates, and drift detection against the live API. * Partner with backend teams on API contracts — push back when a response shape does not efficiently serve the UI, and negotiate the change rather than building front\-end workarounds. * Build a resilient data layer: caching, invalidation, optimistic updates, pagination, and honest loading/error states for highly dynamic infrastructure data. * Write tests at every level — component tests with mocked network behavior, and Playwright end\-to\-end suites that run against live environments. * Ensure accessibility, responsive behavior, and optimal web performance (bundle size, render cost, and what ships to the browser on each route). * Instrument the application for production: error tracking, product analytics, feature flags, and structured logging. * Review peers' code, debug production issues to root cause with regression coverage, and mentor junior engineers through design reviews. **Qualifications** **Required Skills/Abilities:** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering, including deep production experience with TypeScript and modern React paradigms. * Next.js architecture mastery: deep understanding of the server/client component boundary, caching strategies, and server\-side rendering. * Genuine full\-stack range: comfortable and secure owning server\-side code and API proxies, not just browser\-based logic. * Practical web\-tier security experience: implementing OAuth2/OIDC flows, JWT verification, and secure cookie/session management. * Architectural fluency in managing complex application state, specifically bridging server\-state synchronization with client UI updates. * Strong CSS architecture and design\-system practice — utility\-first CSS, scalable theming, and accessible component APIs built on headless primitives. * Testing discipline across unit, component, and end\-to\-end layers, including network mocking and CI integration. * Experience working in a monorepo with shared packages and a task\-graph build system. * Clear written English for design docs, review comments, and asynchronous collaboration across global time zones. **Must Have** (We expect deep production experience in several of these, and the engineering fundamentals to learn the rest rapidly) * Core: TypeScript, React 19, Next.js (App Router), Node.js 22\+. * Styling \& Components: Tailwind CSS v4, headless primitives (Base UI, Radix), CVA, design tokens, and theming. * Data: TanStack Query, Zod validation, and OpenAPI\-generated TypeScript clients. * Auth: OIDC/JWT session handling in a server tier (jose or equivalent), cookie security, and role\-based access control. * Testing: Vitest, Testing Library, MSW, and Playwright. * Tooling: pnpm workspaces, Turborepo, ESLint, Prettier, and GitHub Actions. * Production: Error tracking and product analytics (Sentry, PostHog, or equivalent), and Docker\-packaged deployment. **Nice to Have** * Kubernetes or cloud infrastructure product experience (familiarity with the domain this application exposes). * GPU infrastructure or AI/ML platform UI work. * Rich editor integration ( YAML editing and validation), map/geospatial visualization, animations (motion.dev and/or CSS) * Web performance optimization: Core Web Vitals, bundle analysis, streaming, and partial rendering. * Feature\-flag driven delivery and experimentation. * Design\-system ownership (Ladle, Storybook, visual regression testing). * OpenTelemetry or structured client\-side logging. * Go familiarity, for reading the backend services behind the API contract. * CNCF or React/TypeScript ecosystem open\-source contributions. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science \& Engineering or related field or 10 years related experience. **Additional Information** **What does Mirantis offer you?** * Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry; * Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next\-generation cloud technologies; * Be a part of cutting\-edge, open\-source innovation; * Thrive in the high\-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk\-taking, and continuous growth are valued; * Professional development and training; * Attend conferences and working groups; * Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks; * Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan. We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Job Description** At Mission Pet Health, our passion for pets and their families fuels our ambition to build the world's greatest veterinary organization. We are scaling toward 1,000 hospitals and 20,000\+ teammates, and the data behind that growth runs across hundreds of clinical, financial, HR, and marketing systems. We're hiring a Solutions Architect to own the end\-to\-end design of the platform that ties it all together — and to stay hands\-on while doing it. **This is a hybrid opening in Birmingham, AL.** **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own the target\-state architecture for the data platform end\-to\-end — ingestion, storage, modeling, serving, and governance. * Set the direction for our analytical layer on SQL Server, SSAS, and ClickHouse, and for our integration fabric across Azure Data Factory, REST APIs, NATS, and CDC. * Design and operate event\-driven, service\-oriented workloads on Kubernetes in Go and Python. * Make AI\-driven development a core focus of the team: build and adopt agentic tooling (code\-aware agents, retrieval over our own schemas and lineage) so engineers ship faster, with better tests and documentation, and so routine work gets automated rather than repeated. * Define the data contracts, schema standards, and quality SLAs that engineering and analytics teams build against. * Embed PII/PHI handling, access control, and auditability into the platform * Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and translate executive intent into delivery roadmaps. **Responsibilities and Benefits** **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE** * 8\+ years across data engineering, software engineering, or platform architecture * Deep hands\-on experience with T\-SQL, SQL Server at scale, SSAS, and Azure Data Factory. * Production experience with ClickHouse (or a comparable columnar engine such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks). * Strong production\-grade skills in Python, Go, or a comparable backend language — and the discipline to write the code, not just the diagrams. * Comfort designing event\-driven systems (REST, NATS or Kafka, CDC) and operating workloads on Kubernetes. * Genuine fluency with AI\-assisted engineering — coding agents, LLM tooling, retrieval, evals — and a point of view on how to do it responsibly inside a regulated, multi\-site business. * A track record of partnering with executives and turning ambiguous business problems into durable technical designs. * Reside in or be willing to relocate to Birmingham, Alabama and work onsite. **NICE TO HAVE** * Veterinary, healthcare, or multi\-site retail/services experience, particularly with Practice Information Management Systems (PIMS). \#INDHQ

jobs.description: **Substation Project Assistant** Mitsubishi Electric Power Products, Inc. (MEPPI) is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented **Project Assistant** to support our Substation Division. This role provides critical support to Project Managers, Project Engineers, and Service Managers through project coordination, material tracking, documentation management, scheduling support, and administrative activities that contribute to the successful execution of customer projects. This is an excellent opportunity for an early\-career professional looking to grow their experience in project coordination, engineering projects, supply chain support, and project management within the utility and electrical infrastructure industry. ### **What You'll Do:** **Project Execution \& Coordination** * Maintain project Bills of Materials (BOMs) and track material requirements throughout project execution. * Enter and manage purchase orders within business systems and monitor order status to support timely deliveries. * Track and document material receipts and inventory transactions. * Perform document control activities related to drawings, specifications, transmittals, and technical documentation. * Coordinate transportation services for incoming and outgoing shipments, including material returns. * Support project scheduling activities by assisting with schedule creation and updates. * Participate in project review and scheduling meetings and prepare meeting minutes, action item logs, and project documentation. * Assist with site inventory tracking, material management, and project checklists. **Project Administration \& Reporting** * Prepare project reports, status updates, charts, and graphs to support project management activities. * Maintain project data and generate reports utilizing business systems and project tracking tools. * Prepare, review, and maintain purchase order records and documentation. * Support project teams through administrative activities including filing, document preparation, and special projects. * Assist with maintaining accurate project records and supporting project closeout activities. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Work closely with Project Managers, Project Engineers, Supply Chain, Service, and Operations teams to ensure project objectives are met. * Develop and maintain positive working relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders. * Promote a professional image of MEPPI through responsive and collaborative customer support. ### **What You Bring:** * **Education:** Associate's Degree in Business, Technical Studies, or a related field. * **Experience:** + **1–3 years of experience supporting large projects**, project coordination activities, or related administrative functions. + Experience supporting engineering, construction, utility, manufacturing, or industrial projects is a plus. **Skills \& Expertise** * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams. * Ability to work collaboratively within a team\-oriented environment. * Experience with ERP systems, project management software, or document control systems is a plus. ### **Why MEPPI?** * **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** 90% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision plans * **Retirement Plans:** 401(k) with company match up to 4% * **Generous Paid Time Off:** Vacation accrual after 90 days plus 12 paid holidays * **Career Development:** Training programs and educational assistance * **Employee Perks:** Profit sharing, wellness programs, and 24/7 fitness center access ### **Join Us** At MEPPI, you'll play an important role in supporting projects that strengthen the electrical infrastructure powering communities and industries across North America. As a U.S. affiliate of Mitsubishi Electric, we combine global expertise with local execution—providing opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to meaningful projects. **Equal Opportunity Employer** MEPPI welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. **Notice to Agencies and Search Firms** MEPPI does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms. jobs.title: Principal Architect
jobs.description: MSIG USA continues to grow! **Company Overview:** MSIG USA is the US\-based subsidiary of MS\&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc., one of the world’s top P\&C carriers and a global Class 15 insurer, with A\+ ratings and a reach that spans 40\+ countries and regions. Leveraging our 350\-year heritage, MSIG USA brings the financial strength, expertise, and global footprint to offer commercial insurance solutions that address your business’s unique risks. The Principal Architect serves as a senior technology leader responsible for defining and advancing the enterprise architecture strategy across applications, data, integration, analytics, and artificial intelligence capabilities. This role ensures that business solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with enterprise objectives while enabling innovation, operational efficiency, and business growth. This role is expected to operate at both strategic and hands\-on levels, providing architectural leadership across solution design, platform modernization, data ecosystems, AI adoption, cloud transformation, and enterprise integration initiatives. The ideal candidate combines deep technology expertise with strong business acumen, systems thinking, and the ability to translate business strategy into practical architecture and execution plans. The Principal Architect is also expected to champion responsible adoption of emerging technologies, including AI and GenAI capabilities, while ensuring appropriate governance, security, compliance, risk management, and business value realization. **Essential Functions** ======================= **Application Architecture \& Solution Design** ----------------------------------------------- * Lead architecture efforts for enterprise applications, platforms, and digital experiences. * Define target\-state application architectures that support business agility, scalability, resilience, and operational excellence. * Drive application modernization strategies include cloud adoption, platform consolidation, API enablement, and service\-oriented architecture. * Partner with engineering and product teams to establish scalable application patterns, reusable services, and shared capabilities. * Guide solution architecture decisions for major initiatives while balancing business priorities, technical constraints, risk, and cost considerations. * Promote reuse, simplification, and standardization across applications and platforms. * Ensure architecture decisions support long\-term maintainability, performance, security, and operational supportability. **Enterprise Data Architecture** -------------------------------- * Define and evolve enterprise data architecture strategies, including operational, analytical, reporting, and AI data foundations. * Establish data architecture standards covering data domains, master/reference data, metadata, lineage, governance, and quality management. * Partner with business and data leaders to define enterprise information models and common business data definitions. * Drive adoption of enterprise data platforms and capabilities supporting reporting, analytics, machine learning, and AI initiatives. * Ensure data architectures support traceability, auditability, scalability, regulatory compliance, and business transparency. * Lead architecture decisions involving data integration, data movement, event\-driven architectures, APIs, and enterprise information exchange. * Identify opportunities to improve data accessibility, quality, consistency, and business value across the organization. **AI Strategy, Architecture \& Enablement** ------------------------------------------- * Define enterprise AI architecture and adoption strategies aligned with organizational goals and responsible AI principles. * Partner with business leaders to identify and prioritize AI use cases that improve productivity, decision\-making, customer experiences, and operational outcomes. * Establish architectural patterns, standards, and governance for AI, GenAI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and decision\-support capabilities. * Drive integration of AI capabilities into business applications, workflows, analytics platforms, and enterprise processes. * Collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and risk stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are implemented responsibly and securely. * Provide guidance on AI platforms, model lifecycle management, prompt engineering practices, knowledge management, and AI operationalization. * Promote AI literacy and adoption across business and technology teams through education, coaching, and enterprise enablement activities. **Technology Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement** --------------------------------------------------- * Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, business stakeholders, product teams, and delivery organizations. * Facilitate architecture workshops, strategy discussions, solution reviews, and technology planning sessions. * Translate complex business oud adoption, or data platform initiatives. * Experience implementing enterprise data, analytics, machine learning, or GenAI solutions preferred. * Insurance industry experience strongly preferred. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** ================================== * Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, application architecture, data architecture, integration patterns, and cloud technologies. * Strong systems\-thinking mindset with the ability to understand complex interactions across people, process, data, applications, and technology ecosystems. * Expertise in enterprise integration, APIs, event\-driven architecture, and distributed systems. * Strong understanding of data management principles, governance, metadata, lineage, analytics, and information architecture. * Familiarity with AI, GenAI, machine learning, agent\-based architecture, knowledge retrieval, and intelligent automation platforms. * Ability to balance strategic vision with practical execution and delivery realities. * Strong business acumen and the ability to align technology investments with measurable business outcomes. * Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. * Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority across large, matrixed organizations. * Experience with cloud platforms, enterprise data platforms, Azure ecosystem technologies, Microsoft Copilot, and AI\-enabled productivity tools. * Strong leadership and mentoring skills with a passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and technology excellence. ### **Success Measures** The Principal Architect is successful when: * Enterprise architecture decisions consistently support business outcomes and technology strategy. * Application, data, and AI investments accelerate business modernization and operational efficiency. * Technology platforms become more scalable, reusable, secure, and maintainable. * Data is increasingly trusted, accessible, governed, and leveraged for decision\-making. * AI capabilities deliver measurable business value while meeting governance and responsible AI standards. * Architecture practices improve delivery quality, speed, alignment, and organizational effectiveness. This would likely align at a **Director\-equivalent IC level (Principal Architect)** and position the role as one of the senior\-most architecture leaders below a Chief Architect or Head of Enterprise Architecture. SALARY: The estimated salary range for this position is $240,000\.00 \- $270,000\.00 per year. This is a good\-faith assessment of the salary range for this position only. In determining the actual salary within this range, MSIG USA will consider a candidate’s relevant experience, location, and other job\-related factors. Additional Benefits: Healthcare and Retirement Benefits Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) with a generous employer match and profit\-sharing contribution Wellness incentive program Life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD\&D) insurance Flexible spending programs Short\-term and long\-term disability plans Additional Benefit Programs Paid time off program Paid charitable leave Paid parental leave Tuition reimbursement program Personal insurance (auto/homeowners) discounts \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-REMOTE, \#LI\-HYBRID, \#LI\-ONSITE It's an exciting time for our company and a great opportunity to join a financially sound and growing global insurance group! It is the policy of MSIG USA to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, MSIG USA will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Security Architecture - DGX Cloud
jobs.description: NVIDIA DGX Cloud is an AI Factory designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial\-scale breakthroughs. As a Principal Engineer for Security Architecture, within our Security Engineering organization, you will own a core security domain of the AI factory: the architecture, the paved road that delivers it, and much of the code underneath. You will hold the security design bar across DGX Cloud from inside the teams doing the building, and this is a founding seat on a new team. Security Engineering is a new organization at DGX Cloud, accountable for the security outcome of the platform, and Security Architecture is the function inside it that holds the design bar. Security here is fleet horizontal and stack vertical, so your work will cross every DGX Cloud engineering organization: you will embed with the teams building GPU clusters, control planes, and services, join their designs as a participant rather than an approver, and leave behind systems in which an entire class of risk is no longer possible. There is no architecture review board here and no approval queue. You are a senior IC with deep security domain knowledge, and the security bar holds because you helped set it and then helped ship it. **What You Will Be Doing:** * Own a Security Domain End to End: Take architectural ownership of a core domain of DGX Cloud security, from the design through the system running in production. That could be tenant and GPU workload isolation, workload identity, infrastructure and network, supply\-chain provenance, hardened baselines and patching, or deploy\-time policy and admission control. * Embed with the Teams Building It: Join the design early, write the code, and help land it. The posture is not "you did this wrong." It is "here are the considerations we need to meet, I will help, let's go to work." * Build Paved Roads, Not Gates: Engineer the secure path into the platform so that it is also the easy path. You are measured by whether teams take that path by default, not by the number of requirements you have written down. * Engineer Classes of Risk Out of Existence: Finding a vulnerability is 4% of the work; building the system where it cannot happen again is the other 96%. When teams keep missing the same requirement, the paved road is wrong, and fixing the road is our job rather than theirs. * Threat Model and Attack the Design: Run deep\-dive threat models across the substrate, the orchestration layer, and the tenancy boundary, then go after your own designs offensively and feed what you find back into the baselines, the guardrails, and the detections. * Carry the Bar into Execution: Turn the DGX Cloud security bar into reference architectures, requirements, and golden paths teams can build against. Raise gaps early, in the design, with the work to close them attached. * Multi\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with DGX Cloud platform, production engineering, and network security teams, and with NVIDIA's central security organization, to make the secure path real in CI/CD and in the hardware lifecycle. We operate horizontally across vertically organized teams, with influence rather than authority. **What We Need to See:** * Security and Infrastructure Engineering: Experience (typically 15\+ years) across software engineering, SRE, infrastructure, and security engineering. You build systemic solutions rather than performing manual operations or "tool administration." * Production\-Grade Coding: A strong software engineering background with the ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code. You should be comfortable building and operating production services at scale. * Emerging Technology: You work with what is new rather than waiting for it to settle. Today that means writing and reviewing AI\-generated code at the volume it now arrives, putting AI\-assisted analysis to work in your own security engineering, and building for agents that act inside the systems you own. Tomorrow it will mean something else. * Security Architecture in Practice: Designs you own that actually got built and run, in areas like multi\-tenant isolation, identity and access, policy enforcement, vulnerability management, or detection engineering. You stayed on to operate them. * Threat Modeling and System Design: Proven ability to build threat models for complex distributed systems, identify the architectural gaps rather than only the bugs, and engineer the solutions that close them. * Distributed Systems and Linux Depth: Cloud\-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and hands\-on Linux systems security including kernel\-level primitives (eBPF, AppArmor, or SELinux). * Influence Without Authority: Experience landing designs through teams you do not own, in environments where credibility and relationships, not org charts, determine whether the work ships. * Foundation: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience) with 15\+ yrs of relevant experience. **Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:** * HPC/AI Security: Experience securing high\-performance computing environments, RDMA\-based networks, large GPU fleets, or GPU\-specific security challenges. * Cloud\-Native Identity and Attestation: Expertise in workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE), hardware root of trust (TPM/HSM) integration, or confidential computing. * Offensive Depth Turned Defensive: Real exploitation, red team, or security research experience that you have converted into engineering: the controls, guardrails, and detections that closed what you found for good. * Open Source Impact: Notable contributions to security\-focused open\-source projects or a track record of engineering\-focused security research. How have you represented and helped advance the industry? NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High\-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for great people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. This includes reviewing existing station drawings, verifying equipment ratings and condition, evaluating interactions with other in\-flight projects, and conducting site visits to understand constraints and challenges. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Geospatial
jobs.description: Imagine having the power to stress\-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. We use advanced machine learning to create engineering\-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure. By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network\-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future. Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe. **Data Scientist, Geospatial** We're looking for a Data Scientist, Geospatial to join our Houston team, supporting a key regional electric utility. You’ll work directly with their team to build physics\-backed models on Neara, leveraging complex datasets like LiDAR, GIS, asset records, and weather data. Your work will directly prevent wildfires by simulating vegetation encroachment, predict grid failures under extreme weather loads, and inform capital investment decisions to harden critical infrastructure. **What You Will Do:** * Embed and collaborate directly with customer geospatial and GIS teams in a hybrid setting, spending time on\-site at their offices to deeply understand their data workflows, integrate systems, and solve complex spatial challenges. * Build predictive risk models on Neara that combine LiDAR, terrain models, and weather data to simulate conductor sag, sway, and vegetation fall\-in risks to directly prevent wildfire ignitions. * Translate complex spatial and structural risk metrics into defensible, data\-driven insights that inform utility capital investment decisions for grid hardening. * Build and maintain robust spatial data pipelines to ingest, clean, vectorize, and integrate diverse geospatial data formats from our utility partner. * Establish QA/QC benchmarks for spatial accuracy, coordinate reference system (CRS) transformations, and structural alignment across disparate data sources. * Mentor others in best practices for model training, data analytics, and building data\-driven products. **Who You Are:** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in data science or machine learning. Geospatial data or power grid domain experience is a plus. * Strong quantitative intuition for data, with excellent communication skills and proven experience presenting complex findings to customers and senior leaders. * Experience working in fast\-paced, high\-growth scale\-up technology environments is a plus. * Self\-driven with a bias for action; comfortable taking full ownership of complex projects and adapting quickly to shifting priorities. * Natural collaborator who thrives at the intersection of technical teams (ML, Software) and external customer stakeholders. * Grounded, resourceful approach to problem\-solving, with a track record of navigating messy, real\-world datasets to deliver clear, business\-driven outcomes. **What We Offer:** * Work with an industry\-leading, multi\-modal spatial data stack \- including airborne LiDAR, high\-resolution satellite imagery, and physics\-enabled digital twins \- to solve real\-world engineering challenges at immense scale. * Your spatial modeling will directly mitigate wildfire risks, optimize utility vegetation management, and harden critical infrastructure across millions of kilometers of energy grids. * Shape the spatial architecture of our core product line while collaborating with top\-tier ML and software engineers. * Enjoy a highly competitive compensation package with a significant equity component, ensuring you are a true stakeholder in our rapid global scaling. \#LI\-NT1 \#LI\-DNP Compensation Range: $140K \- $150K

jobs.description: #### **About Neura:** Neura Health is a nationwide, doctor\-led practice built to eliminate the barriers between patients and life\-changing care. This mission is powered by our multidisciplinary specialized care teams, which include world\-class physicians, nurse practitioners, physician associates, and dedicated care coaches. Backed by $22M in funding from world\-class investors, we are not just improving neurology; we are revolutionizing it. We are looking for purpose\-driven innovators to join us in making high\-quality brain health a reality for everyone. At Neura Health, we are constantly looking for clinicians who want to work at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and some of the hardest problems in healthcare.
