If you want real responsibility, real velocity, and the chance to build something transformative from the ground up, this is the place for you. **About the Founders:** * Liz Burstein is the CEO and was previously Head of Product at Maven Clinic, Director of Product at Zocdoc and Senior Product Lead at LinkedIn. She has fifteen years of experience in the tech industry, and a wealth of knowledge in the health tech domain. * Sameer Madan is the CTO and was previously an engineer at Facebook for 9 years. At Facebook, Sameer was the technical lead for Live Video, and built several well known products such as Facebook Mentions, threaded\-ranked comments, and more. *Neura is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these or any other characteristics protected by law.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future\-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast\-paced, mission\-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. **What** **we're** **looking for:** We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to help us build and optimize tech solutions to accelerate our sustainable energy future. At Nexamp, you'll be part of an engineering squad focused on multiplying the efficiency of how we raise and deploy billions of dollars of capital into low\-downtime solar power plants. You'll focus on internal financial modeling tools and will drive impact by writing quality code, steering projects from conception to completion, helping refine our processes, and guiding more junior team members. This role will be hybrid, based out of our Boston office, and you will report to your squad's Tech Lead. **What you'll do:** * Deliver value: Internalize our objectives and deliver measurable change for Nexamp and our customers. * Write code: Design, implement, and deploy reliable and efficient production software in our React/Django/Azure stack. * Elevate your squad: Actively collaborate in sprint planning, execution, code reviews, demos, and retrospectives. * Architect for maintainability: Own design decisions across the stack. Establish and execute scalable patterns, standards, and best practices for the squad. * Grow others: Guide and inspire more junior developers across the organization through mentorship and collaboration. * Grow yourself: Continually seek ways to level\-up your own skills and make a bigger impact throughout the company. **What you'll bring:** * 7\+ years of full stack software development experience at companies with 10 or more developers. * Experience building financial forecasting software is a plus. * Experience building and optimizing consumer\-facing frontend applications in React and TypeScript. * Experience developing and optimizing web\-based solutions in modern Python, ideally using Django, FastAPI, or similar frameworks. * Robust understanding of web standards, infrastructure (databases, storage, caching, content delivery, etc.), and cloud platform offerings. * Effectively communicate and collaborate with users and business stakeholders, facilitating software and process requirements. * Experience leveraging debugging expertise and a proven track record of independently solving problems. * Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases. * Familiarity with version control systems like Git, CI/CD pipelines for automated testing \& deployment, and infrastructure tools like Terraform. * Understanding of cutting edge AI tools and a commitment to leveraging them to rapidly deliver high quality software. * Ownership mentality and initiative to make improvements to code, processes, and user experiences across the organization. * Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today. * Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization. * Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. * Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. * Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. * Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions. ***If you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.*** ***At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.*** **You'll** **love working here because:** Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer\-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more! **Compensation:** *The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $170,000 \- $190,000\. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non\-annual sales incentive plans, or other non\-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company's stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location.* *Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third\-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Staff DevOps Engineer, IaC
jobs.description: **About the Role** As a **Staff DevOps Engineer**, you'll own how code gets from commit to production at NinjaOne — designing and continuously improving the release and deployment pipelines that let engineering teams ship quickly, safely, and often. This role sits at the intersection of CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code, and it's built for someone who thinks in modules, state files, and plan/apply workflows, not manual console changes. Terraform is our IaC standard, and you'll be the architect behind it — building a cloud\-agnostic foundation that scales across teams today and extends to a multi\-cloud future (AWS now, Azure/GCP as we grow). You'll operate at both a strategic and hands\-on level: setting deployment and IaC standards org\-wide, mentoring engineers, and partnering closely with Development, QA, Security, and IT to keep our release process fast, secure, and resilient. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants to own the "last mile" of software delivery — turning builds into safe, repeatable production deployments backed by clean, modular infrastructure code — and who's excited to shape that strategy as we expand into new regions and cloud providers. **Location** \- We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states \- **CA**, **CO**, **CT**, **FL**, **GA**, **\*IL**, **KS**, **MA**,**MD, ME**,**NJ**, **NC**, **NY**,**OH,** **OR**, **TN**, **TX**, **VA**, and **WA**. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.* *Onsite interviews* *may be required* *for this role.* We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on **Java**, **Kotlin**, **C\+\+**, **Golang** and **Postgres**; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in **AWS**. Knowing large\-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client\-server architecture will help you. **What You’ll be Doing*** **Own the CD/Release Pipeline****:** Design, build, and continuously improve delivery pipelines — from artifact promotion through progressive rollout (blue/green, canary, rolling) to production, with automated health checks, gating, and rollback. Build the CI/CD framework with particular depth on the CD half: release orchestration, environment promotion, deployment gating, automated rollback. Automate release management across services and regions — deployment scheduling, change tracking, feature\-flag\-driven rollout, coordinated multi\-service releases. * **Lead Terraform/****IaC** **Strategy \& Architecture****:** Serve as technical authority on the Terraform codebase: module design, remote state management (backends, locking), workspace/organization strategy, versioning, provider pinning, RBAC for infra changes, and secrets management — built to scale across dozens of teams without conflict. Define the cloud\-agnostic architecture (abstraction layers, reusable module libraries, naming/tagging conventions) that lets this extend from AWS to Azure/GCP as the company grows multi\-cloud. * **Establish Governance \& Guardrails****:** Implement policy\-as\-code and automated compliance/security/cost scanning (Sentinel, OPA, Checkov, Infracost, or similar) directly into the Terraform pipeline so infra changes are safe, auditable, and cost\-aware by default. * **Drive Org\-Wide Adoption****:** Partner with every engineering team to migrate existing infrastructure onto the new Terraform architecture; build documentation, golden\-path templates, and training so teams outside DevOps/Deployment Engineering can safely author their own IaC. * **Drive Cross\-Cloud Infrastructure Delivery****:** Design, develop, and deploy secure, compliant infrastructure in AWS (current primary cloud) via Terraform, shaping module/architecture strategy so the standard extends cleanly to Azure/GCP as those environments come online. * **Monitor, Support, and Respond****:** Proactively monitor deployment pipelines, release health, Terraform plan/apply activity, and infra alerts/metrics. Serve as technical escalation point for production support, including after\-hours. Own incident response, rollback, and remediation decisions for both deployment and infrastructure issues. * **Mentor the Team****:** Coach engineers on release engineering, deployment safety, Terraform best practices, and IaC code quality. * Other duties as needed. **About You*** 10\+ years cloud DevOps (AWS\-primary), with strong emphasis on release engineering, deployment automation, and IaC. * Multi\-cloud production experience required — AWS plus hands\-on, production\-grade work in Azure and/or GCP (not theoretical portability). * 4\+ years hands\-on, production\-grade Terraform — module authoring, remote state (S3/DynamoDB), workspaces, provider version management, safe plan/apply in CI/CD. * **Deep CD experience** (not just CI) — progressive rollout strategies, automated rollback, supporting infra as code. * Proven enterprise\-scale **Terraform** architecture experience — remote state design, module registries, versioning/governance policy, multi\-team access control. * Real multi\-cloud IaC architecture experience — built/operated a cloud\-agnostic architecture in production, not just designed portable\-in\-theory modules. * Terraform ecosystem tooling (Terragrunt, Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, Atlantis, Sentinel/OPA, Checkov) — plus. * **Track record driving org\-wide IaC adoption** — migrations, golden\-path templates, enabling other teams. * Agile/version\-control tooling: Jira, Confluence, Git, BitBucket. * Deep CI/CD tooling expertise, with hands\-on **CircleCI**experience strongly preferred; we're especially interested in candidates who've owned the CD/release side of the pipeline — including the provisioning layer — not just build/test automation. * Expert in cloud ops — scalability, reliability, maintainability through full deployment lifecycle. * Track record reducing lead time, change failure rate, time to recover. * Ability to coach/mentor. * 7\+ years \*nix (Linux, MacOS, BSD, AIX). * 5\+ years scripting (Shell, Go, Python, PERL, Tcl/Tk) for deployment tooling/Terraform providers. * 5\+ years monitoring/alerting/observability, including drift detection against Terraform state. * Kubernetes/ECS experience (Helm, Kustomize) including cluster/node provisioning via Terraform — highly desirable. **About Us** NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140\+ countries. The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years. **What You’ll Love** We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community. We honor your flexibility needs with full\-time work that is hybrid remote. We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance. We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan. We prioritize your work\-life balance with our unlimited PTO. We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement. **Additional Information** This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.* Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self\-relocate. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job\-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey, or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $180,000 \- $240,000 per year. For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $180,000 \- $240,000 per year. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment. \#LI\-KS2 \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-Hybrid \#BI\-Remote \#BI\-Hybrid

This role sits at the intersection of CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code, and it's built for someone who thinks in modules, state files, and plan/apply workflows, not manual console changes. Terraform is our IaC standard, and you'll be the architect behind it — building a cloud\-agnostic foundation that scales across teams today and extends to a multi\-cloud future (AWS now, Azure/GCP as we grow). You'll operate at both a strategic and hands\-on level: setting deployment and IaC standards org\-wide, mentoring engineers, and partnering closely with Development, QA, Security, and IT to keep our release process fast, secure, and resilient. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants to own the "last mile" of software delivery — turning builds into safe, repeatable production deployments backed by clean, modular infrastructure code — and who's excited to shape that strategy as we expand into new regions and cloud providers. **Location** \- We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states \- **CA**, **CO**, **CT**, **FL**, **GA**, **\*IL**, **KS**, **MA**,**MD, ME**,**NJ**, **NC**, **NY**,**OH,** **OR**, **TN**, **TX**, **VA**, and **WA**. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.* *Onsite interviews* *may be required* *for this role.* We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on **Java**, **Kotlin**, **C\+\+**, **Golang** and **Postgres**; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in **AWS**. Knowing large\-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client\-server architecture will help you. **What You’ll be Doing*** **Own the CD/Release Pipeline****:** Design, build, and continuously improve delivery pipelines — from artifact promotion through progressive rollout (blue/green, canary, rolling) to production, with automated health checks, gating, and rollback. Build the CI/CD framework with particular depth on the CD half: release orchestration, environment promotion, deployment gating, automated rollback. Automate release management across services and regions — deployment scheduling, change tracking, feature\-flag\-driven rollout, coordinated multi\-service releases. * **Lead Terraform/****IaC** **Strategy \& Architecture****:** Serve as technical authority on the Terraform codebase: module design, remote state management (backends, locking), workspace/organization strategy, versioning, provider pinning, RBAC for infra changes, and secrets management — built to scale across dozens of teams without conflict. Define the cloud\-agnostic architecture (abstraction layers, reusable module libraries, naming/tagging conventions) that lets this extend from AWS to Azure/GCP as the company grows multi\-cloud. * **Establish Governance \& Guardrails****:** Implement policy\-as\-code and automated compliance/security/cost scanning (Sentinel, OPA, Checkov, Infracost, or similar) directly into the Terraform pipeline so infra changes are safe, auditable, and cost\-aware by default. * **Drive Org\-Wide Adoption****:** Partner with every engineering team to migrate existing infrastructure onto the new Terraform architecture; build documentation, golden\-path templates, and training so teams outside DevOps/Deployment Engineering can safely author their own IaC. * **Drive Cross\-Cloud Infrastructure Delivery****:** Design, develop, and deploy secure, compliant infrastructure in AWS (current primary cloud) via Terraform, shaping module/architecture strategy so the standard extends cleanly to Azure/GCP as those environments come online. * **Monitor, Support, and Respond****:** Proactively monitor deployment pipelines, release health, Terraform plan/apply activity, and infra alerts/metrics. Serve as technical escalation point for production support, including after\-hours. Own incident response, rollback, and remediation decisions for both deployment and infrastructure issues. * **Mentor the Team****:** Coach engineers on release engineering, deployment safety, Terraform best practices, and IaC code quality. * Other duties as needed. **About You*** 10\+ years cloud DevOps (AWS\-primary), with strong emphasis on release engineering, deployment automation, and IaC. * Multi\-cloud production experience required — AWS plus hands\-on, production\-grade work in Azure and/or GCP (not theoretical portability). * 4\+ years hands\-on, production\-grade Terraform — module authoring, remote state (S3/DynamoDB), workspaces, provider version management, safe plan/apply in CI/CD. * **Deep CD experience** (not just CI) — progressive rollout strategies, automated rollback, supporting infra as code. * Proven enterprise\-scale **Terraform** architecture experience — remote state design, module registries, versioning/governance policy, multi\-team access control. * Real multi\-cloud IaC architecture experience — built/operated a cloud\-agnostic architecture in production, not just designed portable\-in\-theory modules. * Terraform ecosystem tooling (Terragrunt, Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, Atlantis, Sentinel/OPA, Checkov) — plus. * **Track record driving org\-wide IaC adoption** — migrations, golden\-path templates, enabling other teams. * Agile/version\-control tooling: Jira, Confluence, Git, BitBucket. * Deep CI/CD tooling expertise, with hands\-on **CircleCI**experience strongly preferred; we're especially interested in candidates who've owned the CD/release side of the pipeline — including the provisioning layer — not just build/test automation. * Expert in cloud ops — scalability, reliability, maintainability through full deployment lifecycle. * Track record reducing lead time, change failure rate, time to recover. * Ability to coach/mentor. * 7\+ years \*nix (Linux, MacOS, BSD, AIX). * 5\+ years scripting (Shell, Go, Python, PERL, Tcl/Tk) for deployment tooling/Terraform providers. * 5\+ years monitoring/alerting/observability, including drift detection against Terraform state. * Kubernetes/ECS experience (Helm, Kustomize) including cluster/node provisioning via Terraform — highly desirable. **About Us** NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140\+ countries. The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years. **What You’ll Love** We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community. We honor your flexibility needs with full\-time work that is hybrid remote. We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance. We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan. We prioritize your work\-life balance with our unlimited PTO. We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement. **Additional Information** This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.* Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self\-relocate. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job\-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey, or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $180,000 \- $240,000 per year. For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $180,000 \- $240,000 per year. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment. \#LI\-KS2 \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-Hybrid \#BI\-Remote \#BI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: NobleAI’s VIP Platform is a Science\-Based AI platform that predicts complex systems, helping companies accelerate discovery, improve product and asset performance, and drive measurable commercial results across energy, chemistry, and manufacturing. NobleAI turns sparse, multi\-source industrial data into predictive models and decision\-grade insights. By combining physics and chemistry expertise with advanced machine learning, our platform improves resource recovery, asset performance, and product quality. We're seeking a Solutions Engineer to join our team. This role will work with Sales, Product, and AI/Research teams to understand and meet customer needs, demonstrate in\-depth knowledge of our products to prospective clients, and assist in selling complex scientific and technological solutions. The ideal candidate has experience in enterprise software solutions and professional services, solid hands\-on technical skills, and preferably a background in Computational Chemistry. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Platform – nRF Cloud
jobs.description: **About the job** Nordic Semiconductor is looking for an Engineering Manager who thrives at the intersection of people leadership and deep technical ownership to lead our Cloud Platform team. Our platform gives hardware teams the tools to monitor, debug, and update IoT devices in production. Companies like reMarkable, Whoop, and Ultrahuman rely on it to keep millions of devices reliable in the field, and the results speak for themselves. Customers have reported stats like 10x reductions in return rates, 90% fewer device resets, and doubled engineering productivity. We're an industry leader in enabling hardware teams to ship with confidence and iterate fast after launch. You will lead a team of platform engineers of unique technical breadth and depth, responsible for the core backend platform underpinning nRF Cloud. You will identify and drive strategic investments across infrastructure, databases, performance, reliability, and security, and ultimately help us scale a successful business. **Key responsibilities** * **Own the nRF Cloud platform.** Rise to the challenge of pragmatically scaling a system that ingests data from millions of IoT devices every day, leading and learning from a team of experts. Drive the reliability, scalability, and performance while optimizing cost and other constraints. * **Own your team's productivity and output.** You're accountable for what the team delivers. That means proactively identifying blockers, balancing workload, and shaping workflows so people have the information and focus they need. * **Build and maintain a healthy team culture.** Create a safe, supportive environment where people can do their best work. Set clear expectations, give direct and timely feedback, and foster real collaboration. * **Contribute technically.** Stay an active technical contributor by participating in architecture design, code reviews, and debugging production issues. Let others write most of the code, but build the intuition to inform pragmatic decision\-making. * **Define and evolve the cloud platform roadmap.** Bias towards action and experimentation, doing the simplest thing that works, shipping it, learning from it, and improving from there. * **Champion observability and technical excellence.** Build a strong observability culture across the organization. Ensure meaningful metrics, logs, and alerts are in place and that on\-call rotations are healthy and sustainable. * **Partner cross\-functionally.** Collaborate with Product, SDK \& Field Engineering, Go To Market, and Security teams to align engineering work with customer needs and business goals. * **Hire well.** When the team is performing, hiring becomes the highest\-leverage thing you can do. You'll own the hiring process for your team, from defining roles to closing candidates. * **Represent your team across the organization.** Communicate up and across clearly. Build relationships with other engineering leads, and make sure your team's work is visible and well understood. **Qualification and skills** **Required:** * 6\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 year of engineering management experience. * Proven ability to remain hands\-on technically while managing a team. You should be comfortable reviewing code, contributing to architecture decisions, and debugging production systems. * Deep familiarity with **AWS**, including services such as EKS, RDS, S3, EC2, ECS, and related tooling. * Solid experience with relational databases, especially **PostgreSQL**, including schema design, query optimization, and operational concerns. * Proficiency in backend programming, with a strong preference for **Python**, **Kotlin, and/or TypeScript.** * Strong experience with **Kubernetes**, including deploying, operating, and scaling production workloads. * Practical experience with **observability and monitoring** tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Sentry, or similar, and a track record of improving system reliability. * Strong written and verbal communication. Most of this job is communicating, whether it's giving feedback in a 1:1, aligning teams on technical direction, or presenting a plan to leadership. **Nice to Have:** * Background in IoT, developer tools, or embedded systems tooling. * Experience with building device telemetry pipelines, managing OTA update infrastructure, or working with protocols like MQTT or CoAP. * Experience working in an organization going through a significant product integration or platform migration. * Familiarity with ClickHouse or other columnar/analytical databases for high\-volume time\-series or event data. * Experience owning technical portions of SOC 2 or other compliance processes. **Personal Skills** * You lead with care and accountability. You genuinely invest in the people on your team and hold yourself responsible for outcomes. * You think about systems, not just tasks. You look upstream to figure out why things aren't working and fix the root cause, not the symptom. * You default to clarity. You set expectations, create a narrative around the team's work, and make sure people know what good looks like. * You're a strong communicator. You can explain technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders and translate business context into something your team can act on. * You're curious about the domain. You want to understand how IoT devices work, what firmware engineers actually need, and how cloud tooling and AI can make hardware product teams fundamentally more effective. **Working for Nordic** Working for Nordic Semiconductor, you will be inspired and supported to develop yourself. Our teams enjoy a professional and informal working environment. We value and encourage the continuous development of skills and expertise to the highest levels. We are proud of our Norwegian heritage, our highly skilled international workforce, world\-leading innovation, and professional brilliance. We offer a variety of tasks and projects, and the possibility to work alongside some of the world’s most renowned experts within their field. We encourage our employees to question the established and innovate while expecting professionalism, commitment, and the will to learn. **Benefits** * The salary range for this role is (141\.000 \- 218\.000 USD). Exact salary is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. * We also offer an annual discretionary bonus and a long\-term incentive plan * Medical and Dental benefits. 100% employer\-paid option for employees. * Health Savings Account or Flexible Spending Account * Other voluntary benefits available, like disability and life insurance * 401 (k) with employer match * Generous family\-friendly leave policies for vacation, personal time, sick time, and parental leave * Opportunities for professional development and mentorship **Practical details** * **Location:** Boston, United States * We review applications continuously and encourage early applications. Please note that this position might be subject to a background check.

jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer, AI ML
jobs.description: **Description** **About Norstella:** Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life\-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives. Norstella unites market\-leading brands \- Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta and The Dedham Group and delivers must\-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision\-making. We help our clients: * Accelerate the drug development cycle * Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market * Make data driven commercial and financial decisions * Match and recruit patients for clinical trials * Identify and address barriers to therapies Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA, and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI\-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence. Norstella’s investments in AI are transforming how data is consumed and decisions are made, disrupting inefficient legacy workflows and helping the industry become more efficient, innovative, and responsive to patient needs. **Job Description:** Leads multi\-product security efforts, develops the ProdSec team and mentors engineers, coordinating incident response, and shaping DevSecOps practices, with primary focus on securing Norstella's agentic SDLC platform (Forge) and its supporting knowledge\-base ecosystem (Sage). This engineer owns the security posture of the autonomous AI agent chain end\-to\-end: the platform itself, the prompts and orchestration layer, the proprietary domain data the agents consume, and — critically — the source code the agents produce. Acts as the senior security partner to the Forge engineering team, embedding security guardrails into every phase of the autonomous SDLC (Intake Architect Threat\-Modeling Dev\-Planning Dev QA) so that AI\-generated code meets the same compliance, audit, and resilience standards as human\-written code in HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 environments. **Responsibilities:** * Leads threat modeling across complex architectures, including agent\-to\-agent communication graphs, tool\-use surfaces, MCP server boundaries, and prompt/RAG pipelines, and mentors engineers in risk analysis practices. * Leads secure development training across product groups — including AI\-assisted and AI\-generated coding workflows — and evolves standards based on industry trends, OWASP LLM Top 10, and emerging agentic\-AI threat research. * Leads vulnerability management for multiple products, setting priorities and ensuring timely resolution, and tunes the Forge Security Agent's SAST/SCA gating, severity thresholds, and triage\-LLM classification logic to keep auto\-remediation loops both effective and safe. * Leads supply chain risk assessments and drives API governance practices across product portfolios, with explicit ownership of the AI/ML supply chain — foundation model providers (Anthropic, others), Auth0, Snyk, Azure DevOps NPM feeds, vector databases, and the Sage KB seed data — including concentration\-risk monitoring and contingency planning. * Leads security integration across CI/CD and multi\-cloud platforms, mentoring engineers on automation, and ensures every agentic run produces a reconstructible audit trail sufficient to demonstrate reasonable judgment to SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and Life Sciences auditors. * Technical IR lead overseeing cross\-product incidents, coordinates disclosure processes, and advises leadership, including incidents involving prompt injection, model jailbreak, agent privilege escalation, sensitive data leakage from KB stores, and compromised AI\-generated code reaching production. * Leads AI/ML model security practices across multiple teams and establishes safe design principles, including least\-privilege tool\-use, secrets handling for agent runtimes, PII/PHI sanitization in prompts and outputs, model\-output validation, and red\-team / adversarial\-input programs targeting the Forge agent chain. * Leads SSDLC governance initiatives, mentors teams on embedding controls, and validates adherence across product lines, with explicit accountability for the agentic SSDLC: ensuring the Threat Model Production Agent's output is consumed downstream, that the Forge Security Agent's fail\-open posture is risk\-tiered appropriately, and that human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints are placed where judgment is genuinely required. * Designs and operates continuous security evaluation pipelines that benchmark agent runs across safety, compliance, and code\-quality dimensions, surfacing regressions in real time. * Defines acceptance criteria and secur ses, with demonstrated ability to apply SSDLC controls to non\-deterministic, agent\-driven development workflows. * Hands\-on experience with LLM\-powered applications (Claude, GPT\-4, Gemini, Llama, or equivalent), including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, and chain\-of\-thought orchestration — sufficient to security\-review them, not just consume them. * Working familiarity with at least one agentic framework or orchestration toolkit (LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, Semantic Kernel, MCP, or comparable), and the threat surface each one introduces. * Working knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector) and retrieval\-augmented generation patterns, with an eye to KB poisoning, retrieval leakage, and access\-control failures. * Understanding of LLM evaluation methodologies — behavioral testing, hallucination detection, output grading, drift detection — applied to security and compliance properties of agent outputs. * Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and/or TypeScript; able to read and contribute to production agent code, not just review it from a distance. * Compliance fluency in SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and ideally FDA 21 CFR Part 11 — and the judgment to translate those frameworks into concrete controls for AI/ML and agentic systems. * Pharma, life sciences, or healthcare data experience (RWD/RWE, clinical trials, market access) is a strong plus given the Norstella product portfolio. **Our Guiding Principles for success at Norstella:** 01: Bold, Passionate, and Mission\-First 02: Integrity, Truth, and Reality 03: Kindness, Empathy, and Grace 04: Resilience, Mettle, and Perseverance 05: Humility, Gratitude, and Learning **Benefits:** * Medical and Prescription Drug Benefits * Health Savings Accounts (HSA) or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Dental \& Vision Benefits * Basic Life and AD\&D Benefits * 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match * Company Paid Short \& Long\-Term Disability * Paid Parental Leave * Paid Time Off \& Company Holidays Please Note \- All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We do not provide visa sponsorship or transfers. We are not currently accepting candidates who are on an OPT visa. *Norstella is an equal opportunity employer. All job applicants will receive equal treatment regardless of race, creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability or handicap, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy and pregnancy\-related conditions), marital or domestic partner status, military or veteran status, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, reproductive health decision making, or any other protected characteristic as established by federal, state, or local law.* *Sometimes the best opportunities are hidden by self\-doubt. We disqualify ourselves before we have the opportunity to be considered. Regardless of where you came from, how you identify, or the path that led you here\- you are welcome. If you read this job description and feel passion and excitement, we’re just as excited about you.* *All legitimate roles with Norstella will be posted on Norstella’s job board which is located at norstella.com/careers. If a role is not posted on this job board, a candidate should assume the role is not a legitimate role with Norstella. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nutrient** ================== At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission\-critical. **Your Role at Nutrient...** ============================ As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our Sales team, your work starts with a customer: * You will find the document problem that is actually costing them money, and build the working solution yourself, on their documents, that works with or within their environment, against a scorecard we agree on before we start. * Then you will turn what you built into something the next customer can buy ready made. We commit to the specific outcome for the customer, and we then measure how much of each engagement converts into actual product. Here’s how this role is different: * If you are a **solutions engineer** today, the difference is that you ship. * If you are a **professional services engineer** today, the difference is that the work is not billed by the hour against a spec someone else wrote, and success is not a signed\-off SOW but a customer outcome and a reusable capability in the product. * If you are a **product engineer** today, the difference is that your users are in the room, on the call, and occasionally disagreeing with you. This is a role for someone who is genuinely comfortable in all three chairs: the discovery conversation where you work out what job the customer is actually trying to get done, the terminal where you build it by Friday, and the seat at the table when the product is being meaningfully developed. **What You'll Work On...** ========================== * **Discover the problem before anyone scopes it**. Get into the customer's process deeply enough to state the job to be done in their words. Most engagements start because someone asked for a feature; the work is finding the outcome behind the request. * **Build the first implementation yourself**. Working software on the customer's own documents and in their own environment if necessary, fast enough that the demo lands while the problem is still urgent. A prototype that shows beats a deck that tells, and a working solution closes the deal. * **Agree a scorecard upfront and hit it.** Every engagement starts with a written definition of what success looks like and how it will be measured. We commit to that result. * **Stitch across the whole platform**. Real solutions cut across Nutrient Workflow, Document Engine, our Document Web Services APIs, the Web and native SDKs, AI data extraction, and whatever the customer already runs. Recent engagements have meant SharePoint and Salesforce integrations, AWS Bedrock models, .NET services behind consistent\-hash routing, bulk export pipelines, and database archiving. * **Productize what you build**. Choose the implementation that makes the next customer easier, not the one that closes fastest. In a recent engagement we deliberately built a cover\-sheet generator on AI Data Extraction rather than a SQL script, and that task is now stronger for every customer. Several deliverables from that engagement are now licensable product components and self\-service features. * **Close the loop back into the company**. Write up what you learned, file the defects you hit, articulate the pattern so the next engagement starts from it, and hand the template to the next team. Forward deployed work that stays inside one account is just consulting. * **Support the deal**. You will work alongside account executives and solutions engineers before the contract as well as after it. What you build during the sales cycle is often what decides whether we win. **What You'll Bring...** ======================== The shortest description of the profile: a strong software engineer who has moved toward product thinking — you care about the problem, not the ticket — and who is unusually good with customers. You live in a world that exists beyond technical requirements and can quickly go into solution mode to deliver a working solution. You are likely a good fit if most of the following are true:* You can run a discovery conversation. You ask about the business process before the API, and you can tell the difference between a use case and a job to be done. * You get real leverage out of coding agents. Our customers expect the first working version in days, not sprints, and that only happens if you direct agents well. * You have shipped production software for years, and you still build. You are comfortable being the only engineer on a problem and being a part of a team that delivers the solution. * You are fluent in at least one of JavaScript or TypeScript, .NET/C\#, Java, Python or Go, and you p  experience** with the systems enterprises actually run, such as SharePoint, Salesforce, Power Automate, or an internal system nobody has documented since 2011\. * Comfort working with **regulated environments** and the conversations that come with them, such as HIPAA, FedRAMP, FIPS, and government cloud. Be honest with yourself — this is probably not for you if:* You want a clean backlog and a quiet quarter. Early engagements will be ambiguous and the team's boundaries with Engineering and Professional Services are still being drawn. * You prefer to hand off after the design. Here you build it. * You would rather build the perfect bespoke thing than the slightly less perfect thing three more customers can use. **Also…** ========= * **Your first 90 days**: By day 30 you will have shadowed two live engagements and shipped one small thing a customer uses. By day 60 you will own an engagement end to end, from discovery through the agreed scorecard. By day 90 at least one thing you built will be on its way into the product as a template or a component, and you will have written up why. * **How we will measure your impact**: Customer outcomes against the scorecards you agreed, revenue influenced through the engagements you run, and the share of your work that converts into reusable product rather than staying in one account. That last one is the number that keeps Nutrient a software company. * **Team and location**: You will join the Forward Deployed Engineering team, reporting into Sales, working daily with Engineering and the Account teams. We are hiring in Raleigh, NC and in London. Expect meaningful travel to customer sites, concentrated in bursts around engagement kickoffs. **Who Thrives Here...** ======================= At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are: * **Collaborators**: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego. * **Hungry Learners**: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth. * **Curious Thinkers**: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right. * **Self\-Starters**: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence. * **Owners**: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control. * **Doers**: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges. **Why You'll Love Working Here...** =================================== At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact. * **Real technical ownership:** you're not just managing relationships; you're running technical discovery, building POCs, and being the engineer in the room for your customers. * **Cross\-functional influence:** your work sits at the intersection of CS, Solutions Architecture, and Support, with a direct line to shape product direction through customer advocacy. * **Distributed and async\-first:** minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work. * **Mission\-critical product:** Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%\+ of the Global 500 across 80\+ countries. * **Strong growth trajectory:** ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners. Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non\-merit factor.

jobs.title: Technical Product & Program Manager
jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking an experienced Technical Product \& Program Manager to own the ongoing development, quality, release management, and continuous improvement of our proprietary insurance agency management platform while also managing other strategic technology projects across the organization. Our core platform is nearing completion and transitioning into testing, deployment, stabilization, maintenance, integrations, and ongoing enhancement. We need someone who can take ownership of that process while bringing structure and accountability to multiple concurrent projects. This is not simply a ticket\-management role. The right person can understand complex business workflows, translate them into clear technical requirements, challenge incomplete solutions, test software themselves, and drive projects through completion. Coding is not required, but strong technical literacy and hands\-on QA experience are essential. **Key Responsibilities** **Product \& Technical Ownership** · Translate business needs into requirements, workflows, user stories, and measurable acceptance criteria. · Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, operational impact, technical risk, and release readiness. · Bridge business users, Accounting, Operations, leadership, and engineering. · Identify missing requirements, dependencies, conflicting business rules, and edge cases. · Maintain clear documentation of product requirements, decisions, and business rules. **QA, Testing \& Release Management** · Own final product validation before features and releases are accepted. · Conduct functional, workflow, regression, and user acceptance testing. · Validate workflows, data accuracy, permissions, calculations, integrations, and downstream reporting. · Clearly document defects and verify fixes. · Determine whether work is ready for release, requires additional work, or should be deferred. · Help establish repeatable QA and production\-support processes. **Program \& Project Management** · Manage multiple technology and business initiatives simultaneously. · Establish project plans, milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines. · Coordinate internal stakeholders, developers, and outside vendors. · Identify risks and delays early and drive issues to resolution. · Provide leadership with clear visibility into project status, risks, decisions, and upcoming milestones. · Ensure projects are driven to actual completion rather than simply tracked. **Technical Knowledge** The successful candidate does not need to be a software engineer but should be comfortable working with concepts including: · APIs and integrations · Frontend/backend architecture · Relational databases · Environments and releases · Data ownership · Authentication and authorization · RBAC, multi\-tenant systems, audit trails, data integrity, PII/security · Financial and accounting workflows Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence is expected. **Qualifications** · 5\+ years of technical product management, software program management, product ownership, or similar experience. · Experience managing software through development, QA, release, and production support. · Hands\-on experience with QA, UAT, regression testing, and product acceptance. · Experience managing multiple concurrent projects. · Strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to work directly with software engineers. · Strong documentation, communication, and problem\-solving skills. · Ability to operate independently and drive projects through ambiguity. Experience with insurance technology, agency management systems, financial systems, accounting workflows, commissions, or transaction\-intensive applications is highly desirable. **What Success Looks Like** The Technical Product \& Program Manager can independently take a business problem from concept through production—understanding the workflow, identifying missing requirements, defining what engineering needs to build, validating the finished product, and ensuring the resulting business rules are documented. parameters, and alert settings. * Partner with Air Traffic Control (ATC), Technical Operations, engineering personnel, and program stakeholders to collect, analyze, and translate local operational requirements, procedures, and site data into system adaptations. * Utilize approved adaptation and configuration management tools to develop, modify, track, and maintain site\-specific configuration baselines. * Support site readiness activities, pre\-deployment evaluations, dry runs, and readiness reviews to confirm adaptations are complete, accurate, and prepared for implementation. * Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), Joint Site Acceptance Testing (JSAT), and Operational Test \& Evaluation (OT\&E) activities. * Verify adaptations align with applicable enterprise architecture, system engineering, safety, and program standards. * Investigate adaptation and configuration issues, support root\-cause analysis, and work with engineering teams to identify and implement appropriate resolutions. * Maintain accurate adaptation documentation, technical decisions, configuration records, and version histories. * Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and adaptation support to site personnel, program teams, and local and national FAA stakeholders. **Why This Role Matters** Every FAA terminal facility has unique operational requirements, airport layouts, procedures, and traffic considerations. TFDM must account for those differences while operating as part of a standardized national system. analysis. * Ability to analyze operational requirements and translate them into technical requirements, data elements, or system configurations. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail. * Ability to interpret technical documentation, system requirements, procedures, and/or airport or system layouts. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate with technical and operational stakeholders. * Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time to support program requirements, including travel to FAA facilities and integration laboratories, as well as participation in site surveys, adaptation workshops, testing events, and deployment activities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience supporting the FAA, National Airspace System (NAS), or aviation modernization programs. * Familiarity with TFDM, TFMS, STARS, ASDE\-X, ERAM, or other FAA automation and air traffic management systems. * Experience with TFDM or similar site adaptation/configuration activities. * Experience working directly with air traffic controllers, FAA Technical Operations personnel, engineers, and other operational stakeholders. * Bachelor’s degree in aviation, Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. * Knowledge of terminal airport operations, airport surface movement, gate/stand configurations, taxi routing, and ATC procedures. * Experience supporting system integration, site implementation, acceptance testing, operational testing, or deployment readiness. * Experience with configuration\-management systems, adaptation tools, data\-management platforms, or geospatial applications. * Familiarity with FAA adaptation or data\-development environments such as URET or TDDS. * Experience with ArcGIS, AutoCAD, or similar tools used to develop or interpret airport and geospatial layouts. * Familiarity with FAA implementation and acquisition processes, including AMS and JRC processes. * Experience analyzing and troubleshooting system interfaces, data flows, configuration discrepancies, or integration issues. * Strong understanding of baseline control, requirements traceability, and technical documentation. \#BNATC ##### **Details** **Target Salary Range:** $135,000 \- $216,000\. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. **Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission\-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration. At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it. In this role, you'll help configure and prepare TFDM capabilities for deployment at individual FAA terminal facilities. Working at the intersection of air traffic operations, airport layouts, systems engineering, and technology, you'll translate local operational requirements and Air Traffic Control (ATC) procedures into site\-specific system configurations or adaptations. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with backgrounds in aviation, air traffic operations, systems integration, engineering, airport systems, configuration management, or FAA automation systems who want to contribute directly to NAS modernization. **Work Location:** * This position is **100% on\-site,** primarily located in Herndon VA**,** with an alternate work location available in Atlantic City, NJ. * Must be available to travel up to 25% of the time to support program requirements, including travel to FAA facilities and integration laboratories. **In this position, you will:** Your work will help ensure TFDM is accurately configured, tested, and ready for operational use while maintaining alignment with FAA requirements, national standards, and approved program baselines. * Act as the coordinator for TFDM adaptation activities supporting assigned terminal facilities. * Support FAA TFDM program activities, including coordination with engineering teams, integration environments, and operational facilities. * Create, maintain, and verify facility\-specific TFDM configurations, including gate and stand layouts, airport surface routing, flight data rules, system parameters, and alert settings. * Partner with Air Traffic Control (ATC), Technical Operations, engineering personnel, and program stakeholders to collect, analyze, and translate local operational requirements, procedures, and site data into system adaptations. * Utilize approved adaptation and configuration management tools to develop, modify, track, and maintain site\-specific configuration baselines. * Support site readiness activities, pre\-deployment evaluations, dry runs, and readiness reviews to confirm adaptations are complete, accurate, and prepared for implementation. * Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), Joint Site Acceptance Testing (JSAT), and Operational Test \& Evaluation (OT\&E) activities. * Verify adaptations align with applicable enterprise architecture, system engineering, safety, and program standards. * Investigate adaptation and configuration issues, support root\-cause analysis, and work with engineering teams to identify and implement appropriate resolutions. * Maintain accurate adaptation documentation, technical decisions, configuration records, and version histories. * Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and adaptation support to site personnel, program teams, and local and national FAA stakeholders. **Why This Role Matters** Every FAA terminal facility has unique operational requirements, airport layouts, procedures, and traffic considerations. TFDM must account for those differences while operating as part of a standardized national system. As a TFDM Adaptation Specialist, you'll help bridge the gap between national system capabilities and local airport operations ensuring each site i , software/system configuration, testing, or data analysis. * Ability to analyze operational requirements and translate them into technical requirements, data elements, or system configurations. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail. * Ability to interpret technical documentation, system requirements, procedures, and/or airport or system layouts. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate with technical and operational stakeholders. * Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time to support program requirements, including travel to FAA facilities and integration laboratories, as well as participation in site surveys, adaptation workshops, testing events, and deployment activities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience supporting the FAA, National Airspace System (NAS), or aviation modernization programs. * Familiarity with TFDM, TFMS, STARS, ASDE\-X, ERAM, or other FAA automation and air traffic management systems. * Experience with TFDM or similar site adaptation/configuration activities. * Experience working directly with air traffic controllers, FAA Technical Operations personnel, engineers, and other operational stakeholders. * Bachelor’s degree in aviation, Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. * Knowledge of terminal airport operations, airport surface movement, gate/stand configurations, taxi routing, and ATC procedures. * Experience supporting system integration, site implementation, acceptance testing, operational testing, or deployment readiness. * URET or TDDS. * Experience with ArcGIS, AutoCAD, or similar tools used to develop or interpret airport and geospatial layouts. * Familiarity with FAA implementation and acquisition processes, including AMS and JRC processes. * Experience analyzing and troubleshooting system interfaces, data flows, configuration discrepancies, or integration issues. * Strong understanding of baseline jobs.title: Research Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Position:** Research Data Engineer **Unit:** District Attorney's Transparency Analytics (DATA) Lab **Supervisor:** Senior Data Engineer **Funding:** Two\-year grant\-funded position **Company Description** The ***Philadelphia District Attorney’s Office*** is the largest prosecutor’s office in Pennsylvania, and one of the largest in the nation. It serves more than 1\.5 million citizens of the City and County of Philadelphia, employing 600 lawyers, detectives, and support staff. Our Assistant District Attorneys are dedicated to public service, public safety, and justice for all involved in the criminal justice system. The Philadelphia District Attorney’s Office in particular is committed to several citywide collaborations aimed at reducing Philadelphia’s jail population and improving the criminal justice system overall. **\*\*Please note that effective September 1, 2021, the City of Philadelphia requires all new employees to present proof of vaccination against COVID\-19\. \*\*** **To attain a job with the city, you must be a city of Philadelphia resident within 6 months (180 days) of hire and able to work completely in the office.** **Summary of Job** The District Attorney’s Transparency Analytics (DATA) Lab is hiring its first Research Data Engineer to join our Infrastructure team, with a special focus on supporting embedded researchers and analysts from the Penn Prosecution Lab. The DATA Lab's mission is to use data, research, and advocacy to inform policies and practices; increase equity, transparency, and accountability; and reduce harm through prosecutorial and systems reform in Philadelphia and beyond. This unique position will work closely with our Infrastructure and Research teams and DATA Lab leadership to help align, prioritize, and solve the technical and data needs of our embedded research partners. By addressing issues infrastructurally, improvements will benefit all DATA Lab personnel and numerous partners. Responsibilities include building data pipelines that extract, transform, and load data into the DATA Lab's Postgres reporting database. The DATA Lab and Penn teams use data from the DAO, the courts, police, prisons, and other sources to inform day\-to\-day operations at the DAO, shape policy in the criminal legal space, support external research, and more. The technological landscape is continuously evolving, and we consistently iterate our data pipelines to provide accurate, timely data. Data pipelines are written in a combination of R and Python and feed into an AWS RDS database, using Airflow orchestration. The Research Data Engineer will work closely with the Supervising Data Engineer, Penn team, project managers, unit leadership, data analysts, and other DAO staff. This position reports to the Supervising Data Engineer in the DATA Lab. This is a grant\-funded position for at least 2 years. How You Will Make an Impact * Be part of a nationally recognized team doing innovative research and analysis of the criminal legal system from within a prosecutor’s office. * Open the doors of the office to community members and research partners by opening unprecedented prosecution data to the public through direct data sharing, public data releases, data stories, analyses, and DAO\-sponsored studies. * Harness volumes of criminal legal data from a wide array of sources, consolidate and connect it, and produce analytical and research\-ready data and documentation. * Work in an environment free of vibe coding and develop true hand\-crafted, human\-created work. **Job Responsibilities*** Serve as primary contact for database\-related questions from Penn team (availability of a particular field or variable, how to access a database, troubleshooting server issues, etc.) * Design, build, and maintain automated, scalable, and test\-driven data pipelines. * Build research\-ready versions of datasets and documentation for Penn team and external researchers. * Ensure quality, efficiency, and accuracy of data. * Troubleshoot and fix errors and outages as they occur. * Participate in Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily standup, and retro. * Support DATA Lab Infra team in identifying and integrating new data sources. * Manage version control for Penn research code and support Penn team researchers in best practices. * Support DATA Lab reviews of Penn Fellows’ work to ensure proper interpretation of data, including leading code review process for replication packets. **Skills \& Qualifications** * Education and/or experience: A background in computer science and academic research, or equivalent experience of at least 3 years, is desired. Prior experience working with researchers is preferred. * Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative and service\-oriented approach to data work. Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and accessible to colleagues with varying levels of technical expertise. Proficiency in Python or a demonstrated ability to learn it. * Proficiency in SQL * Proficiency in R, statistics, and research methods. Familiarity with experimental and quasi\-experimental methods is preferred * A demonstrated ability to build ETL pipelines * Be a team player who can communicate and collaborate with the Infrastructure, Penn Research, Analytics, and internal Research teams * Familiarity with Git and GitHub for version control * Familiarity with AWS * Experience with Linux; Airflow is a plus **Rewards/Benefits** This is an exempt employee with the City of Philadelphia. Immediately upon assuming office, new hire will receive benefits similar to those of other City of Philadelphia employees, including the below benefits: * Learning and development opportunities * Generous retirement savings options available (pension plan and etc.) * We are a Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Program qualified employer * We offer comprehensive health coverage (medical, vision, prescription and dental) for employees and their eligible dependents * Annual paid time off (PTO) package: 10 *vacation days, 15 sick leave days, 11 paid holidays, 5 annual administrative leave* * Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan * Before tax commuter program * Health care and Dependent care flexible spending accounts * Sick leave bonuses and exchanges * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Applications will be active for one year from the date of receipt by the Office. All exempt employees of the District Attorney’s Office are at\-will employees and serve at the pleasure of the District Attorney. The at\-will relationship shall not be modified for any employee and no agreement, oral or written, shall be entered into that changes the at\-will relationship. *\*\* The Philadelphia District Attorney's Office is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, source of income, familial status, genetic information or domestic or sexual violence victim status. \*\**
