jobs.description: ### **About Point** **✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals. **✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage. **✨ Game\-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4\.7 Trustpilot rating and an A\+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000\+ customers. **✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area. **✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people\-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week. **Location** This is a hybrid role based in Palo Alto, with team members expected to work onsite one day per week for in\-person collaboration. **About the role** We're seeking a **Software Engineer (IC1\)** to join our team and help support and grow Point's multi\-product digital platform. In this role, you'll work under the guidance of senior engineers and alongside product partners on the **Customer Operations pillar**, building smaller features within a defined product area that help our Sales and Customer Experience teams deliver faster, smarter, and more personalized experiences for our customers. This is an entry point into production engineering. You'll learn how our systems fit together, how features move from design review to release, and how emerging technologies—such as AI\-assisted workflows—are applied in real production environments under responsible data and privacy guidelines. This role is ideal for an early\-career engineer who is eager to learn, receptive to feedback, comfortable in a fast\-paced environment, and inclined to over\-communicate rather than go quiet. Check out our latest Engineering Blog to learn more about why it's a great time to join Point's Engineering team! **Your responsibilities** * Build and ship smaller, well\-scoped features within an established codebase, with guidance from senior engineers. * Write and test code against the acceptance criteria of your assigned tasks, including unit tests for both positive and negative conditions. * Submit clear, reviewable PRs; review teammates' code and use feedback on your own PRs as a key resource for technical growth. * Work with senior engineers to design solutions for assigned tasks and discuss the tradeoffs of different approaches. * Participate in sprint planning, grooming, retrospectives, and technical design reviews with a view toward learning best practices. * Communicate progress, risks, and blockers early and often to your team and cross\-functional partners — err on the side of over\-communication. * Learn how AI\- and data\-powered components are used in production systems while following responsible data and privacy guidelines. * Write clearly in both informal (Slack, email) and formal (Jira tickets, commit messages, PR descriptions) media. * Follow team standards for testing, documentation, monitoring, and operational readiness, and make minor refactors to keep the code you touch clean and clear. * Estimate your own tasks, seek out mentorship, and work with product managers to understand the business impact of technical decisions. **About you** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 1\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including internships or co\-op experience, writing object\-oriented code in a production, coursework, or open\-source setting. * Foundational grasp of object\-oriented design — classes, interfaces, encapsulation, and inheritance versus composition — in at least one object\-oriented language such as TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Java, or C\#. * Working understanding of data structures and data modeling, and the ability to break a problem into well\-named objects, methods, and responsibilities. * Some exposure to building or consuming APIs and to working with a relational database. * Familiarity with unit testing, including stubbing or mocking dependencies, and a willingness to build that skill quickly. * Exposure to customer\-facing applications through coursework, internships, side projects, or early professional work. * Ability to communicate clearly with teammates and ask questions when product or design requirements are ambiguous. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, balancing quality and speed while learning under guidance. * Collaborative team player who actively seeks out feedback and mentorship and acts on it. **Nice to have** * Exposure to common design patterns, or to a statically typed language such as Java, C\#, or Kotlin * A/B testing frameworks and data\-driven experimentation in a Growth or conversion context * AI/ML\-powered personalization or recommendation feature integration * Analytics instrumentation (PostHog, Segment, Amplitude) * Coursework, internship, or side\-project experience in fintech, lending, or another regulated industry Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role in the San Francisco Bay Area \| $138,700 \- $153,300 This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job\-related factors, to determine final compensation. ### **Our benefits** * **Generous health benefits:** We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA). * **Unlimited paid time off:** Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays. * **Flexible remote and onsite work:** Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in\-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ. * **Fully paid parental leave:** Point will supplement state Paid Family Leave (PFL) so employees receive 100% of their regular base pay, plus two additional weeks of fully paid leave after state PFL ends. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay. * **Equity:** We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives you a stake in our future success. * **Financial wellness:** We provide 401K retirement plans for employees as well as guaranteed life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * **Extra work/life benefits:** We provide monthly stipends for internet, mobile plans, wellness perks, a one\-time home office reimbursement, and company provided equipment including a MacBook and monitor. Point is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities regardless of age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. Each individual at Point brings their own perspectives, work experiences, lifestyles, and cultures with them, and we believe that a more diverse team creates more innovative products, provides better services to customers, and helps us all grow and learn. SREs are implementing best practices for availability, reliability, and scalability. They are responsible for maintaining and automating monitoring, alerting to proactively identify and resolve potential incidents and drive continuous improvement. SRE defines and manages service level objectives (SLOs), service level indicators (SLIs), service level agreements (SLAs) and ensures those are met or exceeded. As a Site Reliability Engineer focused on Identity \& Access Management, you will be responsible for maintaining, monitoring, supporting, and upgrading processes and systems for one or multiple Digital Products with quality and efficiency. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Incident Management and Monitoring:** Monitor system alerts and respond promptly to incidents, ensuring that Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) are met or exceeded. Performing Root Cause Analysis and creating Postmortems to improve incident response time and ensure consistent stability of the application. * **Automation and Process Improvement:** Automate repetitive tasks, implement and maintain monitoring and logging systems, drive continuous improvements to prevent future incidents, including defining standards for processes. * **Guidance and Collaboration**: Provide expert guidance to Stakeholders (Product, Platform, and Software Engineering teams) in relation to supportability, scalability, and efficiency with products and tools in the organization's portfolio. * **Infrastructure Management:** Administer platform infrastructure, oversee change management procedures, contributing to product roadmap creation and defining strategies for critical products. jobs.title: Solutions Engineer (US)
jobs.description: Qdrant is an **open\-source vector** search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real\-time recommendations. Trusted by global leaders like **Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom**, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising **$50M in Series B** funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data. As a remote\-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI. As a **Solutions Engineer**, you'll take ownership from day one, acting as a technical guide for our clients. We're looking for someone with a strong builder mindset who's self\-reliant and truly passionate about vector search. An entrepreneurial streak will set you up for success in this role. **What you will own** * **Support the Technical\-to\-Commercial Translation:** Help translate architectural requirements (Multi\-AZ, sharding, replication) into accurate pricing models and contract terms, working alongside senior team members to protect deal value. * **Help Drive Deal Execution:** Coordinate with Support, Product, and Engineering to unblock proofs of concept (POCs), and keep the technical sales workflow moving in Jira and Salesforce. * **Flag Deployment Risks Early:** Learn to spot noisy neighbour issues, latency bottlenecks, and resource contention before they affect renewals or expansions. * **Support Architectural Reviews and Migration Assessments:** Join discovery sessions to help validate use cases and map migration paths from legacy search engines like Elastic, Solr, and OpenSearch to Qdrant. * **Contribute to Resilient Architecture Design:** Help spec high\-availability search clusters jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer [Remote-US]
jobs.description: *To help keep everyone safe, we encourage all applicants to pay close attention to protect themselves during their job search. When applying for a position online you are at risk of being targeted by malicious actors looking for personal data. Please be aware we will only reach out via email using the domain quanata.com. Anything that does not match those domains should be ignored and considered a security risk.* **About Us** Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context\-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. We blend some of the best Silicon Valley talent and cutting\-edge thinking with the long\-term backing of leading insurer, State Farm. Learn more about us and our work at quanata.com **Our Team** Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk\-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full\-stack, flexible, digital \& increasingly AI\-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm. As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.#### **The Role** As a Staff Security Engineer, you'll play a key role in securing the AI\-enabled systems, applications, and platforms that power our organization. You'll partner closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and security teams to make security an integral part of how AI solutions are designed, built, deployed, and operated. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable diving into architecture and threat models, evaluating emerging AI risks, and translating security requirements into practical engineering solutions. You'll help secure everything from LLM applications and RAG pipelines to agentic AI workflows, third\-party integrations, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS\-native infrastructure. Your impact will extend beyond AI. As a senior individual contributor, you'll help shape our broader security strategy, establish scalable security patterns and standards, and influence technical decisions across the organization. You'll have the autonomy to tackle complex security challenges and drive initiatives from strategy through implementation. **Your Day\-to\-Day** * Partner with engineering and product teams to embed security into AI\-enabled products, internal applications, APIs, services, and platforms throughout their lifecycle. * Lead threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and risk assessments for LLM applications, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, MCP servers, model providers, third\-party AI tools, plugins, automations, and AI\-assisted development. * Define and implement secure AI engineering patterns, guardrails, standards, and reference architectures across identity, data protection, prompt and context handling, tool permissions, logging, monitoring, abuse prevention, and incident readiness. * Strengthen AWS\-native infrastructure and CI/CD environments, including infrastructure\-as\-code, containerized workloads, secrets management, workload identity, deployment pipelines, and software supply chain controls. * Partner with security operations, detection engineering, incident response, and vulnerability management teams to improve AI\-related detection, observability, telemetry, and response capabilities. * Evaluate AI applications, SaaS platforms, model providers, MCPs, agents, developer tools, and other third\-party technologies for security, privacy, access, data exposure, logging, contractual, and operational risks. * Develop practical security guidance, training, and enablement materials that help engineering and business teams use AI safely and build secure solutions. * Lead cross\-functional security\-by\-design initiatives, translate security objectives into technical requirements, influence architectural decisions, and take ownership of broader security projects and critical incident response efforts as organizational needs evolve. #### **About You** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; **or equivalent relevant experience**. * 8\+ years of experience in full\-stack security, product security, application security, cloud security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or software engineering with significant security responsibilities. * 5\+ years of demonstrated experience working with AI, machine learning, LLM, GenAI, or AI\-enabled application environments, including hands\-on experience securing, assessing, building, integrating,  g. * Experience developing secure software in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java, or similar languages. * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar cloud\-native and DevOps technologies. * Familiarity with frameworks and guidance such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, CIS benchmarks, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or cloud security reference architectures. * Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, GIAC, OSCP, or other cloud, application security, AI security, or security engineering certifications. * Experience as a senior individual contributor influencing engineering teams, establishing security standards, and delivering security outcomes without direct management authority. **Salary: $235,000 to $305,000** * Please note that the final salary offered will be determined based on the selected candidate's skills, and experience, as well as the internal salary structure at Quanata. Our aim is to offer a competitive and equitable compensation package that reflects the candidate's expertise and contributions to our organization. **Additional Details:** * **Benefits**: We provide a wide variety of health, wellness and other benefits.These include medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental income plans for you and your dependents, a Headspace app subscription, monthly wellness allowance and a 401(k) Plan with a company match. * **Work from Home Equipment**: Given our virtual environment— in order to set you up for success at home, a one\-time payment of $2K will be provided to cover the purchase of in\-home office equipment and furniture at your discretion. Also, our teams work with MacBook Pros, which we will deliver to you fully provisioned prior to your first day. * **Paid Time Off:** All employees accrue four weeks of PTO in their first year of employment. New parents receive twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave which may be taken within one year after the birth and/or adoption of a child. The twelve weeks is applicable to both birthing and non\-birthing parent. * **Personal and Professional Development:** We're committed to investing in and helping our people grow personally and professionally. All employees receive up to $5000 each year for professional learning, continuing education and career development. All team members also receive LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and access to multiple different coaching opportunities through BetterUp. * **Location**: We are a remote\-first company for most positions so you may work from anywhere you like in the U.S, excluding U.S. territories. *For most positions,* ***occasional travel may be requested or encouraged but is not required****. Some positions might require travel per the job description provided to the employee.* Employees based in the San Francisco Bay Area or in Providence, Rhode Island may commute to one of our local offices as desired. * **Hours**: We maintain core meeting hours from 9AM \- 2PM Pacific time for collaborating with team members across all time zones. *Quanata, LLC is an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **JOB** **TITLE****:** **Automation Engineer** **FLSA:** Exempt position **LOCATION:** Fremont, CA (Onsite) **SALARY:** $89,000 \- $122,000 **Job Summary:** The Automation Engineer supports the automated production systems on the Quanta Manufacturing Fremont floor including automated assembly lines, robot\-arm cells (such as automated DIMM insertion), and precision equipment. The automation equipment is designed and built by Quanta's headquarters (HQ) automation team and delivered to Fremont, California. This role supports HQ during local setup and site acceptance testing, then manages ongoing system operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvement to keep systems running reliably and meeting cycle\-time and yield targets. The Engineering Operations team sets up new production capacity and keeps the factory's automated systems running. Its Industrial Engineers handle production and facility planning — defining the space, equipment, and resources each line needs to meet demand — while its Automation Engineers install, operate, maintain, and improve the factory's automated production systems. The team focuses on execution rather than design or development, working closely with cross\-functional partners to keep production running efficiently and meet performance targets. **Duties/Responsibilities** Support the day\-to\-day operation and performance of automated assembly lines, robot\-arm cells, and precision equipment. * Monitor system performance (e.g., cycle time) and respond rapidly to equipment downtime or system anomalies to minimize disruption. * Troubleshoot complex issues at the intersection of hardware, software, and network connectivity, working with cross\-functional teams to resolve them. * Perform routine preventive maintenance, system backups, and health checks to keep equipment stable. * Support the installation, setup, and site acceptance testing (SAT) of automation systems delivered from headquarters. * + Execute light modifications and parameter tuning, for example, calibrating sensors and modifying configurations files to support new product introduction (NPI) and process changes. + Read Ladder Logic to assist in diagnosting PLC\-driven faults and validate changes against process and quality requirements before release. + Coordinate with HQ Engineering and local IT/IT Engineering teams to ensure seamless system communication, software updates, and network integration. + Collaborate with Industrial Engineering and production teams to translate process requirements into system configurations, so automated lines meet cycle\-time and yield targets. + Identify bottlenecks and implement optimization actions to improve system reliability, throughput, and efficiency. + Maintain accurate logs of system issues, root\-cause analysis (RCA), configuration changes, and improvement outcomes. + Train and mentor technicians and operators on basic system operations and first\-line troubleshooting procedures. **Competencies** + Solid understanding of automated production systems, including precision actuators, servo/stepper motors, pneumatic systems, and industrial sensors. + Proficient with mechanical hand tools (screwdrivers, hex/Allen keys, torque tools) for equipment disassembly, component replacement, and mechanical calibration. + Strong, root\-cause\-oriented problem solving with a practical, hands\-on approach. + Excellent cross\-functional communication to bridge local production, IT, and remote HQ engineering teams. + Ability to read electrical schematics, pneumatic diagrams, and mechanical drawings. + Ability to maintain composure and perform in a fast\-paced, high\-volume manufacturing environment. + Familiarity with PLC concepts and the ability to read Ladder Logic to assist troubleshooting (deep programming not required) is a strong plus. + Experience with vision systems (e.g., Keyence) or robotic\-arm operations is a plus. **Education and Experience** + Must have a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related engineering field. + 1\-3 years of experience in manufacturing, automation, or production environments. + Experience working with automated equipment, assembly lines, robotic cells, or precision machinery. + Experience supporting installation, site acceptance testing (SAT), maintenance, or troubleshooting is preferred. + Experience working in fast\-paced, high\-volume manufacturing environments. + Exposure to new product introduction (NPI) processes is a plus. + **Physical Requirements** - Regularly required to walk, talk, and hear while performing daily job duties - Occasionally required to stand, sit, use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, and move within the facility - May occasionally be required to climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl when accessing equipment or facility areas - Must be able to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds as needed - Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus

jobs.title: Design Engineer - Substation
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in\-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects. Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right\-of\-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients. **About this Role** ------------------- Every moment of every day, people all over the world rely on electricity provided by Quanta Services and its customers. With its highly skilled and innovative workforce, Quanta is the largest specialty contractor in North America that powers modern life. Find your future with us by being a part of something bigger – leading the energy transition in building a better world for generations to come. We encourage and inspire our people to embrace opportunities within our corporate office and 200 operating companies providing solutions for the utility, renewable energy, electric power, industrial, and communications industries worldwide. Quanta’s culture is about creating an environment where all employees can be themselves, are valued, and have an equal opportunity to succeed. When you join our team, you join a dynamic culture in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is valued. **What You'll Do** ------------------ The Design Engineer \- Substation will perform substation design assignments including physical layout and protection \& control systems while ensuring compliance with safety and construction standards. This role involves designing substation components, selecting materials, preparing design documents, and collaborating with engineers and field personnel to ensure project accuracy and efficiency. This position will report to a Supervising Engineer and be part of a substation design team with other engineers, designers, and drafters supporting substation projects across the QISG platform. opportunities and project status information accurately and consistently. * Adhere to established policies, procedures, regulations, and compliance requirements. **Project \& Organizational jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** IAA is seeking a highly experienced Staff Engineer to join the US Operations Platform organization. This role is focused on modernizing and scaling mission\-critical operational applications that support auction, logistics, titles, payments, and yard operations across the United States. You will provide hands\-on technical leadership in evolving legacy systems into modern, cloud\-native .NET applications, while improving reliability, performance, and long\-term maintainability. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead application modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy .NET Framework to modern .NET (.NET Core / latest LTS). * Drive architectural design for scalable, modular services and APIs supporting high\-volume operational workflows. * Partner with Product and Architecture to decompose monolithic applications into well\-defined domains and services. * Define and implement modern data\-access patterns using ORMs, repository patterns, and controlled schema migrations. * Improve system performance, resilience, and fault tolerance through sound design practices (timeouts, retries, idempotency, and graceful degradation). * Establish and enforce engineering standards for code quality, testing, and maintainability. * Embed observability into applications using structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry). * Design secure\-by\-default application patterns including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure coding practices. * Lead technical discovery and solution design for complex, cross\-team initiatives. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and hands\-on technical guidance. * Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Security, Data, and Operations teams to ensure solutions meet operational and compliance requirements. **Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent modernizing large\-scale applications. * Demonstrated experience operating at a Staff or Principal Engineer level, influencing architecture and technical direction. * Deep expertise in C\#, .NET, .NET Core, and modern application development practices. * Strong experience designing RESTful APIs and service\-oriented or domain\-driven architectures. * Hands\-on experience modernizing legacy systems and databases in production environments. * Strong understanding of relational databases and modern data\-access strategies. * Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and cloud\-native application patterns. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain technical tradeoffs to engineering and business stakeholders. * Proven ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, and raise overall engineering quality. **Bonus Experience** * Experience with high\-throughput, transaction\-heavy operational systems. * Exposure to event\-driven or asynchronous architectures. * Experience modernizing applications in regulated or compliance\-sensitive environments. * Familiarity with front\-end modernization (e.g., React) as part of full\-stack initiatives. IAA Holdings, LLC (IAA) IAA Holdings, LLC (IAA), a Ritchie Bros. Auctioneers company (NYSE: RBA) and (TSX: RBA), is a trusted global marketplace for insights, services, and transaction solutions for commercial assets and vehicles. Leveraging leading\-edge technology and focusing on innovation, IAA’s unique platform facilitates the marketing and sale of total\-loss, damaged and low\-value vehicles. IAA serves a global buyer base – located throughout over 170 countries – and a full spectrum of sellers, including insurers, dealerships, fleet lease and rental car companies, and charitable organizations. Buyers have access to multiple digital bidding and buying channels, innovative vehicle merchandising, and efficient evaluation services, enhancing the overall purchasing experience. IAA offers sellers a comprehensive suite of services aimed at maximizing vehicle value, reducing administrative costs, shortening selling cycle time and delivering the highest economic returns. RB Global full\-time employees are offered medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurances. Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan and RB Global will match 100% for the first 4% contributed. Employees will also receive 15 days of PTO each year.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Rebar** --------------- Rebar is building the AI operating system for commercial HVAC, Electrical, and Plumbing. Over the past year our quoting platform has processed tens of thousands of projects across North America and we're continuing that growth. Our customers include many of the top firms in the industry. Some of these companies are running billion dollar construction projects on workflows that still look like it's 1985\. Construction is 10% of GDP and still massively underserved by software. We are changing that. We recently raised a $14M Series A from leading construction tech investors and are entering our next phase of growth. We are building a set of AI native products that will define how this industry operates. **About the Engineering Org** ----------------------------- The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware and we're being very intentional of ensuring we adapt with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. To echo our values, everyone operates like an owner, we find a way, and we win together. **About the Role** ------------------ This role is going to be sitting on our AI and ML team as a backend engineer. You will be working directly with our in house models (as well as frontier VLMs) so that we can build a world class interaction for the frontend. For example, you could be taking a segmentation mask that one of our detection models produces, deciding what it should become on the canvas \- a polygon, a polyline, a set of connection ports \- designing the contract that carries it there, and then making it something our users can grab and correct. The job is not just "make the model better", it’s to have the ideal shape and use case for the user can see, trust, correct, and bill against. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design the perception product data contract * Ship AI geometry into the canvas * Own the accuracy and UX tradeoff honestly * Close the correction loop * Be the translation layer between our AI/ML team and the product engineers **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We're looking for someone comfortable working largely across the stack. You should be comfortable reading a PyTorch postprocessing path in the morning and then understanding the flow to the canvas rendering path in the afternoon. You should be willing to dive deeper into understand model architectures and spotting inefficiencies as their outputs are translated downstream. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 6\+ years of industry software engineering experience + If fewer than 6 years of experience, still encouraged to apply! * Shipped computer vision or ML output into a product surface that users interact with daily * Comfortable in Python and TypeScript * Experience designing and versioning data contracts between services on live customer data **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Canvas and rendering experience * Familiarity with vector graphic object models, standards, and protocols * Experience building human in the loop labeling or active learning loops * Construction, CAD, GIS, or another domain where drawings are the source of truth **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * **Salary:** Competitive base salary * **Equity:** Meaningful equity package, commensurate with experience * **Benefits:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * **Perks:** + Agentic tooling budget + Lunches provided, dinners provided (after a set time) + Great culture and office banter This is a salaried, onsite role located in New York City's Flatiron district. We are still a startup! We love working onsite together and believe strongly that this gives us for creative problem\-solving, and building strong connections. You'll be at the heart of our fast\-paced operations, actively contributing to a culture that values engagement, growth, and teamwork. Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

The company’s proprietary technology, advanced data analytics, and expertise fuel organizational decision\-making from strategy through execution, delivering sustainable solutions with the lowest possible environmental impact. Global organizations and regulated industries trust RRD to reduce complexity and drive audience connections across the entire customer journey. **Job Description** The Senior Linux \& Infrastructure Automation Engineer is responsible for engineering, scaling, and maintaining the underlying Valassis DMT platform environment. This individual contributor role focuses heavily on hands\-on systems engineering, robust configuration management, and high\-availability cloud infrastructure execution across hybrid environments, spanning bare\-metal servers, collocations, and cloud architectures. The position requires deep expertise in Linux systems administration, advanced automation using Puppet and Ansible, and experience deploying and operating OpenStack environments. **Core Responsibilities** * Infrastructure Automation \& Configuration Management: Design, develop, and maintain declarative configuration modules using Puppet and Ansible to automate system provisioning, application deployment, and continuous compliance across bare\-metal and virtualized nodes. * Linux Systems Engineering: Administer, tune, and troubleshoot enterprise Linux environments (primarily Ubuntu) for optimal performance, kernel optimization, security hardening, and maximum uptime. * Cloud \& Virtualization Operations: Operate and optimize virtualization and hypervisor layers (including OpenStack, LXD, KVM, and ESXi lifecycles) and drive automated bare\-metal server provisioning. * Storage \& Infrastructure Maintenance: Administer and maintain persistent storage infrastructure alongside physical SAN equipment (PureStorage or enterprise S3\-compatible targets). * Technical Execution \& Migrations: Actively execute platform refreshes, legacy environment decommissionings, and infrastructure migrations across datacenter footprints. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent professional work experience. * Minimum of 5–7\+ years of progressive hands\-on experience in Linux infrastructure engineering, systems administration, and cloud infrastructure automation. **Required Skills** * **Linux Administration \-** Expert\-level, hands\-on experience engineering, hardening, and maintaining enterprise Ubuntu/Debian server environments. * **Automation \& CM \-** Proven mastery authoring custom Puppet modules and Ansible playbooks/roles to automate configuration, orchestration, and system management at scale. * **Orchestration \& Virtualization \-**Strong foundational background in bare\-metal provisioning concepts and hypervisor/container runtimes (KVM, LXD, ESXi). * **Storage Fundamentals \-**Solid understanding of enterprise storage architectures, including SAN/NAS devices, block/object storage concepts, and volume management. * **Identity \& Security \-**Working knowledge of cross\-platform Active Directory integration, enterprise PKI/certificate enrollment, and domain identity services. **Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)** * OpenStack Operations: Hands\-on experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining production OpenStack deployments (Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Keystone). * Scale\-Out Storage (Ceph): Direct experience configuring, operating, or maintaining Ceph storage clusters. * Bare\-Metal Provisioning Tools (MAAS): Hands\-on experience with Canonical MAAS or similar automated bare\-metal provisioning platforms. * MicroCloud \& Edge Frameworks: Familiarity with MicroCloud deployment and lightweight cloud infrastructure environments. **Additional Information** RRD's current salary range for this role is $91,800 to $146,800 / year. jobs.title: Tech Lead, Ramp Travel
jobs.description: **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About the Role** ================== The Ramp Travel team builds the travel booking and management platform built\-in to Ramp. We build the capabilities that allows travelers to stay productive on the road: flight and hotel search, booking and checkout, our agentic travel assistant, and on\-the\-go mobile trip guidance. We also own the capabilities that ensure companies are spending their travel dollars effectively: travel policy evaluation, supplier and TMC integrations and benchmarking, and data insights. Growing the sophistication and global reach of the Travel product is a top strategic priority at Ramp. The work this team does directly enables Ramp to to support some of the largest and most interesting customers in the world. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Lead, mentor, coach, and grow the Ramp Travel engineering team (\~6 engineers today). * Own delivery across our travel management surfaces: search and inventory, quoting and repricing, checkout, policy evaluation, loyalty, post\-booking servicing. * Own reliability and correctness of a system dependent on third parties: supplier APIs, GDS and aggregator content, TMC and OBT integrations. * Partner with Product, Design, Ops, Partnerships, and Sales on enterprise travel commitments. * Set the team's practices for AI\-assisted development and ship agentic booking features. * Hire. jobs.description: **Description** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. Realtor.com is looking for a Sr. AI Solutions Engineer to turn business challenges into practical AI solutions. You will collaborate with teams to uncover pain points, build rapid prototypes, and coach colleagues so they can extend what you start. Your work will span three of our internal AI tracks: Assist (knowledge copilots), Automate (workflow agents), and Compose (low\-code apps). If you thrive on analyzing problems, building hands\-on solutions, and teaching others, this role is for you. Join us as our newest Sr. AI Solutions Engineer, and help change the world of real estate, one home at a time. **Top Reasons to Apply:** * Pioneer a first\-of\-its\-kind role at Realtor.com – Shape the future of AI developer productivity by building the foundational systems, tools, and workflows from the ground up. * Drive AI adoption and learning across the company – Help design, teach, and scale AI best practices that will empower teams across Product, Engineering, and Ops. * Make a big impact while leveling up your own skills – Contribute meaningfully to Realtor.com's AI strategy and enjoy continuous learning opportunities in one of tech’s fastest\-moving spaces. **What You'll Do:** * Discover and design \- Interview stakeholders, map workflows, estimate impact, and choose whether Assist, Automate, or Compose is the right fit, using discovery templates in Miro. * Prototype Assist solutions \- Stand up knowledge copilots with Glean Search and Assistant, Gemini for Workspace, etc. including prompt libraries and retrieval configs. * Develop/Automate solutions \- Build agentic workflows with Google ADK, LangChain, CrewAI, n8n, etc. and harden the winners into production. * Create Compose solutions \- Create fullstack AI applications with integrations across various internal tools. Own and maintain the full lifecycle of these applications, from frontend and backend development, production implementation, cloud resource management, and hand off runbooks to business owners. * Teach and evangelize \- Produce AI flight\-school decks, hands\-on labs, prompt cheat sheets, and run office hours so PMs, analysts, and ops teams can build confidently. * Measure and iterate \- Track adoption, demo outcomes at town halls, and feed lessons into the next solution cycle. **What You'll Bring:** * Experienced in stakeholder discovery, process mapping, and turning requirements into clear AI use cases. * Hands\-on with Assist and knowledge retrieval tools such as Glean, Gemini, Windsurf, or Claude Code and be able to fine\-tune retrieval settings. * Comfortable with Automate tooling like Glean Agents, Vertex AI and can chain steps across APIs. * Experience with cloud\-based development, deployment, and architecture, including tools and technologies such as CircleCI, Kafka, Kubernetes, GraphQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS), and GCP * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment best practices * Exposure to monitoring systems, incident alerting, and service reliability practices to support SLAs * Skilled at crafting and refining LLM prompts, context engineering, MCPs, A2A protocol, Human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation and feedback, and explaining basics to newcomers. * 5\+ years of experience with data and APIs (SQL, REST, JSON, CSV), and able to integrate them into AI workflows. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field or related experience * Natural educator who has led workshops or produced self\-serve guides that stick. * Iterative by nature, quick to test, learn, and refine without needing a formal CS degree. **How We Work:** We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. **How We Reward You:** Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The problem we've solved Selling has always run on a brutal ratio. A salesperson spends barely a third of their day actually selling. The other two\-thirds goes to the work around the customer: the research, the lists, the notes, the CRM, the follow\-up. Two\-thirds of every sales payroll dollar buys administration instead of revenue. The manager's ratio is worse. Coaching is the highest\-leverage thing a sales manager does and it's structurally impossible to do at scale, so they sit in on one call a week and guess at the rest while the quiet underperformers repeat the same mistakes on real customers every day. We built the platform that ends both ratios. One system: the humans get coached on every call they make, and an AI coworker absorbs everything that comes with selling but isn't selling, wired into the CRM, the phones, and the calendar the business already runs on. The hours come back, every conversation gets better, and every outcome feeds back into what gets coached and absorbed next. More time, spent better, measured against revenue. The thing worth understanding before you apply: the call itself is about to be free. Within a year every voice model will hold a competent conversation. What lasts is what happens after the agent hangs up, the messy conversation turned into clean structured data, landed in the system the customer already works in, with the reasoning attached and proof it was done right. Anyone can make the call. Almost nobody does the finishing. That finishing is the product, it's deep, unglamorous, customer\-specific work that doesn't get copied over a weekend, and it's already running. It's also most of what this role extends into every new account. The role We need one person to own the technical customer journey end to end: first serious conversation to live in production. Demo, discovery, pilot design, CRM and telephony integration, launch, and support. You'll go into the codebase when a deployment demands it, tuning and extending what's already there so it fits each new customer, and turning what you learn in the field back into the product. This is the hire that stands up our go\-to\-market motion. You won't inherit a process. You'll build one, run it on our first accounts, and make it repeatable enough that the tenth deployment is dramatically easier than the first. Why this role exists The product is built and it works. The two founders ship production code across the platform, and it's live and running today. What we don't yet have is someone who has run an enterprise technical sales cycle and can deploy that product into outside customers reliably. That's the gap this hire fills, and it's the difference between a product that works and a company that sells. We're not looking for a cog. We're looking for the person who owns the commercial engine and teaches the founders the cycle along the way, so the motion lives in the company and not in one person's head. The unfair advantage you're walking into We own and operate a mid\-sized business in our beachhead vertical. The platform is deployed and running inside that operation right now, with real reps, real call volume, real CRM, and real revenue on the line. It was battle\-tested against a business we own before it ever went near an outside account. You are not selling vapor and you are not cold\-starting in an empty category. You're taking something proven in production into a market we know cold. The size of it The beachhead is one vertical, deliberately. But the architecture doesn't care which vertical it's in. The same system, humans coached on the calls that stay human, a coworker taking the volume and the routine events, wired into whatever stack the customer already runs, applies to any floor where the phone is where the revenue happens: distribution, staffing, mortgage, real estate, dealer groups, legal intake, and beyond. And it runs in two directions. On the floor it's the best software a sales team has ever used. On the wire it's infrastructure the customer's own systems call over API when an event fires. That second direction is where the ceiling stops tracking headcount and starts tracking transaction volume. You'd be deploying the first outside proof of a motion that's meant to stamp across an entire market. Where we are The product is live and proven inside our own operation. Outside customers are the frontier you'd be hired to open, so you're employee\-level early, with the ownership and the upside that implies. If you want a mature pipeline handed to you, this isn't it. If you want to be the person who builds it on top of a product that already works, it's exactly it. What you'll own * **Win the customer.** Lead demos and technical discovery with sales leaders, RevOps, and executives. Turn "we use Salesforce and RingCentral" into a real deployment plan. A good demo leaves them thinking this understands how our team actually works. * **Deploy the customer.** CRM integration and write\-back, telephony setup, configuration, end\-to\-end validation. A phone number that shows connected is not enough. You own the test call. An API that connects is not an integration. It's done when the right data lands in the right place and the customer trusts it. * **Design pilots that answer business questions,** not pilots that succeed because people liked the demo. Baseline metrics, instrumentation, clear success criteria, escalation path. * **Tune and extend the product in the field.** Fix the CRM sync, trace the voice defect, close the integration gap, adapt the finishing to a new customer's stack. You own problems through the stack, not up to the edge of a title. * **Turn the field into product.** When three customers need the same thing, the job isn't to configure it three times. It's to see the pattern and help turn it into a platform capability. * **Transfer the motion.** Part of this role is teaching the founders to run discovery and demos without you in the room. Making yourself repeatable is a measure of success here, not a threat to your seat. The stack Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node, Supabase/Postgres, Inngest for durable async workflows, Electron for live\-call experiences. Voice runs over PSTN with realtime AI: ASR, LLM reasoning, TTS, warm transfers, escalation. You don't need every piece on day one. You need to move through the stack without a tour guide and know where the deterministic boundaries have to sit around the AI. What we look for * You've run enterprise technical sales cycles: discovery, demos to executives, pilots, RFP responses, real integrations. * You can ship production code (TypeScript/Node/React/Postgres) and own a deployment end to end. * You've put AI into production and can reason about agents, tools, evaluation, state, and human escalation. * Strong judgment under incomplete information, and the credibility to tell a customer "we don't support that reliably yet, here's what we do, and here's how we'd prove the next step." * Comfort talking to engineers, operators, RevOps, sales leaders, executives, and security teams in the same week. **Especially valuable:** Salesforce architecture and write\-back, telephony provisioning and routing, realtime voice AI, and freight/logistics/TMS experience. You win the customer, deploy the customer, and improve the product because of what you learned doing both. If you're happiest with a hard problem instead of a detailed ticket, and your instinct after solving something is "how do we turn this into a capability we can use everywhere," this is the seat. jobs.title: Builder - Product Designer
jobs.description: ### **About us:** At Reevo, we're reimagining the entire revenue stack from the ground up, and we're doing it with speed. We're building software that orchestrates every go\-to\-market motion, enabling B2B teams to operate faster, smarter, and more collaboratively. By combining automation, intelligence, and a radically intuitive interface, we're helping companies unlock new levels of productivity and growth across marketing, sales, ops, and customer success teams. If you're excited about working on a product that reshapes how revenue teams work and being surrounded by curious, driven teammates, you'll feel right at home here. From day one, you'll get real ownership, real mentorship, and real impact. Our team of 100\+ builders has over 30 exits under their belt, so you'll be in good company, and working alongside the best! ### **The Role:** We're looking for a product designer at the start of their career — someone who is already building with AI, and who wants to learn the craft in a room full of people doing the work. You'll own pieces of the product, ship them, and see customers use what you made within weeks. You'll do it with a lot of support: you'll work from our San Francisco or Santa Clara office next to senior designers and the engineers and product managers you build with, and the structure, feedback, and mentorship come from being in the room with them every day. We think the job is changing faster than most curricula have caught up with, and that's an advantage for you. Our designers prototype in code, command agents, and ship their own front\-end work. If you've been building things with AI tools because you wanted to, not because a class told you to, you're the kind of person we're looking for. ### **What You Will Do:** **Own real work:** Take well\-scoped design problems end to end — flows, states, edge cases, the details — and deliver them on time, with a lead or a senior designer close by. **Build, don't just mock:** Prototype in code, use agents to get to something clickable fast, and put half\-baked ideas in front of people early. Prototyping something rough to react to is a feature, not a bug. **Learn the customer:** Sit in on sales calls and customer recordings, learn how SDRs, AEs, sales managers, and RevOps leaders actually work, and let that — not taste alone — drive your decisions. **Use the system, and improve it:** Build on our design system rather than around it. When it doesn't have what you need, say so, and help make the case for what should exist. **Ask, share, and get better fast:** Bring work to crit early and often. Share the tools and techniques you're finding — on this team, the newest person is frequently the one who discovers the next workflow everyone adopts. **Show your thinking:** Explain what you made and why. You won't always be right; we care that you can be clear about the call you made and change it when the evidence says to. ### **What We’re Looking For:** * 0–2 years of professional product design experience, including new grads. Internships, freelance work, and things you built on your own all count. * A portfolio of real design work, and real things you've built. Let the work speak for itself — we're not looking for long write\-ups or process explanations. * You're already using AI tools in your daily practice and you're building things with them. This is the closest thing we have to a hard requirement at this level. * Strong instincts for craft and a visible interest in getting better at it, fast. * Curiosity and a technical bent. You're not afraid of a codebase, a terminal, or a tool you've never used. * High agency. You ask for what you need, raise problems early, and don't wait to be assigned. * Based in the Bay Area and in office five days a week — at either our San Francisco or our Santa Clara office, with one day a week in Santa Clara. * No B2B or sales software experience required. We'll teach you the domain. ### **What we offer:** * **Compensation:** A highly competitive base salary and bonus structure, and early\-stage equity that aligns your success directly with the company's growth. * **Comprehensive benefits**: health, dental, and vision coverage, generous paid time off (PTO), plus additional benefits that support how you work. * **Growth and development**: Career advancement paths, dedicated mentorship opportunities, and a strong commitment to investing in your continuous professional development and skill enhancement. * **Dynamic culture**: Join a collaborative, innovative, and fast\-paced work environment where your direct contributions have a tangible and immediate impact on the product, the sales strategy, and the overall company trajectory. Here at Reevo, we know the best ideas come from people with different experiences and perspectives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic, and we’re happy to provide accommodations throughout the application process.

This is the person who makes it possible for every team at Reevo to build consistent, high\-quality experiences quickly, and who understands that the components are only part of the job. The documentation, the socialization, and the governance are what determine whether a system actually gets used. Our design system is early, and the foundational decisions are still ahead of us. You'll drive how we make them, with design and engineering shaping them alongside you. Your customers are the designers and engineers who build on the system. It's also the foundation our AI agents build on, which makes it a product surface in its own right, not just internal scaffolding. The best systems designers have sat on the other side of the table: they've shipped product work themselves, they still take some on, and they design the system around what that work actually demands. ### **What You Will Do:** **Own the Design System:** Own the system end to end, from components and documentation to governance and the roadmap. You'll drive what gets built next and pull in design leadership where you need support. **Build for Scale:** Build and evolve a system that goes from tokens through atomic components to composed patterns, holds up across platforms, and is structured so our AI agents can generate on\-system experiences, working alongside the engineers who implement it. **Iterate Rapidly:** Prototype and pressure\-test components and patterns, iterating on them with the designers and engineers using them and against user feedback and business goals. **Make Documentation Self\-Sustaining:** Own how the system is documented by designing the tooling and process that keep guidance current and useful, so designers, engineers, and our AI agents know not just what a component is, but when and why to use it. **Stay in the Product:** Take on end\-to\-end product design work that stress\-tests the system in real use. **Serve Design and Engineering:** Build deep relationships with the designers and engineers who depend on the system, understand what's blocking them, and prioritize the work that unblocks them. **Socialize and Govern:** Drive adoption across teams, review contributions, and hold the quality bar with guardrails that keep what ships on\-system whether a person or an agent is building it, without becoming a bottleneck. ### **What We’re Looking For:** * 8\+ years designing designers and engineers, and of letting their needs drive your roadmap * Fluency in how components get built, and comfort in the conversation with engineers about component APIs, tokens, and implementation tradeoffs * Genuine interest in building a system that AI agents create with. You don't need to have done it before, but it's central to where ours is going * A self\-starter who is comfortable in ambiguity. You find the problems, decide what matters, and move, pulling in leadership when you need support rather than permission * A high craft bar and the persistence to hold it, including in the parts people skip: edge cases, deprecations, and keeping docs current ### **What we offer:** * **Compensation:** A highly competitive base salary and bonus structure, and early\-stage equity that aligns your success directly with the company's growth. * **Comprehensive benefits**: health, dental, and vision coverage, generous paid time off (PTO), plus additional benefits that support how you work. * **Growth and development**: Career advancement paths, dedicated mentorship opportunities, and a strong commitment to investing in your continuous professional development and skill enhancement. * **Dynamic culture**: Join a collaborative, innovative, and fast\-paced work environment where your direct contributions have a tangible and immediate impact on the product, the sales strategy, and the overall company trajectory. jobs.title: Builder - Staff Product Designer
jobs.description: ### **About us:** At Reevo, we're reimagining the entire revenue stack from the ground up, and we're doing it with speed. We're building software that orchestrates every go\-to\-market motion, enabling B2B teams to operate faster, smarter, and more collaboratively. By combining automation, intelligence, and a radically intuitive interface, we're helping companies unlock new levels of productivity and growth across marketing, sales, ops, and customer success teams. If you're excited about working on a product that reshapes how revenue teams work and being surrounded by curious, driven teammates, you'll feel right at home here. From day one, you'll get real ownership, real mentorship, and real impact. Our team of 100\+ builders has over 30 exits under their belt, so you'll be in good company, and working alongside the best! ### **The Role:** We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to own a major surface of Reevo end to end and to raise the bar for how the whole team works. You'll work from our San Francisco or Santa Clara office alongside the engineers and product managers you build with, take the hardest and least\-defined problems on the roadmap, and turn them into product bets that ship. Nobody hands you a spec here, and nobody is waiting on one from you. You lead with a solution — a design, a prototype, something people can react to. You own your work from idea through production. The product designer role is changing fast across the industry, and we're looking for someone on the leading edge of it. Our designers prototype in code, command agents, and ship their own front\-end work. Figma is for lightweight mockups, exploring divergent directions quickly, polishing little details, whiteboarding, and vision work; production work happens in the codebase. You work in the codebase through agents, owning the decision *and* proving it with something running. ### **What You Will Do:** **Own the problem, not the screen:** Take ambiguous, high\-stakes areas of the product and decide what should exist. Own the workflow, the information architecture, and the bet — across a domain or, at times, the product end to end. You'll make those calls fast and on minimal information rather than waiting for certainty, and you'll bring a direction rather than a list of open questions. **Ship in code:** Prototype in our playground, work in the codebase, and ship the surface\-level UX you own — styling, states, alignment, polish — without waiting on a front\-end specialist. You'll do it through agents, and when the output isn't good enough you'll work with engineering to improve how we build our experiences rather than patching the one screen. **Ship fast, then iterate:** We learn by putting real work in front of real customers quickly and sharpening it from there. Be clear about the bet you're making and the signal that will tell you whether you were right — then ship it, watch what happens, and improve it. The first version is where the learning starts, not where the project ends. **Set the craft bar:** Hold the line on the details that decide whether the product feels designed or assembled — edge cases, empty states, motion, the parts people skip. Critique work that doesn't meet the bar — your own and the team's. **Live in the customer's workflow:** Be in the team channels, in the standups, in the sales call recordings. Care deeply about how SDRs, AEs, sales managers, and RevOps leaders actually work, and let what you learn there drive what you build. **Design for agents as well as people:** Our product is agentic and so is how we build it. Build on the design system, push it where it falls short, and design experiences where agents do the orchestrating and the interface is a thin layer for visibility, guidance, and trust. **Raise the level of the designers around you:** Mentor, be a strong voice in crit, and share the workflows and prompts behind your craft, not just the output. Help us hire — you'll be a trusted interviewer, and you'll help set what we screen for. ### **What We’re Looking For:** * 10\+ years designing products in a fast\-paced environment, with meaningful time in B2B SaaS and at startup stage. * A track record of zero\-to\-one work: you've taken something from nothing to shipped, more than once, and can talk about what you got wrong. * Fluency with AI tooling in your daily practice today. You're already building with agents, not planning to start. * Comfortable working in the codebase through agents. You're already prototyping and shipping real UI this way, and you can hold your end of a conversation with engineers about tradeoffs. * Systems thinking — you build reusable patterns and understand the workflow beyond your immediate surface. * You lead with a solution. You bring designs and prototypes rather than documents and open questions, and when you disagree you come with an alternative. * Speed of decision. You make good calls on incomplete information and keep the work moving instead of waiting for certainty. * A high craft bar and the persistence to hold it, paired with the judgment to know when shipping beats polishing. * A self\-starter who is comfortable in ambiguity. We run on minimal process and a lot of collaboration — all day, every day — and we're building and evolving the product fast; you find the problems, decide what matters, and move — pulling in leadership when you need support rather than permission. * Based in the Bay Area and in office five days a week — at either our San Francisco or our Santa Clara office, with one day a week in Santa Clara. This role is built around daily, in\-person collaboration with the engineers and product managers you ship with. ### **What we offer:** * **Compensation:** A highly competitive base salary and bonus structure, and early\-stage equity that aligns your success directly with the company's growth. * **Comprehensive benefits**: health, dental, and vision coverage, generous paid time off (PTO), plus additional benefits that support how you work. * **Growth and development**: Career advancement paths, dedicated mentorship opportunities, and a strong commitment to investing in your continuous professional development and skill enhancement. * **Dynamic culture**: Join a collaborative, innovative, and fast\-paced work environment where your direct contributions have a tangible and immediate impact on the product, the sales strategy, and the overall company trajectory. Here at Reevo, we know the best ideas come from people with different experiences and perspectives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic, and we’re happy to provide accommodations throughout the application process.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - AWS, Snowflake
jobs.description: Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance\-driven individuals a place where they can build a career \-\-\- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice. Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system. **Job Description:** At Regions, the Data Engineer focuses on the evaluation, design, and execution of data structures, processes, and logic to deliver business value through operational and analytical data assets. jobs.title: CNC Machinist II, Second Shift
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The engine manufacturing department's mission is to product high performing products \& manufacturing systems by continuously innovating on cost, quality, and lead time. Through cross\-functional collaboration, high levels of accountability, and a focus on safety we support the Terran R program. We are responsible for providing design feedback on new hardware iterations, developing new manufacturing methods and systems, and ultimately building engine and vehicle hardware for testing prior to our first launch. Our team's highlights from the last 6 months include the MDC of the first Aeon\-R engine, completing thousands of hours of PBF printing, building and testing over 50 valves of 26 different iterations, and implementing large scale process improvements along the way. In addition to base pay, employees receive a 10% shift differential. **About the Role:** * Set up and operate CNC equipment, including multi\-axis mills, lathes, and mill\-turn machining centers, to produce complex, tight\-tolerance hardware. * Execute machining operations in support of development and production schedules while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and throughput. * Load and monitor cutting tools, vises, and fixturing to ensure repeatable processes and conforming hardware. * Read and interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, work instructions, and inspection requirements to ensure parts meet design intent. * Troubleshoot machining, tooling, setup, and process issues in partnership with CNC programmers and manufacturing engineers. * Identify opportunities to improve machining processes, quality, cycle time, and overall shop capability. **About You:** * 4\+ years of experience setting up and operating CNC mills, lathes, mill\-turns, or similar equipment in a precision manufacturing environment. * Hands\-on experience setting up and operating multi\-axis CNC machining equipment. * Strong understanding of GD\&T with the ability to independently read and interpret complex engineering drawings. * Experience machining complex, tight\-tolerance components and verifying parts using precision measurement equipment. * Experience partnering with manufacturing engineers and CNC programmers in a production, development, or R\&D environment. **Nice to haves but not required:** * Experience with programming CNC machines in ESPRIT is a plus. * DMG Mori/CELOS experience is a plus. **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. jobs.title: Sr. Staff Engineer - Applied AI, Patient (Remote)
jobs.description: We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health.
