By providing a high level of benefit coverage at a reasonable cost to the employee, we hope to foster a long and productive employment relationship. **Summary:** The purpose of this position is to provide engineering support for all aspects of the product development process with specific focus on drafting and laboratory product testing. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned. * Utilize AutoCAD software to create 2D/3D window/door drawings on the computer. * Maintain and update drawing on a regular basis. * Prepare final drawings that incorporate dimensional checking, required materials, parts relationship, and visualization of entire project. * Assists in the analysis of research data and proposed product specifications to determine feasibility of product proposals. * Research and analysis of the competitor products based on Design Engineer specifications. * Work closely with Engineering and Manufacturing to support Design Engineer in the implementation of Product Development themes. * Coordinate and participate in installing test specimens for testing. * Monitor controls instruments and record test data for engineer's use. * Activates controls to apply electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or mechanical power and subject test item to successive steps in test cycle. * Examine parts for form/fit/function conformance with dimensional specifications. * Fabricate precision parts for test specimens or interpret specifications for the fabrication of parts. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This job has no direct supervisory responsibilities. **Education/Experience:** * Associate's degree from an accredited two\-year college or technical school in Architectural Engineering Technology/Architectural Design plus 2 years related experience required; or bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited college * Communication skills with an ability to develop collaborative relationships * Proficient with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Microsoft Office applications * Applies basic engineering principles to troubleshoot technical issues and assist in developing practical solutions * Be vigilant about safety * Quality \- conscious, oriented to excellence **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. jobs.title: Principle Integration and Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview The Principal Integration \& Data Platform Engineer leads the design and evolution of the company’s enterprise integration and data platform. This role operates at the intersection of enterprise applications, manufacturing systems, and analytics infrastructure. The position combines architecture, hands\-on engineering, and technical leadership to ensure reliable data movement and system interoperability across the organization. The Principal Engineer helps shape how information flows across the company — connecting ERP systems, SaaS platforms, manufacturing technologies, and analytics environments into a cohesive and reliable data ecosystem. This role provides senior technical leadership and works closely with enterprise applications, manufacturing engineering, and analytics stakeholders to translate operational needs into scalable technical solutions. While this role influences technical direction and mentors engineers, people management and formal performance oversight remain with the Director of Enterprise Applications. Mission Design and operate the integration and data platform that connects enterprise applications, manufacturing systems, SaaS platforms, and analytics infrastructure across the company. This platform enables operational automation, reliable data movement, and analytics capabilities that support business operations and decision\-making. Key Responsibilities Architecture \& Technical Leadership Provide technical leadership for the company’s enterprise integration and data architecture. * Provide technical leadership across integration and data platform initiatives * Define integration patterns and architectural approaches for cross\-system data flows * Translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical designs * Establish development standards and integration best practices * Participate in platform and architecture decisions alongside IT leadership * Mentor and guide engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and complex troubleshooting Enterprise System Integration Design and maintain integrations connecting core enterprise systems, including: * Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations * Tulip Manufacturing Software * eMaint CMMS * EDI trading partners * Various SaaS platforms and operational systems Integration solutions may involve APIs, event\-driven messaging, data pipelines, and orchestration workflows. Data Platform \& Analytics Infrastructure Lead development and evolution of the company’s analytics data platform. Responsibilities include: * Development of data pipelines supporting enterprise reporting * Architecture and implementation of Microsoft Fabric\-based analytics pipelines * Integration with an existing SQL Server data warehouse and SSAS OLAP models * Supporting Power BI semantic models and reporting infrastructure * Improving reliability and maintainability of enterprise data pipelines * Manufacturing Data Integration Collaborate with manufacturing engineering teams to integrate operational data from production equipment and manufacturing systems. Examples include telemetry and operational data flowing from PLC environments through systems such as Kepware, Azure IoT Hub, Event Hub, Stream Analytics, and Fabric. Engineering teams manage the PLC layer; this role focuses on ingestion, orchestration, and integration with enterprise systems and analytics platforms. jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ The Mercury Mobile team builds Zillow Instant Messaging (ZIM) — the conversation layer where millions of movers participate in a multiplayer, integrated experience to find their next home. hance daily workflows and augment problem\-solving * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in technical marketing, solutions architecture, or advanced systems engineering with deep subject matter of API gateway and reverse\-proxy architecture: request lifecycle, policy and plugin chains, entrypoints/endpoints, and sync and event\-driven APIs. * API security fundamentals: OAuth2, JWT, API keys, mTLS, rate limiting and quotas, CORS. * Experience with persistent data stores such as MongoDB or relational databases, and with search/analytics technologies such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. * review and improve their output. * Clear communication, collaborative problem\-solving, and the ability to take an ambiguous problem through to production **Desired Skills** ================== You do not need to match every item. jobs.title: Sr. Manager. IT Programs
jobs.description: **About iDC Logistics** iDC Logistics, founded in 2004 by logistics industry veterans, is a leading end\-to\-end logistics company focused on transparency, efficiency, and innovative supply chain solutions. Run the intake questionnaire with the commercial team, scope the account, set the go\-live date and the go/no\-go with operations, sequence the Blue Yonder configuration, EDI build, and label work across the enterprise\-applications lead and our vendors, run hypercare, and close out with evidence. Take over the live customer onboarding threads so no relationship depends on one person. * **Build the standardized onboarding playbook.** Templates and SLAs per customer type, the go\-live test library (receiving and putaway, pick and ship, labels, interfaces), training materials, and cycle\-time metrics. Onboarding time and defect rate should fall visibly within your first two quarters. * **Refresh and teach the operational SOPs.** Rebuild the warehouse\-systems SOPs for operations, run training and retraining with site leaders, and work with engineering to make the SOPs queryable so the floor stops depending on one person’s memory. * **Own IT intake, triage, and routing.** Run the single intake path for enterprise\-application, EDI, and IT project requests (built with the IT Operations Manager in ServiceDesk Plus). Decide what is an incident, a request, or a project. Route each to the enterprise\-applications lead, IT operations, the platform engineer, or a vendor, and drive it to done. Hold the line on what is not a priority; a clear “no, here is why” is a valid answer. * **Run the IT delivery cadence.** Chair the weekly Application Project List and the WMS/Applications meeting, keep one prioritized view of the portfolio (ClickUp, ServiceDesk Plus, Jira), and publish written status to the CTO and the business. Break\-fix and data corrections stay in the ticket queue. * **Run the IT side of warehouse openings and closings.** Scope go\-live essentials with operations leaders, phase the rest, and coordinate WMS site setup (enterprise applications), network, connectivity, and hardware (IT operations), EDI, and cutover. * **Coordinate cybersecurity and network projects.** Sequence, track, and report the network standardization and security workstreams with the IT Operations Manager and the external providers. The builder never certifies their own acceptance: you coordinate verification by the operations owner, with the account manager on client\-facing ro o not surprise the business. Commercial terms and budget sit with the CTO. * **Collaborate with product and engineering.** Partner with the warehouse product manager and the forward\-deployed engineers where onboarding and customer requests touch the product roadmap. They build; you run the customer’s timeline. * **Protect the technical bench and the CTO’s time.** Absorb the coordination, prioritization, requirement\-gathering, and stakeholder communication that would otherwise pull them away from the work only they can do. **Minimum Required Qualifications** * 6 to 10 years’ experience PMP or equivalent work experience. * WMS rollout or implementation experience in a warehousing or 3PL context (required, any modern WMS). * Customer\-facing onboarding ownership. * Site launch experience. * EDI onboarding literacy. * Exceptional communication and presence (a hard screen). * Cross\-systems coordination without being the engineer. * Prioritization and outcome ownership. * Autonomy. You are comfortable as the most senior project person in the room, reporting directly to an executive with no PM peer. * Written\-first operating discipline. * AI fluency (a required minimum bar) * Southern California based, able to work hybrid at the City of Industry headquarters and travel 50% to sites. **Strongly Preferred** * Blue Yonder exposure. * NetSuite, CargoWise, or other ERP and TMS implementation exposure. * Has built an SOP library and a training program from scratch. * Network or infrastructure project coordination (circuits, hardware, site cutovers). * Bilingual English and Spanish. * Experience in a fast\-moving, PE\-backed or owner\-operated company. **Benefits** The company offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as basic and voluntary life and voluntary ancillary coverages for accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity. Full\-time employees are eligible for paid sick leave, bereavement, holiday and vacation pay. Employees are eligible to participate in the company 401k plan on the first day of the third month following hire date. **Why Join iDC Logistics?** At iDC Logistics, you will join a growing organization committed to operational excellence, innovation, and employee success. jobs.title: Low-Voltage to Medium-Voltage Silicon MOSFET Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Low\-Voltage to Medium\-Voltage Silicon MOSFET Design Engineer to join our advanced technology development team. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, simulation, and optimization of next\-generation power silicon MOSFETs, with a primary focus on shielded gate structures. Leveraging your deep expertise in semiconductor device physics and the Synopsys TCAD platform, you will drive innovations in device architecture to improve performance metrics such as Rds(on), switching losses, and ruggedness. You will collaborate closely with process integration, characterization, and product engineering teams to bring high\-performance discrete power devices from concept to high\-volume manufacturing. * Responsibilities **Core Responsibilities** * **Shielded Gate Design \& Architecture:** Drive the architecture and optimization of low\-voltage to medium\-voltage silicon power MOSFETs, focusing heavily on advanced shielded gate trench structures to achieve industry\-leading specific on\-resistance and switching figures of merit (FOM). * **Synopsys TCAD Simulation:** Utilize the Synopsys TCAD platform (Sentaurus) to perform extensive 2D/3D process and device simulations, predicting electrical characteristics, breakdown voltage, charge\-balance optimization, and thermal behavior. * **Layout \& Mask Design:** Define layout design rules, create device structures, and collaborate with layout engineers to generate mask layouts for prototype fabrication. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with process integration engineers to define process flows, design rules, and process variations, ensuring design manufacturability and high yield. * **Characterization \& Validation:** Analyze electrical test data from inline monitoring, parametric testing (PCM), and lab characterization to validate Synopsys TCAD models and troubleshoot device performance or reliability issues. * Qualifications **Required Qualifications** * **Education:** Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Sciences, Materials Science, or a closely related discipline, with a research focus directly tied to power semiconductor devices. * **Experience:** 3\+ years of post\-degree industrial or advanced academic research experience in silicon power MOSFET design and development. * **Device Physics Expertise:** Deep theoretical understanding of semiconductor device physics, carrier transport, breakdown mechanisms, and power MOSFET dynamics (UIS, safe operating area, switching behavior). * **Advanced TCAD Skills:** Proven expertise using the Synopsys TCAD suite for comprehensive process integration emulation and electrical device characterization. * **Problem\-Solving \& Communication:** Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex device\-level anomalies, paired with excellent communication skills to present technical data across multi\-functional engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with discrete power packaging technologies and their impact on device parasitic elements. * Familiarity with reliability mechanisms specific to shielded gate power devices, such as shield oxide integrity, electromigration, and high\-temperature stress testing (HTGB/HTRB). * Knowledge of power electronics applications to better align device specifications with system\-level requirements. About Us **onsemi** (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end\-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.
